FLUID Alerts display a concise, important message in a way that attracts the user's attention.

Alert variations have specific colors, icons, and content considerations associated with them to communicate certain types of information.

props.name: alertCargo
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "alertCargo" is now deprecated. Instead, use the
"config" Prop (same functionality, just a different naming
convention) -- Single configuration object to populate Alert
(instead of using individual Props).

props.name: alertTitle
props.docs:
When provided, displays a title at the top of the Alert (above the
"message").

props.name: config
props.docs:
Single configuration object to populate Alert (instead of using
individual Props).

props.name: dismissible
props.docs:
When true, Alert will display a "close" button that will dismiss/
hide the Alert when clicked. NOTE: only available for "info" &
"success" severity levels (i.e. "warning" & "error" Alerts are NOT
dismissible per UX standards).

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When provided, the "identifier" string will be prepended to
"data-test-id" attributes on Alert's inner architecture to help
facilitate testing.

props.name: inline
props.docs:
When true, the Alert's width will be determined by its content
(rather than expanding to 100% width of container).

props.name: loading
props.docs:
When true, Alert will display a "loading spinner" Icon in place
of the Icon associated with its "severity". NOTE: only available
for "info" or "success" severity levels (i.e. "warning" & "error"
Alerts cannot display as "loading" per UX standards).

props.name: message
props.docs:
Message/content displayed within the Alert's body (accepts HTML).
If message Prop is undefined, Alert will render a "message" named slot.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: position
props.docs:
When "snackbar" Prop is true, determines "floating" position of the
Alert relative to the viewport. NOTE: this Prop ONLY applies to
"snackbar" Alerts & will be ignored if "snackbar" Prop is false.

props.name: removeMargin
props.docs: When true, removes Alert's bottom margin.

props.name: severity
props.docs: Determines the Alert's color scheme & Icon based on its purpose.

props.name: snackbar
props.docs:
When true, Alert will be displayed as a "floating" element (i.e.
appears on top of page content) in the position specified by the
"position" Prop. NOTE: use the "position" Prop to customize the
"snackbar" Alert's appearance, & use the "timeout" Prop to
automatically hide Alert after a specified time limit.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: timeout
props.docs: How long after the alert renders should it stay on screen? (ms).

props.name: visible
props.docs: Whether the Alert is visible or hidden.

props.name: width
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "width" is now deprecated. "snackbar" Alerts
are now responsive based on viewport size & "message" length.
If this Prop is used, Alert will NOT be responsive --
When "snackbar" Prop is true, defines the Alert's width. NOTE:
this Prop ONLY applies to "snackbar" Alerts & will be ignored
if "snackbar" Prop is false.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.docs:
Dismisses the Alert (when open) & emits "alertDismissed" event
containing Alert's Prop values.

methods.name: show
methods.docs:
Displays the Alert (when hidden/closed) & emits "alertShown" event
containing Alert's Prop values.

events.docs:
Event emitted when Alert is dismissed that contains current

Event emitted when Alert is shown that contains current state of the

show() is called).

changeLog.title: FLUID Alert Added
changeLog.description: Fluid button group component created.

changeLog.title: Rendering Tests Updated
changeLog.description: Added render tests for most props

changeLog.title: Support for Inline Alerts
changeLog.description: Added `inline` Prop that sets width of Alert based on length of text/content within the Alert (rather than spanning 100% of parent container). Also displays Alert as `inline-block`.

changeLog.title: Added `show()` method
changeLog.description: Alerts can now be displayed using the `show()` method. Similarly, Alerts can be dismissed using the `dismiss()` method.

changeLog.title: Only "Success" & "Info" Alerts are Dismissible
changeLog.description: Removed the ability to dismiss "Error" & "Warning" Alerts. "Error" & "Warning" Alerts are typically caused by user interaction with the UI, and should only be removed when the issue is fixed (NOT via clicking a "dismiss" button)

changeLog.title: Added fading animation to Alerts when dismissed
changeLog.description: Alerts now fade out of view when dismissed instead of immediately disappearing.

changeLog.title: Added Ability to Remove Bottom Margin
changeLog.description: Added `removeMargin` Prop. When true, Alert is rendered without bottom margin

changeLog.title: Updated Alert LM Theme
changeLog.description: Updated FLUID Alert LM theme "success", "info", "warning", & "error" color palettes to be more consistent with existing Property alerts. Also updated LM / default theme Icon SVGs to use LM brand icons (instead of legacy FontAwesome icons).

changeLog.title: Added LM Corporate Theme Support to Alert
changeLog.description: Added LM Corporate theme support to FLUID Alert.

changeLog.title: Improved Alert "aria" Attribute Integration
changeLog.description: Improved FLUID Alert accessibility by refactoring / improving "aria" attribute integration.

changeLog.title: Adding a snackbar component
changeLog.description: Users should be able to utilize a snackbar for toast-like notifications

changeLog.title: Color Contrast Accessibility Updates
changeLog.description: Updated Alert's "close" button color fill to meet WCAG AA contrast spec. Also updated Alert's severity: warning Icon color fill to meet WCAG AA contrast spec for Default, Corp, & Portal themes.

changeLog.title: Adds i18n Strategy
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to configure FLUID alert to accept message translations (MVP)

changeLog.title: Responsive "snackbar" Alert
changeLog.description: Updated snackbar Alert to be responsive based on content width & viewport size. snackbar Alert now has a "fluid" width that automatically adjusts to match the width of its message without overflowing the bounds of the viewport. Also added drop shadow to snackbar Alert, making it more visible against background page content.

changeLog.title: Updated Alert Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Overhauled & refactored Alert's very outdated usage examples to include demos of all major Props & features.

changeLog.title: Refactored Alert LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Alert's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Aesthetic Improvements
changeLog.description: Refreshed Alert's visual design to be more modern, visually appealing, & consistent with each theme's overall look & feel.

changeLog.title: Support for Alert Title
changeLog.description: Added alertTitle Prop to Alert that renders a heading title at the top of the component above the message.

docsTags.text: FLUID Badge is simply a label that holds a small amount of contextual information. It is commonly used for displaying status words & phrases (e.g. "New", "Pending", "Success", "UW Review Needed", etc.), dates, numerical values, etc. Badge should be displayed in close proximity to the information that it's associated with, and should have a color that indicates the tone or severity of its label.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: icon-before - Named Slot for icon displayed before Badge label. Only available if "iconBefore" Prop is NOT specified.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: icon-after - Named Slot for icon displayed after Badge label. Only available if "iconAfter" Prop is NOT specified.

props.name: block
props.docs:
If true, Badge will be rendered as a block-level element instead of
inline-block.

props.name: chip
props.docs: Default setting is true, only legacy theme will have this set to false. If false, badge will display with rectangular styling.

props.name: color
props.docs:
Primary color used for Badge border, label (when "solid" Prop is false),
& background (when "solid" Prop is true).

props.name: config
props.docs: Allows Badge @Props to be set via a single configuration object.

props.name: iconAfter
props.docs: If provided, renders a FLUID Icon to the right of the Badge label.

props.name: iconBefore
props.docs: If provided, renders a FLUID Icon to the left of the Badge label.

props.name: indicator
props.docs:
If true, Badge will be styled as an "indicator" for displaying a
numerical value, character marker, or status word (e.g. a number within a
Tree Menu menu item). NOTE: Badge should NOT be used as a standalone
component when this Prop is utilized. Indicator Badges should only be
used as "add-ons" to indicate status or context, and should be displayed
beside label text or in the upper right-hand corner of a container.

props.name: label
props.docs: Text to be displayed within the Badge body.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: solid
props.docs:
If true, Badge will have a solid-color background. Otherwise, Badge
will have transparent background with color border & label. This Prop
can be used in combination with "chip" & "indicator" Props.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

slots.name: icon-after
slots.docs: Named Slot for icon displayed after Badge label. Only available if "iconAfter" Prop is NOT specified.

slots.name: icon-before
slots.docs: Named Slot for icon displayed before Badge label. Only available if "iconBefore" Prop is NOT specified.

changeLog.title: Badge Created

changeLog.title: Added Badge Type: "Chip"
changeLog.description: Added chip property to the Badge component. Chip property changes the styling of the Badge to work with the Forms Management Service styling. Changes the padding, font-size, border radius and adds an icon to the Badge.

changeLog.title: Refactored Badge Architecture & Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Badge architecture to fix positioning & alignment issues, & refactored Badge styles to have theme-specific sizing, spacing, etc. Also refactored Badge Icon render methods into functional components.

changeLog.title: Added Badge Type: "Indicator"
changeLog.description: Added "indicator" @Prop to Badge for displaying a numerical value, character marker, or status word (e.g. a number within a Tree Menu menu item). Indicator Badges should only be used as "add-ons" to indicate status or context, and should be displayed beside label text or in the upper right-hand corner of a container. Badge should NOT be used as a standalone component when this @Prop is utilized.

changeLog.title: Added Support for All FluidColor Values to Badge
changeLog.description: Updated Badge "color" @Prop to accept all FluidColor values (instead of just FluidSeverityColor values) EXCEPT for the non-standard colors: "DEEP_YELLOW" & "RED_ORANGE".

changeLog.title: Fixed Badge Color Contrast Issues
changeLog.description: Updated Badge styles so that all color variations are at least WCAG 2.0 Level AA compliant.

changeLog.title: Added "config" @Prop to Badge
changeLog.description: Added ability to set all Badge @Props through a single configuration object.

changeLog.title: Overhauled Badge Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Completely refactored Badge usage examples to cover all @Props & Slots. Also included comprehensive "color" @Prop examples for each Badge type/style.

changeLog.title: Changed default badge type to "chip"
changeLog.description: Default badge type now has chip set to true. Only legacy theme will have this set to false.

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation

docsTags.text:
At the top of a multipage app, the breadcrumb component allows user to reference the current page and the depth of navigation that has brought them to that current page within the site structure. Usually the breadcrumb trail references previous page titles as well as providing users clickable links to navigate to a previous page, several pages back, and at the homepage. Styles are usually defined to distinguish clickable links versus the current page being rendered.

IMPORTANT: Clicking on a link within breadcrumb will not generate a new page load. Breadcrumb is written to pass link value as an event detail. Page routing should therefore be handled as an event listener for breadcrumbClicked event.

props.name: config
props.docs:
Allows a single config object to be given, rather than inline properties
so config can be passed as a single prop.

props.name: homeLabel
props.docs:
Allows for passing a string to substitute the default text "Home" for
the home page or first element of the breadcrumb

props.name: homeLink
props.docs:
Allows for passing a custom path to substitute the default root "/" for
the home page or first link of the breadcrumb

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the breadcrumb in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: trail
props.docs:
Allows for the building of an array of links to trace the trail of the breadcrumb
navigation. The history, sequence and shifting of this array should be maintained
by the developer as part of the flow of the pages within an application.

events.docs:
Emits the link route and prevents default behavior of anchor when clicked.
In order to handle the routing of the application; this value should be
intercepted by adding an event listener to breadcrumb component; routing
logic should be handled under here as click will not load a new page.

changeLog.title: Breadcrumb Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Breadcrumb component was created to give users an easy out-of-the-box solution for providing page structure navigation within a page. The component is part of a FLUID package of solutions of essential web components to kick-start a web page. Users can pass an array of objects as a property to set out the trail of user navigation.

changeLog.title: Breadcrumb Logic Enhancement
changeLog.description: Updated the FLUID Breadcrumb component to enhance the breadcrumb trail logic. Now, when neither homeLink nor homeLabel is provided, the first item of the trail is correctly rendered outside the context menu, ensuring a more intuitive navigation experience. This update addresses specific use cases to improve the components flexibility and usability in various application structures.

changeLog.title: Responsive Breadcrumb Update
changeLog.description: Enhanced the FLUID Breadcrumb component to support responsive behavior. When the breadcrumb trail exceeds the available viewport width, it now automatically truncates and presents the excess items within a context menu. This update ensures a clean and accessible navigation experience across various screen sizes, maintaining usability without compromising the breadcrumb trail’s integrity.

changeLog.title: Refactored Breadcrumb LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Breadcrumb's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

docsTags.text: FLUID Buttons represent actions that users can initiate within an experience.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: icon-before - Named slot for icon BEFORE the Button label. Only available if "iconBefore" Prop is NOT specified.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: icon-after - Named slot for icon AFTER the Button label. Only available if "iconAfter" Prop is NOT specified.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: icon-self - Named slot for an icon-only Button.

props.name: color
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "color" is now deprecated. Instead, use the "type" Prop
(same functionality, just a different naming convention) -- Sets the
color & style of the Button.

props.name: colorScheme
props.docs:
NOTE: This Prop applies to Icon-Only Buttons (i.e. "icon" Prop) &
"type: ghost" Buttons ONLY (it will be ignored for all other Button
types). Sets color of Button's label text and/or embedded Icon to
"light" or "dark" for increased contrast when displayed on a color
background. For example, if your Button is displayed on a DARK BLUE
background, set this Prop's value to "light" so that the label color
will be white (instead of the default blue). If your Button is
displayed on a YELLOW background, set this Prop's value to "dark" so
that the label will be dark gray (instead of the default blue). Do
NOT change this Prop's value if your Button is displayed on a WHITE
background. See "Examples" tab for more info.

props.name: config
props.docs: Allows all Button Props to be set via a single configuration object.

props.name: controlBarPosition
props.docs:
If the button is part of a control bar, what position is it
in? 'start' | 'middle' | 'end'

props.name: disabled
props.docs: If true, Button will be disabled (i.e. adds 'disabled' attribute).

props.name: fullWidth
props.docs: When true, the Button will stretch to fill the full width of its container.

props.name: icon
props.docs:
When provided, Button will display an embedded Icon ONLY instead of
a label (i.e. creates an Icon-Only Button). NOTE: even though a
label isn't displayed when this Prop is used, you should still
provide a descriptive label to the "label" Prop for accessibility
(i.e. the "label" Prop value is applied as an "aria-label" to the
<button> element).

props.name: iconAfter
props.docs: An additional icon to be placed after the button label

props.name: iconBefore
props.docs: An additional icon to be placed before the button label

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When provided, the "identifier" string will be prepended to
"data-test-id" attributes on Button's inner architecture to help
facilitate testing.

props.name: interactionElement
props.docs: The type of interaction element to report for observability.

props.name: label
props.docs:
The label text displayed on the Button OR the "aria-label" applied
to Icon-Only Buttons. NOTE: when using the "icon" Prop, you should
still provide a descriptive label to this Prop for accessibility.

props.name: large
props.docs: When true, Button will be larger than the default size.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: popover
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popover" is now deprecated (https://chromestatus.com/feature/5463833265045504).
Instead, use the "message" property of the "popoverConfig" Prop. --
If provided, adds simple "tooltip" Popover to Button that is
displayed on hover. Typically used to display a message when Button
is disabled. NOTE: if you need to customize Popover's Props, use the
"popoverConfig" Prop instead to access ALL of Popover's Props.

props.name: popoverConfig
props.docs:
When provided, adds a Popover to Button that is displayed on :hover
(e.g. display a message on disabled Button). Accepts either a
string or FluidPopoverConfig value - string value generates a simple
Popover, while a FluidPopoverConfig value allows all Popover Props
to be customized.

props.name: popoverTitle
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popoverTitle" is now deprecated. Instead, use the
"header" property of the "popoverConfig" Prop. -- Adds a title to the
Popover. If undefined, Popover will show without a header section.

props.name: popoverWidth
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popoverWidth" is now deprecated. Instead, use the
"width" property of the "PopoverConfig" Prop. -- Specifies the maximum
width of the Popover (in px).

props.name: removeHorizontalMargin
props.docs: Removes default right margin.

props.name: removeMargin
props.docs: Removes ALL default margins (i.e. "margin-right" & "margin-bottom").

props.name: removeVerticalMargin
props.docs: Removes default bottom margin.

props.name: small
props.docs: When true, Button will be smaller than the default size.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: type
props.docs:
Sets the color & style of the Button. NOTE: "primary" Buttons should
be used very sparingly, & should only be used for the most important
actions in the user's workflow (i.e. you should NOT have 2+ "primary"
Buttons side-by-side).

slots.name: icon-after
slots.docs: Named slot for icon AFTER the Button label. Only available if "iconAfter" Prop is NOT specified.

slots.name: icon-before
slots.docs: Named slot for icon BEFORE the Button label. Only available if "iconBefore" Prop is NOT specified.

slots.name: icon-self
slots.docs: Named slot for an icon-only Button.

components.contextData: FLUID Buttons represent actions that users can initiate within an experience.

changeLog.title: Added Full Width Support
changeLog.description: Added "fullWidth" @Prop (boolean) to make buttons stretch to fill the full width of their container. Feature excludes icon-only buttons to preserve their square shape.

changeLog.title: FLUID Buttons added
changeLog.description: Fluid button component created.

changeLog.title: Rendering Tests Updated
changeLog.description: Added render tests for most props

changeLog.title: Styles updated for icon before / after
changeLog.description: Updated icon before / after styling to be more consistent across browsers / apps

changeLog.title: Fixed Hover Icon Color Bug
changeLog.description: Fixed issue that prevented FLUID Icon color from changing with text color on :hover (LM theme only).

changeLog.title: Added Corporate Theme Support
changeLog.description: Added styles for LM Corporate theme to Button.

changeLog.title: Added Support for "Icon-Only" Buttons
changeLog.description: Updated Button's "label" @Prop to be optional, allowing for "icon-only" Buttons (icon(s) must be provided if "label" @Prop is omitted). Also added conditional rendering to Button's icon slots - slot(s) not rendered if no slotted icon(s) provided (removes extraneous horizontal margin).

changeLog.title: Button Tests Updated
changeLog.description: Rewrote Button tests to account for optional "label" @Prop & conditional icon slot rendering.

changeLog.title: Added "Inverse" Button Variation
changeLog.description: Added support for "inverse" Button styles via the "color" @Prop for all themes. "Inverse" Button variation should only be used on dark backgrounds.

changeLog.title: Updated LM Corporate Theme Button "Tertiary" Styles
changeLog.description: Updated "tertiary" Button styles for LM Corporate theme to be consistent with dark blue "tertiary" Buttons in all other themes.

changeLog.title: Improved Button Styles for Each Theme
changeLog.description: Updated Button styles to be more consistent with overall look & feel for each theme. Also updated :hover, :focus, & :active state styles for each theme, & added support for :focus-visible (in supported browsers).

changeLog.title: Fixed Button Popover Theme Issue
changeLog.description: Updated optional Button Popover to correctly implement the "theme" @Prop.

changeLog.title: Functional Tests Added and Rendering Tests Updated
changeLog.description: Added functional tests for togglePopover() method. Added comprehensive suite of render tests for Buttons with Popovers, including tests for :focus and :blur. Updated other render tests to use simpler, native Stencil test functions.

changeLog.title: Converted button to use functional component
changeLog.description: Button has now been split into functional components internally to make updates easier to make, style and test. Also added a full suite of functional component tests so each element (label, icons, popover, etc) has been tested in isolation as well as as a complete unit.

changeLog.title: Added large button and icon as button
changeLog.description: To complement the `small` button variant, there now exists a `large` variant of the buttons, which align with each themes form input heights. Additionally, by passing an icon configuration through the new `icon` prop, you can create an icon as button, with hover and focus states. Whilst it still looks like an icon, it is actually a button, which comes with all the necessary accessibility considerations built in.

changeLog.title: Added Ghost Button Styles
changeLog.description: Added styles for "ghost" variation of FLUID Button. Ghost Buttons have no background or border, displaying only a label & optional icon(s) (if provided). Ghost Buttons are sometimes referred to as "text buttons" or "link buttons" (although they don't have to be used as links).

changeLog.title: Refactored Button Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Updated Button usage examples to encompass a more complete set of use cases for the component. New usage examples include Ghost Button, Inverse Button, and Buttons with slotted icons.

changeLog.title: Added "colorScheme" Prop
changeLog.description: Added "colorScheme" Prop to Button - changes ghost Button label text color to either light (white) or dark (default text color) for increased contrast when displayed on a color background. For example, if your Ghost Button is displayed on a DARK BLUE background, set this Prop's value to "light" so that the label color will be white (instead of the default blue). If your Ghost Button is displayed on a YELLOW background, set this Prop's value to "dark" so that the label will be dark gray (instead of the default blue). NOTE: This Prop applies to "type: ghost" Buttons ONLY & will be ignored for all other Button types.

changeLog.title: Added "type" Prop & Deprecated "color" Prop
changeLog.description: Changed naming convention of Button's Prop "color" to "type". New naming convention is more consistent with other component Prop names, conveys the Prop's functionality clearly, & is less ambiguous with the addition of the new "colorScheme" Prop.

changeLog.title: Added Support for Multiple Icon Sizes to Icon-Only Button
changeLog.description: When implementing an Icon-Only Button (using the icon Prop), you can now specify the size of the Icon via the FluidIconConfig object (which affects the overall size of the Button). FluidSize values xxs through lg are supported.

changeLog.title: Icon-Only Button "colorScheme" Support
changeLog.description: Icon-Only Buttons (i.e. Buttons using the icon Prop) now support the colorScheme Prop, which allows the Button's embedded Icon color to be changed to dark or light for increased contrast against a color background.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
FLUID Button Group is used to display contextually related, but mutually exclusive options as discrete buttons in a single row. Similar to Radio Group, only 1 option can be selected at a time, and there is no way to deselect all options once one has been selected. By default, Button Group will automatically select the first non-disabled option in the group unless a selected option is provided.

Button Group is primarily used to toggle between different "views" within a page, but can also be used in forms as a form field.

props.name: debounceChange
props.docs:
Observable used to debounce selected option change. If provided,
changes to the selected option are deferred until the Observable is
executed (i.e. when an option is clicked, the Button Group will emit
the option's value, but won't visually update the selected option
until the Observable executes).

props.name: disabled
props.docs:
Disables the entire Button Group if true. NOTE: individual option(s)
can be disabled via the FluidOption "disabled" property.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the button group in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: labels
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "labels" is now deprecated. Instead, use "options" Prop.
-- Array of string labels to populate the Button Group. Values from
this Prop are now mapped to FluidOption objects in the "options" Prop.

props.name: name
props.docs:
Name used to associate the individual options together as a group.
If Button Group is used as a form element, set to "controlName"
of parent form field.

props.name: optionButtonType
props.docs: Sets the aesthetic style of Button Group's options (see usage examples for details)

props.name: options
props.docs:
Array of FluidOption objects to populate the Button Group.
NOTE: Use this Prop INSTEAD OF deprecated "labels" Prop.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: preventDefault
props.docs:
If true, all options will be unselected by default. If false,
Button Group will automatically select the first non-disabled option
in the "options" array IF no other selected option is defined (i.e.
the "selectedLabel" Prop, the "selectedValue" Prop, or an option
with "selected: true" will override this Prop's functionality).

props.name: selectedLabel
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "selectedLabel" is now deprecated. Instead, use
"selectedValue" Prop. -- The current selected option's "label"
property. Dynamically updated when the selected option changes. If
provided, sets the option with matching "label" property as selected.
If provided label does NOT match any existing FluidOption objects in
the "options" array OR is "undefined", REMOVES the selected option and
DESELECTS all options in the group. NOTE: the selected option can
also be set via an individual option's "selected" property.

props.name: selectedValue
props.docs:
The current selected option's "value" property. Dynamically updated
when the selected option changes. If provided, sets the option with
matching "value" property as selected. If provided value does NOT
match any existing FluidOption objects in the "options" array OR is
"undefined", REMOVES the selected option and DESELECTS all options in
the group. NOTE: the selected option can also be set via an
individual option's "selected" property.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

events.docs: Emits the FluidOption "value" property of an option when it's selected.

examples.name: Tile Buttons: Icons Before Labels (optionButtonType + options)
Tile Buttons: Icons After Labels (optionButtonType + options)

components.contextData:
FLUID Button Group is used to display contextually related, but mutually exclusive options as discrete buttons in a single row. Similar to Radio Group, only 1 option can be selected at a time, and there is no way to deselect all options once one has been selected. By default, Button Group will automatically select the first non-disabled option in the group unless a selected option is provided.

Button Group is primarily used to toggle between different "views" within a page, but can also be used in forms as a form field.

changeLog.title: FLUID Button Group Added
changeLog.description: Fluid Button Group component created.

changeLog.title: Rendering Tests Updated!
changeLog.description: Added render tests for "options" and "theme" @Props.

changeLog.title: Deprecated Button Group "labels" @Prop
changeLog.description: The Button Group "labels" @Prop is now deprecated - use "options" @Prop as go forward. However, all existing implementations that use "labels" @Prop will still function. All strings in the "labels" array will be mapped to the "options" @Prop as FluidOption objects (where each object's "label" & "value" properties have the same value).

changeLog.title: Updated Button Group to Use Internal State
changeLog.description: Refactored Button Group to manage selected option, "selectedValue", & "selectedLabel" via internal derived state. "selectedValue", & "selectedLabel" @Props are now updated dynamically when selected option changes, & can reset the Button Group (i.e. deselect all options) by changing either @Prop value to undefined. Also, Button Group now attempts to retain it's selected value when the "options" @Prop is updated. Previously selected option is only retained if the new "options" array does NOT have a selected option defined AND contains an option with the previous selected value and/or label.

changeLog.title: Updated Button Group Styles & Theme Styles
changeLog.description: Improved usability/accessibility of Button Group styles (i.e. :hover, :focus, & disabled states) & updated theme-specific styles to align more closely to corresponding FLUID Button styles.

changeLog.title: Improved Button Group Accessibility
changeLog.description: Added appropriate "aria" attributes to Button Group architecture & updated color palette to pass WCAG AA standards.

changeLog.title: Major Updates to Button Group Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Refactored all existing Button Group usage examples, added missing examples for remaining @Props, & implemented comprehensive set of examples for `options` @Prop configurations.

changeLog.title: Major Updates to Button Group Unit Tests
changeLog.description: Refactored Button Group's existing render tests, implemented missing render tests, & added complete set of functional tests that cover all major aspects of Button Group.

changeLog.title: Deprecated Button Group "icon" @Prop
changeLog.description: The Button Group "icon" @Prop is now deprecated - use "iconAfter or iconBefore" @Prop as go forward. However, all existing implementations that use "icon" @Prop will still function. icons specified in options array will be displayed as they are using "iconAfter" @Prop.

changeLog.title: Updated Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Updated Usage examples to include the new "iconAfter" @Prop, "iconBefore" @Prop, and "optionButtonType" @Prop

changeLog.title: Added "optionButtonType" @Prop
changeLog.description: Button Group now supports two button styles, "default" and "tile" where buttons will appear as separate cards displayed in a grid

changeLog.title: Refactored Button Groups LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Button Group's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text: FLUID Card is a commonly-used component that groups related content into a single container. Cards should be used to compartmentalize information & create sections within a webpage - multiple Cards are often "stacked" to create a vertical page layout. It is not recommended to use a Card within another Card.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: - Content displayed within the Card body.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: header - Named slot for content/controls displayed within the Card's header. Only available if "cardTitle" Prop provided.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: action-set - Named slot for controls displayed below Card's body content (e.g. "save"/"cancel" buttons).

props.name: actionButtonConfig
props.docs:
When defined, renders an "action button" with the provided configuration
in the Card header. NOTE: "cardTitle" Prop is required for this Prop
to be functional.

props.name: actionIcon
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "actionIcon" is now deprecated. Instead, use either the
"iconAfter" property (to display an Icon AFTER the Button label) or
"icon" property (for an Icon-Only Button without label) of the
"actionButtonConfig" Prop (see usage examples for demo). -- When
defined, renders an "action button" in the Card header with the
provided Icon. If "actionText" Prop is also defined, the config
provided to this Prop will override the button's default "external
link" Icon.

props.name: actionText
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "actionText" is now deprecated. Instead, use the "label"
property of the "actionButtonConfig" Prop. -- When defined, renders
an "action button" in the Card header that displays this Prop's
value as its label. By default, the "action button" will also
display an "external link" Icon next to the label - the Icon can
be customized using the "actionIcon" Prop.

props.name: badgeConfig
props.docs:
When defined, Card will render a FLUID Badge with the provided configuration
in the Card's header directly after the "cardTitle" text. NOTE: "cardTitle"
Prop is required for this Prop to be functional.

props.name: border
props.docs: Whether the Card has an outer border. Overrides theme-specific default.

props.name: cardTitle
props.docs:
When provided, Card will render a header section that displays this Prop's
value as the Card's title. NOTE: if this Prop is omitted, Card will NOT render
a header section, will NOT be collapsible, & will NOT display an action button
or Badge.

props.name: collapsed
props.docs:
Controls whether collapsible Card is currently expanded/collapsed.
This Prop can be used after initial load/render to dynamically expand
or collapse Card. NOTE: "collapsible" Prop MUST be true AND "cardTitle"
Prop must be provided for this Prop to be functional.

props.name: collapsible
props.docs:
When true, Card body will be collapsible. Card can be expanded/
collapsed by clicking the "up/down chevron" button, clicking the
Card title, or changing the "collapsed" Prop value. NOTE: "cardTitle"
Prop is required for this Prop to be functional.

props.name: dropShadow
props.docs: Whether the Card has a drop shadow. Overrides theme-specific default.

props.name: fullHeight
props.docs: When true, Card will expand to be 100% of its parent container's height.

props.name: isNew
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "isNew" is now deprecated. Instead, use the "label"
property of the "badgeConfig" Prop. -- If the card houses something
new, such as a feature, or info, should we render a 'New!' Badge?

props.name: layoutOnly
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "layoutOnly" is now deprecated. FLUID Card should only
be used as a "top-level" content container & should NOT be used to
create subsections within Cards or other containers. Instead, use
FLUID Accordion with "type" Prop set to "section" to create
subsections. This approach improves UX/accessibility, is more
semantically correct, & allows for multiple subsections to be
implemented easily via FLUID Accordion Panel. -- When true, removes
Card's background color, border, & drop shadow, but maintains the
Card layout.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: refreshTooltip
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "refreshTooltip" is now deprecated. Instead, add an
Icon-Only FLUID Button with "refresh" Icon & "popoverConfig"
to Card's "header" slot. -- If "refreshable" Prop is true, adds
an optional Popover to the "refresh button" (i.e. this Prop sets
the Popover's "message" Prop value).

props.name: refreshTooltipPlacement
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "refreshTooltipPlacement" is now deprecated. Popover's
built-in edge detection will prevent it from appearing offscreen,
making this Prop unnecessary. -- If "refreshable: true", sets the
embedded Popover's placement in relation to the "refresh" Icon.

props.name: refreshable
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "refreshable" is now deprecated. Instead, add an
Icon-Only FLUID Button with "refresh" Icon to Card's "header" slot.
-- Indicates that Card has the ability to be refreshed - when true,
Card will render a "refresh button" adjacent to the Card title.

props.name: refreshing
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "refreshing" is now deprecated. Instead,
When true, indicates that the Card is currently refreshing (i.e. if
the calling component is refreshing, this should be true).

props.name: removeContentPadding
props.docs:
When true, Card body & "action-set" slot will NOT have internal
top/bottom/left/right padding.

props.name: removeHeaderBorder
props.docs:
When true, Card will NOT render a border beneath its header section.
NOTE: "cardTitle" Prop is required for this Prop to be functional.

props.name: removeMargin
props.docs: When true, removes Card's default bottom margin.

props.name: removeVerticalContentPadding
props.docs:
When true, Card body & "action-set" slot will NOT have internal
top/bottom padding.

props.name: subtitle
props.docs:
When provided, displays an optional "subtitle" underneath the "cardTitle"
text in Card's header. Subtitle text will be smaller & lighter than
"cardTitle" text, & is meant to provide additional context. NOTE:
"cardTitle" Prop is required for this Prop to be functional.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: titleLabel
props.docs:
When provided, adds an optional label/prefix before the "cardTitle" text
in Card's header & automatically makes the "cardTitle" text bold (see
Card's usage examples for a demo). NOTE: "cardTitle" Prop is required
for this Prop to be functional.

events.docs: Event emitted when "action" button is clicked.
Event emitted when the card is collapsed.
Event emitted when the card is opened.
Event emitted when "collapse" button is clicked.

DEPRECATED: "refreshed" Event is now deprecated (as well as
"refreshable" + related Props). Instead, add an Icon-Only FLUID
Button with "refresh" Icon to Card's "header" slot & listen for
click event there -- Event emitted when "refresh" button is clicked.

slots.docs: Content displayed within the Card body.

slots.name: action-set
slots.docs: Named slot for controls displayed below Card's body content (e.g. "save"/"cancel" buttons).

slots.name: header
slots.docs: Named slot for content/controls displayed within the Card's header. Only available if "cardTitle" Prop provided.

components.contextData: FLUID Card is a commonly-used component that groups related content into a single container. Cards should be used to compartmentalize information & create sections within a webpage - multiple Cards are often "stacked" to create a vertical page layout. It is not recommended to use a Card within another Card.
components.slot: action-set - Named slot for controls displayed below Card's body content (e.g. "save"/"cancel" buttons).

changeLog.title: Card Component Added
changeLog.description: Fluid card component created.

changeLog.title: Adds refreshTooltip prop to card.
changeLog.description: This allows for a tooltip on the refresh icon hover.

changeLog.title: Updates to how card handles refresh.
changeLog.description: FLUID should not be responsible for executing functions attached to actions, as this will take that function outside of the execution context of the calling application. This update changes the refresh action on a FLUID card to emit an event `refreshed` which the calling component can listen for, and update any `refreshing` state (which the card uses to know when to rotate the icon) and executing any action and subsequent update to the card content.

changeLog.title: Adds title label to card
changeLog.description: Adds a new prop `titleLabel` which, if populated, applies a label before the card title (think opportunity header: e.g Opportunity: My Opportunity) and bolds the card title.

changeLog.title: Adds placement for tooltip
changeLog.description: Adds the possibility to define the placement position for the refresh icon tooltip {top/bottom}. By default, if is not used, will be set as top

changeLog.title: Added @Props for Border and Drop Shadow
changeLog.description: Added `border` and `dropShadow` @Props that allow additional customization of Card appearance within each theme. Also set theme defaults for each @Prop consistent with each theme's overall look & feel.

changeLog.title: Updated Card Styles for LM & Corp Themes
changeLog.description: Updated appearance of LM theme Card to be more consistent with overall theme look & feel (Material). Also updated LM Corporate theme Card appearance to be more consistent with LM brand standards.

changeLog.title: Support for Customizable Badge
changeLog.description: Added badgeConfig Prop to Card that allows a fully-customizable Badge to be displayed in Card's header adjacent to its title. Also deprecated old isNew Prop.

changeLog.title: Full-Height Card
changeLog.description: Added fullHeight Prop to Card that allows it to expand to fill 100% of its parent container's height.

changeLog.title: Built-In Action Button Upgrade
changeLog.description: Added actionButtonConfig Prop to Card that allows full customization of its optional header action button. Previously, Card's action button was only partially customizable via the actionText & actionIcon Props, which have now been deprecated.

changeLog.title: Updated Card's Corp & Portal Themes
changeLog.description: Updated Card's Corp & Portal theme aesthetics to be more consistent with each theme's overall look & feel. Also moved Corp theme "collapse toggle" button from left to right side of header (more consistent with brand standards).

changeLog.title: Improvements to Card's Responsiveness & Accessibility
changeLog.description: FLUID Card now has better support for table/mobile viewport sizes. It also has better native screen reader support & improved color contrast accessibility.

changeLog.title: Usage Examples Overhaul
changeLog.description: FLUID Card's usage examples have been completely refactored to include demos of all major Props, features, & common configurations.

changeLog.title: Added "removeMargin" Prop
changeLog.description: Added removeMargin Prop to Card that allows its default bottom margin to be removed.

changeLog.title: Aesthetic Improvements to LM Theme
changeLog.description: Updated Card's LM theme aesthetics to be more consistent with the theme's overall look & feel (e.g. rounded edges on "collapse toggle", narrower left/right margins, regular title font weight, etc).

changeLog.title: Improvements to "fullHeight" Card
changeLog.description: Updated Card's fullHeight architecture & styles to allow vertical alignment of flexbox-based slotted children.

changeLog.title: Refactored Cards LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Cards stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation
changeLog.description: Instrumented FLUID Card for observability using the FLUID Observability Provider pattern. Tracks user interactions on collapse toggle, card title toggle, action button, and refresh button (deprecated).

The Carousel is a slideshow for cycling through a series of content.
It works with a series of images, text, or custom markup. It also includes support for previous/next controls and indicators.
Please be aware that nested Carousels are not supported, and Carousels are generally not compliant with accessibility standards.

active/visible slide (if "id" exists on the slotted slide child).

props.name: controlsOnHover

When true, navigation controls will only be visible on Carousel
:hover or :focus-within.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
Optional identifier for observability tracking. Defaults to the
host element's id or a generated unique id.

props.name: interval
props.docs: The interval in milliseconds for the carousel to automatically advance to the next slide.

If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the

The Carousel is a slideshow for cycling through a series of content.
It works with a series of images, text, or custom markup. It also includes support for previous/next controls and indicators.
Please be aware that nested Carousels are not supported, and Carousels are generally not compliant with accessibility standards.

changeLog.title: FLUID Carousel Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Carousel component created.

changeLog.title: Carousel Navigation Accessibility Improvements
changeLog.description: Fixed usability/accessibility issues in Carousel's slide navigation controls. Refactored "next/previous slide" controls to use FLUID Button, which adds :hover/:focus states & support for keyboard navigation. Updated the "next/previous slide" controls' embedded Icon sizes for better visibility. Also improved the color contrast between the inactive/active states of Carousel's "slide indicators" for the Corp (Default) & Portal themes.

changeLog.title: Accessibility Improvements
changeLog.description: Carousel's "slide indicator" navigation controls are now keyboard-accessible, & their click target sizes have been increased 6x. The "slide indicators" have also been upgraded with :hover & :focus-visible states. Carousel's previous/next buttons now have larger click target sizes as well.

changeLog.title: Refactored Carousel LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Carousel's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation
changeLog.description: Instrumented FLUID Carousel for observability using the FLUID Observability Provider pattern. Tracks user interactions on slide indicator clicks, previous button, and next button.

docsTags.text: FLUID Chat renders an open-ended chat interface supporting configurable message formats, avatars, timestamps, and extensible message controls. Messages can be received from any external source via the public `addMessage()` method.

props.name: defaultIncomingMessageFormat
props.docs:
Default display format for incoming (responder) messages that do not
specify their own "format". Individual messages can override this via
"ChatMessage.format", allowing mixed formats within one conversation.
- "default": standard chat bubble
- "markdown": renders basic Markdown formatting
- "html": renders sanitized HTML content

props.name: disableCopyAction
props.docs:
When true, removes default "copy" action from both the incoming
& outgoing message actions.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When provided, the "identifier" string will be prepended to
"data-test-id" attributes on Chat's inner architecture to help
facilitate testing.

props.name: incomingMessageActions
props.docs:
Custom message actions rendered for each incoming (responder)
message in addition to the default "copy" action. NOTE: to
remove the default "copy" action, set "disableCopyAction" to true.

props.name: messages
props.docs:
Initial message history to populate the chat on first render.
To add new messages after initialization, use the `addMessage()`
public method.

props.name: outgoingMessageActions
props.docs:
Custom message actions rendered for each outgoing (user)
message in addition to the default "copy" action. NOTE: to
remove the default "copy" action, set "disableCopyAction" to true.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: responderProfile
props.docs:
Profile configuration for the incoming message sender (responder).
Controls name display and avatar rendering for incoming messages.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: timestampThreshold
props.docs:
Number of minutes between messages before a timestamp divider
is displayed. Set to 0 to show timestamps on every message.

props.name: userProfile
props.docs:
Profile configuration for the outgoing message sender (current user).
Controls name display and avatar rendering for outgoing messages.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.docs:
Adds a new message to the chat & resets the "responderProfile"
status to "IDLE". This is the primary mechanism for incoming
message delivery from any external source (API, WebSocket, SSE, etc.).
Emits the "messageReceived" event with the added message.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: message - the incoming ChatMessage to add

methods.name: getChatHistory
methods.docs: Returns all incoming/outgoing messages from the current Chat.

methods.name: setResponderStatus
methods.docs:
Sets the activity/connection status of the responder (incoming
participant). Call this while awaiting a response (e.g. "BUSY"),
then call "addMessage()" (which resets the status to "IDLE") once
the response arrives. NOTE: setting a status of "BUSY" displays a
"typing indicator" for the responder.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: status - the "ChatProfileStatus" to apply to the responder

events.docs:
Emitted when a message's action button is clicked. Event's payload
contains an object including the "actionKey", as well as the
"ChatMessage" object associated with the action button that was clicked.

Emitted when an incoming (responder) message is received via the
public `addMessage()` method. Event detail contains the received
"ChatMessage" object.

Emitted when the user sends a new message via the text input.
Event detail contains the new "ChatMessage" object.

props.name: code
props.docs: The code snippet you want to highlight, as a string

props.name: collapseByDefault
props.docs:
If true, all collapsible regions will be collapsed by default.
Individual regions can be overridden using the collapseOverrides property.

props.name: collapseOverrides
props.docs:
Specify which regions should have their collapse state customized.
This overrides the collapseByDefault setting for specific regions.

Regions are assigned sequential IDs starting from 0 (e.g. '0', '1', '2')
in the order their opening braces/blocks appear in the code.

Accepts an array of region IDs to toggle, or an object mapping IDs to explicit states:
- Array: `['0', '2']` — toggles the default for those regions
- Object: `{ '0': false, '2': true }` — sets explicit collapsed state

props.name: collapsible
props.docs:
Enable collapsible sections using special markers in code.

Supported language types:
- Brace-based languages: javascript, js, typescript, ts, jsx, java, csharp, cs, c#
- JSON: json (supports collapsing both objects { } and arrays [ ])
- Markup languages: xml, html (supports self-closing tags and same-line open/close)
- Database: sql (BEGIN/END, CASE/ENDCASE, IF/ENDIF, WHILE/ENDWHILE, FOR/ENDFOR, LOOP/ENDLOOP)
- Shell scripting: bash, shell, sh (if/fi, while/done, for/done, case/esac, function blocks)
- PowerShell: powershell (brace-based and keyword-based blocks)

Note: Languages not explicitly listed will default to brace-based parsing ({ and }).

props.name: copyMessage
props.docs: Message to display in the fluid-alert when the contents have been copied to the clipboard.

props.name: copyable
props.docs: If false the copy button will not be displayed

props.name: inlineType
props.docs:
If you want to add a custom class name (CSS).
This will be only added when the noContainer property is set to true

props.name: muted
props.docs: If true the code will be in muted style

props.name: noContainer
props.docs: If true will render without the default container (copy functionality)

props.name: type
props.docs:
The name of the language definition.
Check for the full list of supported languages here: https://prismjs.com/#supported-languages
imported languages: javascript, java, ini, jsx, yaml, python, json, typescript, bash, regex, powershell, docker, git, c#, sql

docsTags.text: FLUID Combo Box combines the functionality of a FLUID Select (i.e. dropdown menu) with the convenience of a FLUID Input Field, enabling users to dynamically filter options displayed in the dropdown menu while typing. Combo Box can be used as a standalone component, or within FLUID Form / Form Array.

props.name: allowCancel
props.docs:
If true, displays a "clear" button that resets the form field when
clicked. At least one option must be selected for button to be visible.
Button is NOT displayed when field has "required" validation.

props.name: allowCustomInput
props.docs:
When true, Combo Box will accept arbitrary input not included
in the array of available options.

props.name: autoFocus
props.docs:
If true, this field will automatically have focus on page load.
Note: only one form field should have "autoFocus" set to true
on a page. Multiple fields with "autoFocus: true" can/will cause
unexpected behavior.

props.name: config
props.docs: Allows Combo Box Props to be set via a single configuration object.

props.name: controlName
props.docs:
A unique name for the field (usually the dataKey for any form using
the input element).

props.name: customGroupSort
props.docs: Consuming app provides a sort order

props.name: disableAutoHighlight
props.docs:
When true, default auto-highlight functionality is disabled
(i.e. the first option in the dropdown list will NOT automatically
be highlighted for selection when menu opens & while typing).

props.name: disabled
props.docs: If true, Combo Box's <input> & dropdown menu will be disabled.

props.name: dynamicMenuWidth
props.docs:
When true, Combo Box's dropdown menu will dynamically expand its
width based on the text content of its options (i.e. the menu's
width is allowed to extend past the edge of the component). When
false, the dropdown menu's width will match the overall width of
the component, regardless of the size of its options. NOTE: this
Prop is automatically enabled when Combo Box is used within FLUID Table.

props.name: emitSingleValue
props.docs:
When true, single-select Combo Box's "valueChange" Event &
"getValue()" Method will emit/return a single string value
instead of an array ("value" Prop is not affected). NOTE:
this Prop cannot be used with multi-select Combo Box.

props.name: emptyListMessage
props.docs:
Message displayed when none of Combo Box's options match the
current user input (i.e. all options have been "filtered out"
of the dropdown menu).

props.name: fixedPositionMenu
props.docs:
Changes the dropdown menu's CSS "position" property from "absolute"
(default) to "fixed". NOTE: if the dropdown menu isn't displaying
correctly, try setting this Prop's value to "true".

props.name: fluidTranslate
props.docs: Internationalisation

props.name: helpText
props.docs:
If provided, Combo Box's Form Label will render a "helptext" icon
with attached Popover. To render a basic Popover with default
Prop values, simply provide the Popover's message as a string
value to this Prop. To render a Popover with customized Props,
provide a FluidPopoverConfig object to this Prop with the "message"
property set. For more information, please see Popover's API
documentation.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the combo box in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: initialValue
props.docs:
Values of the option(s) that should be selected by default. If a
string is provided, it will be converted into a single-item array.
NOTE: options can also be selected by default using the "selected"
property of the FluidOption objects provided to the "options" Prop.

props.name: inlineField
props.docs: Removes the form field's default bottom margin.

props.name: label
props.docs:
If provided, a FLUID Form Label will be rendered above the Combo Box
with the specified string.

props.name: labelTextOverflow
props.docs:
Sets the Form Label's text overflow behavior. By default, overflowing
label text will be truncated with ellipsis.

props.name: maskingConfig
props.docs:
If provided, applies masking function to selected "custom input"
option(s) when Combo Box loses :focus after specified delay. Masking is
applied visually to either the value displayed within the <input>
(single-select) or the text displayed within selected "custom input"
chips (multi-select). Masking is ONLY applied to "custom input", so
"allowCustomInput" Prop MUST be true.

props.name: matchFrom
props.docs:
Determines how Combo Box filters its dropdown menu options as the
user types. By default, an option is visible if the user's input
matches characters ANYWHERE in its label or group label (if "group"
property exists). When this Prop is set to "start", the user's
input must match the BEGINNING of an option's label or group for
it to be visible. For example, if a user enters "wa" into Combo Box,
an option with "Star Wars" label would be VISIBLE when "matchFrom: any",
but would be HIDDEN when "matchFrom: start". NOTE: it is NOT
recommended to use "matchFrom: start" with grouped options.

props.name: multiSelect
props.docs:
When true, Combo Box will allow multiple options to be selected
simultaneously.

props.name: optionLookup
props.docs:
When provided, Combo Box will dynamically populate its options
from a remote source via asynchronous requests as the user
types. Async Combo Box can also be configured to have a list of
"default options" (i.e. array of FluidOptions provided to the
"defaultOptions" property) that are always displayed in the
dropdown menu (unless user input filters them out). NOTE: do NOT
use the "options" Prop when using the "optionLookup" Prop.

props.name: options
props.docs:
Options displayed in the dropdown menu that users can choose from.
NOTE: do NOT use this Prop when using "optionLookup" Prop -
to display a list of static options in addition to the options
populated via async requests, use "optionLookup.defaultOptions".

props.name: outputFormat
props.docs:
When provided, Combo Box will apply a custom formatting function to
the value emitted in its "valueChange" Event & the value returned
from the "getValue()" Method ("value" Prop is not affected).

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: placeholder
props.docs: Optional placeholder text to display within Combo Box's <input>.

props.name: readonly
props.docs:
If true, Combo Box's <input> will be "readonly" & dropdown menu
will be disabled.

props.name: readonlyTextOverflow
props.docs:
Sets the overflow behavior of "readonly" Combo Box's selected option
text (by default, "readonly" Combo Box will truncate its selected
option text with ellipsis if it overflows the width of the component).
NOTE: "readonly" Prop MUST be true for this Prop to have an effect.

props.name: sortOrder
props.docs:
Sorts options in ascending/descending order in the dropdown menu.
By default, Combo Box displays options in the same order as they're
provided to the "options" Prop.

props.name: supplementaryLabel
props.docs:
If provided, a supplementary muted label will be displayed after the
primary Form Label.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: validation
props.docs:
An array of field validation options. Combo Box currently supports
"required" & "custom" field validation. **NOTE: Combo Box's
"form element state" stores selected option values in an array. When
using "custom" validation, the "value" parameter of "validatorFn" will
be an array (NOT a string).**

props.name: value
props.docs:
Combo Box's current value. This Prop is dynamically updated to
reflect the form element's current state - it can be used as a
"synchronous" alternative to the public async "getValue()" method.
When provided on first load, this Prop will set Combo Box's default
selected option. After the component has been rendered, changes to
this Prop will update the form field's value (similar to "setValue()"
method). NOTE: "initialValue" will override this Prop on first load
if both Props are provided.

props.name: wrapValidation
props.docs: If true, validation error messages wrap instead of being truncated with ellipsis.

components.contextData: FLUID Combo Box combines the functionality of a FLUID Select (i.e. dropdown menu) with the convenience of a FLUID Input Field, enabling users to dynamically filter options displayed in the dropdown menu while typing. Combo Box can be used as a standalone component, or within FLUID Form / Form Array.

changeLog.title: Combo Box Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Combo Box component created.

changeLog.title: Combo Box "Custom Input" Functionality Updated
changeLog.description: Updated Combo Box to display the "custom input option" (i.e. "Select ...") for custom/arbitrary input as soon as first character typed. Previously, custom input option was hidden until all other options within the dropdown menu had been filtered out.

changeLog.title: Added Support for "maskingConfig" to Combo Box
changeLog.description: Added "maskingConfig" @Prop to Combo Box. If provided, applies masking function to selected "custom input" option(s) when Combo Box loses :focus after specified delay. Masking is applied visually to either the value displayed within the component's input (single-select) or the text displayed within selected "custom input" chips (multi-select). Masking is ONLY applied to "custom input", so "allowCustomInput" @Prop MUST be true.

changeLog.title: Added support for option grouping
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to provide a grouping key via the group key of FluidOption, which automatically groups the available options into the option groups.

changeLog.title: Added support asynchronous option lookup.
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to configure a lookup function, which can be called when user input events are fired, collate options to populate the combo-box, before updating the available options using a function expression passed to your function as a parameter. This allows you to do whatever you need to in order to get your options, including making HTTP calls, running your own filters, and whatever else you need to.

changeLog.title: Add autoFocus prop
changeLog.description: autoFocus allows this field to automatically be focused on page load without user action.

changeLog.title: Improved Disabled State Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Combo Box disabled state styles for improved readability/legibility.

changeLog.title: Auto-Highlight Support (New Default Behavior)
changeLog.description: Combo Box now supports "auto-highlight" functionality by default - the first option in the dropdown menu will now be automatically highlighted/focused for selection when you open the menu & while typing (just press "Enter" to select!). This largely eliminates the need to manually navigate through options in the dropdown menu using the arrow keys. If needed, auto-highlight can be disabled by setting disableAutoHighlight: true.

changeLog.title: Updated Validation Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Combo Box's validation error text so that it doesn't cause layout shift when displayed. Also added "fade in" visual effect to error text.

changeLog.title: Added "emptyListMessage" property
changeLog.description: Added "emptyListMessage" (default="No Results") property to Combo Box to allow a custom message to be shown when the Combo Box has no options to display.

changeLog.title: Added "value" Prop
changeLog.description: Added value Prop to FLUID Combo Box that allows the form field's selected option value to be set & accessed. The Prop is dynamically updated to reflect the form field's current state, so it can be used as a "synchronous" alternative to the public async getValue() method. If provided on first load, the value Prop sets the default selected option. After the component is loaded, changes to the value Prop will update the form field's value (similar to the setValue() method). NOTE: the initialValue Prop will override the value Prop on first load if both Props are provided.

changeLog.title: Refactored "optionLookup" Functionality
changeLog.description: Refactored Async Combo Box's optionLookup functionality so that it's user experience is more similar to "standard" Combo Box functionality. Async Combo Box now displays a "Begin Typing to Search" message in the dropdown menu when the user first interacts with the component, then displays a "Searching..." message while the "async lookup" is running. Async Combo Box is now also fully compatible with the new value Prop.

changeLog.title: Async Lookup: Retain Selections by Default
changeLog.description: Async Combo Box (i.e. optionLookup is provided) now "retains selections" by default (UNLESS the optionLookup.retainSelections property is explicitly set to false). This update coincides with the recent user experience improvements to Async Combo Box & will not negatively impact existing instances of the component.

changeLog.title: Support for Dynamic Dropdown Menu Width
changeLog.description: Combo Box's new dynamicMenuWidth Prop dynamically expands the dropdown menu's width based on the text content of its options. When true, the Prop also allows the menu's width to extend past the edge of the component. This is especially useful when Combo Box is implemented within a small container (e.g. a FLUID Table cell), which would typically result in a "compressed" dropdown menu - instead, dynamicMenuWidth: true allows the dropdown menu to extend up to 2x-3x the width of Combo Box & prevents options' text from wrapping to multiple lines.

changeLog.title: Dropdown Menu Edge Detection & Overflow Prevention
changeLog.description: Combo Box's dropdown menu now uses PopperJS for positioning & overflow prevention. The dropdown menu's new edge detection functionality prevents it from overflowing the viewport both horizontally & vertically by "flipping" it above/left of the embedded input.

changeLog.title: Support for Fixed-Position Dropdown Menu
changeLog.description: Combo Box now allows its dropdown menu's CSS position to be configured via the fixedPositionMenu Prop. Previously, the component's dropdown menu only supported absolute positioning, which could result in the menu being truncated when implemented within a parent container with CSS overflow styles applied (i.e. styles for vertical or horizontal scrolling). Now, this issue can be avoided by simply configuring fixedPositionMenu: true.

changeLog.title: Async Lookup: "defaultOptions" Support
changeLog.description: Async Combo Box now accepts static "default options" via optionLookup.defaultOptions that populate the dropdown menu without needing to execute an async lookup. When provided, default options will be displayed in Async Combo Box's dropdown menu BEFORE the first lookup is executed, & allow for the initialValue or value Props to set the default selected option without triggering a lookup (when the value exists in defaultOptions). After a lookup is triggered, the default options will be displayed inline with the dynamically generated options returned from the lookup unless user input filters them out. Default options can also be used to populate Async Combo Box with options that do not exist in the optionLookup.lookup function's remote source.

changeLog.title: Combo Box Keyboard Navigation
changeLog.description: Combo Box Keyboard navigation now skips disabled options and goes to the next available option.

changeLog.title: Combo Box Custom Group Sort
changeLog.description: Created a customGroupSort prop that allows consuming apps to define their own sorting logic for the groups in the combo box.

changeLog.title: Adds ability to configure combo-box to return a single value.
changeLog.description: Added the ability to tell Combo Box to return a single value, rather than an array, when multiSelect is false. Add the emitSingleValue property to enable the new behaviour.

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update allows the outputFormat feature, previously only available in the context of a form, to be used in standalone mode too.

changeLog.title: Readonly Text Wrap
changeLog.description: Combo Box now supports configuring the text overflow behavior of its selected option text when in readonly mode. Setting the new readonlyTextOverflow Prop to wrap allows Combo Box's selected option text to wrap to multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis - particularly useful for Combo Boxes with long option labels.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation
changeLog.description: Instrumented FLUID Combo Box for observability using the FLUID Observability Provider pattern. Tracks user interactions for click, focus, blur, and keydown.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
FLUID Container is exactly what it sounds like - a multipurpose container for in-page content. Although it may sound basic, FLUID Container has many powerful features that some would consider to be the "Swiss Army Knife" of FLUID components.

FLUID Container can be used to set padding, margin, horizontal/vertical scrolling, etc. anywhere it's needed. It's extremely flexible size-based Props accept values for pre-made "t-shirt sizes" (FluidSize), percentages (decimal numbers), pixel values (integers), or custom CSS (strings). It also has built-in named Slots for "fixed" content (i.e. "sticky" or "absolutely-positioned" content) on each side of the Container that will "anchor" content in place, even when scrolling. Use FLUID Container within FLUID Grid to tackle just about any content layout imaginable.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: fixed-content-top - Named slot for fixed/sticky content. Spans 100% width across the top of the Container

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: fixed-content-bottom - Named slot for fixed/sticky content. Spans 100% width across the bottom of the Container

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: fixed-content-left - Named slot for fixed/sticky content. Spans top to bottom on the left side of the Container

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: fixed-content-right - Named slot for fixed/sticky content. Spans top to bottom on the right side of the Container

props.name: backgroundColor
props.docs: Sets the background color of the Container.

props.name: height
props.docs:
The height of the Container. FluidSize values equate to preset
percentages, decimal numbers between 0 and 1 equate to percent
values, whole numbers greater than 1 equate to pixel values, and
strings are outputted directly as inline style values (NOTE: strings
should contain valid CSS units - i.e. 'px', '%', 'em', 'vh', etc.).

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the container in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: inPageNavConfig
props.docs:
When provided, In-Page Navigation (aka "table of contents") will be
rendered on either the right or left side of the Container.

props.name: inline
props.docs:
If true, Container will render as inline-block element. If false,
Container will render as block element.

props.name: margin
props.docs:
Margin applied to Container element. FluidSize values equate to preset
pixel values, decimal numbers between -1 and 1 equate to negative/positive
percent values, whole numbers less than -1 or greater than 1 equate to
negative/positive pixel values, and strings are outputted directly as inline style
values (NOTE: strings should contain valid CSS units - i.e. 'px', '%', 'em', 'vw',
etc.). Strings can contain CSS shorthand to set margin on individual sides of the
Container (e.g. '1em 2em 3em 4em' would set 1em margin on Container top, 2em margin on
Container right, 3em margin on Container bottom, & 4em margin on Container left).

props.name: maxHeight
props.docs:
The maximum height of the Container. FluidSize values equate to preset
percentages, decimal numbers between 0 and 1 equate to percent
values, whole numbers greater than 1 equate to pixel values, and
strings are outputted directly as inline style values (NOTE: strings
should contain valid CSS units - i.e. 'px', '%', 'em', 'vh', etc.).

props.name: maxWidth
props.docs:
The maximum width of the Container. FluidSize values equate to preset
percentages, decimal numbers between 0 and 1 equate to percent
values, whole numbers greater than 1 equate to pixel values, and
strings are outputted directly as inline style values (NOTE: strings
should contain valid CSS units - i.e. 'px', '%', 'em', 'vw', etc.).

props.name: minHeight
props.docs:
The minimum height of the Container. FluidSize values equate to preset
percentages, decimal numbers between 0 and 1 equate to percent
values, whole numbers greater than 1 equate to pixel values, and
strings are outputted directly as inline style values (NOTE: strings
should contain valid CSS units - i.e. 'px', '%', 'em', 'vh', etc.).

props.name: minWidth
props.docs:
The minimum width of the Container. FluidSize values equate to preset
percentages, decimal numbers between 0 and 1 equate to percent
values, whole numbers greater than 1 equate to pixel values, and
strings are outputted directly as inline style values (NOTE: strings
should contain valid CSS units - i.e. 'px', '%', 'em', 'vw', etc.).

props.name: overflowX
props.docs:
How the Container should handle horizontal content overflow. NOTE: setting
this Prop to 'hidden' or 'scroll' WILL cause absolutely-position elements
(e.g. FLUID Popover, FLUID Dropdown Button, etc.) that overflow the container
bounds to be truncated.

props.name: overflowY
props.docs:
How the Container should handle vertical content overflow. NOTE: setting
this Prop to 'hidden' or 'scroll' WILL cause absolutely-position elements
(e.g. FLUID Popover, FLUID Dropdown Button, etc.) that overflow the container
bounds to be truncated.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: padding
props.docs:
Padding applied to the body of the Container. FluidSize values equate
to preset pixel values, decimal numbers between 0 and 1 equate to percent
values, whole numbers greater than 1 equate to pixel values, and
strings are outputted directly as inline style values (NOTE: strings
should contain valid CSS units - i.e. 'px', '%', 'em', 'vw', etc.). Strings
can contain CSS shorthand to set padding on individual sides of the Container
(e.g. '1em 2em 3em 4em' would set 1em padding on Container top, 2em padding on
Container right, 3em padding on Container bottom, & 4em padding on Container left).

props.name: scrollShadow
props.docs:
When true, shows gradient shadows at the top and/or bottom of the container
to indicate that content can be scrolled in that direction. Only applicable
when overflowY is set to 'scroll' and content overflows the container height.

props.name: textAlign
props.docs:
Alignment of text & content within the Container. This applies to text elements
(i.e. 'p', 'span', 'fluid-text', etc.), inline elements, & inline-block elements.

props.name: theme
props.docs: Theme settings the component should use.

props.name: width
props.docs:
The width of the Container. FluidSize values equate to preset
percentages, decimal numbers between 0 and 1 equate to percent
values, whole numbers greater than 1 equate to pixel values, and
strings are outputted directly as inline style values (NOTE: strings
should contain valid CSS units - i.e. 'px', '%', 'em', 'vw', etc.).
