components.contextData:
FLUID Container is exactly what it sounds like - a multipurpose container for in-page content. Although it may sound basic, FLUID Container has many powerful features that some would consider to be the "Swiss Army Knife" of FLUID components.

FLUID Container can be used to set padding, margin, horizontal/vertical scrolling, etc. anywhere it's needed. It's extremely flexible size-based Props accept values for pre-made "t-shirt sizes" (FluidSize), percentages (decimal numbers), pixel values (integers), or custom CSS (strings). It also has built-in named Slots for "fixed" content (i.e. "sticky" or "absolutely-positioned" content) on each side of the Container that will "anchor" content in place, even when scrolling. Use FLUID Container within FLUID Grid to tackle just about any content layout imaginable.
components.slot: fixed-content-right - Named slot for fixed/sticky content. Spans top to bottom on the right side of the Container

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
FLUID Context Menu is a modular dropdown menu that is attached to a "trigger" element such as an Icon or Button. Context Menu consists of individual "menu sections" that can contain hyperlinks, FLUID Toggles, or a FLUID Toggle Group. For ultimate customization, menu sections can also be configured to accept slotted content.

Context Menu should be used for contextual options, actions, or controls that relate to nearby content. For example, FLUID Table uses Context Menu for its column filter menus.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: - Default slot for "trigger" element (NOTE: if "trigger" element is a Button, set "asWrapper" Prop to true)

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: CUSTOM_SLOT_NAME - Custom named slot generated from "slotName" property (FluidContextMenuSection)

props.name: absolutePosition
props.docs:
Changes the dropdown menu's CSS "position" property from "fixed"
(default) to "absolute". NOTE: if the dropdown menu isn't displaying
correctly, try setting this Prop's value to "true".

props.name: asWrapper
props.docs:
Indicates that Context Menu "trigger" slot contains a clickable
/ focusable element (e.g. FLUID Button). Prevents "trigger" slot
wrapper from receiving "double :focus" via keyboard navigation.
NOTE: if using FLUID Button for "trigger", make sure to set Prop
"removeMargin" to true.

props.name: block
props.docs:
When true, changes Context Menu's layout from "inline-block"
to "block" (i.e. full-width) & changes the dropdown menu's
edge-detection behavior to be consistent with FLUID Combo Box's
dropdown menu. Useful when Context Menu is used with a "trigger"
element that should span the full width of its parent container
(e.g. FLUID Input Field).

props.name: closeLabel
props.docs: The label to use for the close button

props.name: disableFocusTransfer
props.docs:
When true, prevents Context Menu from transferring focus to the
dropdown menu when opened. This is useful when the "trigger"
element can receive user input (e.g. Input Field) & needs to
maintain focus after the menu is opened.

props.name: disabled
props.docs: If true, menu will be disabled & "trigger" element will be inert.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the context menu in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: ignoreTrigger
props.docs:
When true, Context Menu can only be opened programmatically
(i.e. via "toggleMenu()" method) & all user interactions with the
"trigger" element that would normally open the menu (e.g. click, hover,
etc.) are ignored.

props.name: menuAlignment
props.docs:
Sets dropdown menu alignment with the "trigger" element (i.e. "left"
will align the left edge of the dropdown menu with left edge of the
"trigger" element).

props.name: menuId
props.docs: Unique "id" attribute for the dropdown menu container.

props.name: menuSectionStyle
props.docs:
Determines how menu sections are displayed within the dropdown menu.
"stacked" causes menu sections to cascade vertically (i.e. column
layout). "inline" displays menu sections side-by-side horizontally
(i.e. row layout).

props.name: menuSections
props.docs:
Array of FluidContextMenuSection objects that populate the Context
Menu.

props.name: openOnHover
props.docs:
When true, hovering over the "trigger" element will open the menu
and moving the mouse out of the component's bounds will close it.
NOTE: this Prop DISABLES click events on the "trigger" element (i.e.
clicking the trigger will NOT open/close the menu), but does NOT
affect keyboard events (i.e. "enter" or "space" WILL open the menu).

props.name: outsideClickClose
props.docs:
If Context Menu contains Toggles, enables "click outside to close"
functionality & prevents default "close" button from rendering when

components.contextData:
FLUID Context Menu is a modular dropdown menu that is attached to a "trigger" element such as an Icon or Button. Context Menu consists of individual "menu sections" that can contain hyperlinks, FLUID Toggles, or a FLUID Toggle Group. For ultimate customization, menu sections can also be configured to accept slotted content.

Context Menu should be used for contextual options, actions, or controls that relate to nearby content. For example, FLUID Table uses Context Menu for its column filter menus.
components.slot: CUSTOM_SLOT_NAME - Custom named slot generated from "slotName" property (FluidContextMenuSection)

changeLog.title: Context Menu component created
changeLog.description: Standalone context menu component. Used primarily in Table for now, but allows custom trigger as slot, so can refactor dropdown button to use it at some stage.

changeLog.title: Added "close" button when menu contains toggles
changeLog.description: If Context Menu contains toggles, prevent menu close on outside click & render dedicated "close" button under menu sections.

changeLog.title: Updated Context Menu tests
changeLog.description: Added unique ID attributes to menu & updated tests.

changeLog.title: Added "disabled" Prop
changeLog.description: Added the ability to disable the Context Menu from opening via the "disabled" Prop.

changeLog.title: Removed Tippy.js & implemented edge detection
changeLog.description: Removed Tippy.js (controlled menu being hidden/shown) and implemented CSS fading animations. Added edge detection to prevent menu from appearing offscreen. Added ability to specify whether Context Menu can be closed on outside click & ability to specify the alignment of the menu in relation to the trigger element (i.e. left/right).

changeLog.title: Added dynamic named Slots
changeLog.description: Added FluidContextMenuItemType type "SLOT" and FluidContextMenuSection property "slotName" that can generate unlimited named Slots as menu sections. These "dynamic Slot" menu sections can be mixed in with link / toggle sections for full customization Context Menu content.

changeLog.title: Added FLUID Icon support to links
changeLog.description: Implemented render function for adding FLUID Icons before / after link text.

changeLog.title: Swapped standard checkboxes for FLUID Toggles
changeLog.description: Implemented FLUID Toggle component to populate menu toggle sections. Added support for any defined FluidToggleType: checkbox, flag, link, switch, custom, etc.

changeLog.title: Updated toggleMenu() method to be public
changeLog.description: Publicly exposed toggleMenu() method so that Context Menu can be opened/closed externally.

changeLog.title: Added theme support to Context Menu
changeLog.description: Added FluidThemeInterface support to Context Menu & added appropriate styles for each theme. Added theme tokens definition for each theme as well.

changeLog.title: Keyboard navigation support & other accessibility updates
changeLog.description: Swapped <div> trigger wrapper for <button> so that trigger can receive :focus. Increased clickable area of trigger elements that can't natively receive focus (i.e. FLUID Icon). Added keyboard navigation support to links. Updated links / toggles to be block elements so that entire "row" is clickable. Fixed missing pointer cursor states for links / toggles. Added appropriate `aria-` attributes for accessibility.

changeLog.title: Updated tests for new architecture & styles
changeLog.description: Rewrote tests to expect new architecture / styles & added several new render tests.

changeLog.title: Added Support for Toggle Group to Context Menu
changeLog.description: Added ability to implement Toggle Group within Context Menu using FluidContextMenuItemType "TOGGLE_GROUP". Toggle Group allows for all Toggles within the group to be checked/unchecked simultaneously using the "Toggle All" checkbox.

changeLog.title: Improved Dropdown Menu Edge Detection & Overflow Prevention
changeLog.description: Refactored Context Menu to use PopperJS for dropdown menu positioning & edge detection. Menu now uses "position: fixed;" to display above sibling/parent elements, which mitigates previous truncation issues caused by parent containers with "overflow" settings. Context Menu also has improved edge detection functionality that prevents the dropdown menu from overflowing the viewport both horizontally & vertically.

changeLog.title: Added Ability to Set "sectionHeight" for ALL Menu Sections
changeLog.description: Context Menu now supports setting "sectionHeight" for ANY FluidContextMenuSection in the dropdown menu (previously, only Toggle Group sections supported "sectionHeight").

changeLog.title: "Escape" Key Closes Dropdown Menu
changeLog.description: Context Menu now supports closing the dropdown menu via the "escape" key.

changeLog.title: Adds support for `openOnHover`
changeLog.description: Added a new prop "openOnHover" - when true, causes the dropdown menu to open when the trigger is hovered over & close when the mouse leaves the component's bounds. NOTE: click events on the "trigger" element are disabled when "openOnHover" is true to prevent accidental menu closes.

changeLog.title: Improved "Close" Button Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Context Menu's "close" button (shown when menuSectionStyle: inline) color fill to meet WCAG AA contrast spec.

changeLog.title: Added Support for Slotted Icons in Links
changeLog.description: Context Menu now supports custom slotted icons in links using FluidContextMenuLink's iconBefore.slotName or iconAfter.slotName. See Context Menu's usage examples in the FLUID Docs Site for demo.

changeLog.title: Added Support for i18n
changeLog.description: Context Menu now supports internationalization

FLUID Currency Field is a FLUID Form Element designed for entering and displaying currency values with proper formatting, validation, and internationalization support. It ensures accurate input of monetary amounts, handles various currencies and locales, and provides options for shorthand entry, rounding, and custom output formatting.

Use Currency Field when users need to input or view currency values in a consistent format.

NOTE: only one form field should have "autoFocus" set to true

props.docs:
A unique name for the field (usually the "dataPath" for any form
using the input element).

props.name: currencyLocale
props.docs:
If the chosen currency isn't natively supported by FLUID, provide the
locale to use in the formatting.

props.name: currencySymbol
props.docs:
Specifies the currency symbol & formatting applied to the value
displayed in the Currency Field's embedded <input> (does NOT
affect formatting of Currency Field's value).

props.docs: Disables Currency Field when true.

are displayed on desktop devices.

props.docs:
When provided, Currency Field's Form Label will display an "info"
Icon with attached Popover. To render a basic Popover with default
Prop values, simply provide the Popover's message as a string
value to this Prop. To render a Popover with customized Props,
provide a FluidPopoverConfig object to this Prop with the "message"
property set. For more information, please see Popover's API
documentation.

props.name: htmlAutocomplete
props.docs:
Sets the HTML "autocomplete" attribute on the Currency Field's embedded
<input>. Accepts 'on', 'off', or a space-separated <token-list> that
describes the meaning of the autocompletion value. See
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/autocomplete
for more information.

props.name: initialValue
props.docs:
Sets the initial value of the Currency Field (prior to formatting
to desired currency). NOTE: currency symbol is optional & will be
removed from the field's value if provided.

props.name: inlineField
props.docs: Removes the form field's default bottom margin.

props.name: label
props.docs: When provided, displays a FLUID Form Label at the top of the Currency Field.

props.name: labelTextOverflow
props.docs:
Sets the Form Label's text overflow behavior. By default, overflowing
label text will be truncated with ellipsis.

props.name: negativeOnly
props.docs:
Determines whether the Currency Field's value should always be negative.
Accepts a function that receives the current Form state and/or external
state (when configured) as arguments, & returns a boolean that determines
if the value must be negative. If the function returns true, any positive
value entered will be converted to its negative equivalent.

values.type: (formData?: Record<any, any>, externalState?: Record<any, any>) => boolean

props.name: outputFormat
props.docs:
When provided, Currency Field will apply a custom formatting function
to the value emitted in its "valueChange" Event. When "applyInline" is
true, formatting is also applied to the field's internal state value &
reflected in the value displayed in the embedded <input>.

props.name: outputType
props.docs:
Determines whether the output value should remain as a string or be
coerced to a number when emitted.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: placeholder
props.docs: Optional placeholder text to display within Currency Field's <input>.

props.name: readonly
props.docs:
When true, sets Currency Field to "readonly" (i.e. value cannot be
changed, but field is not grayed out like a disabled field).

props.name: roundingMethod
props.docs:
Dictates how decimal values are rounded to the nearest whole number when
using the "wholeOnly" Prop. Rounds decimals down by default. NOTE: this
Prop has no effect unless "wholeOnly" is true.

props.name: shortHandNumbers
props.docs:
When true, Currency Field will accept "shorthand" number abbreviations
as valid input (e.g. '1.2K' => '1,200', '3.5M' => '3,500,000', etc).

props.name: showCurrency
props.docs:
When false, no currency symbol is shown in the Currency Field's
embedded <input>.

props.name: step
props.docs:
Sets the increment/decrement interval for the input's "stepper"
(spin) buttons or keyboard arrows (i.e. applied to the embedded
<input> element's "step" attribute).

props.name: supplementaryLabel
props.docs:
When provided, a supplementary muted label will be displayed after the
primary Form Label.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: updateStrategy
props.docs:
Determines when the field's state is updated & "valueChange" Event
is emitted. When set to 'INPUT' (default), Currency Field is updated on
each change to the field's value (i.e. on every keystroke). When set to
'BLUR', Currency Field is only updated when the user leaves the field (i.e.
focus is transferred out). NOTE: when "shortHandNumbers" is true, the field
will always update on 'BLUR' regardless of this Prop's value.

props.name: validation
props.docs: An array of field validation options.

props.name: value
props.docs:
The Currency Field's current value. This Prop is dynamically updated
to reflect the form field's current state, so it can be used as an
alternative to the public async "getValue()" method. When provided
on first load, populates the form field with a default value. After
the component is rendered, changes to this Prop will update the form
field's value (similar to "setValue()" method). NOTE: "initialValue"
will override this Prop on first load if both Props are provided.

props.name: wholeOnly
props.docs:
When true, Currency Field will only support whole numbers (i.e. decimals
provided to the field will be rounded). NOTE: the "roundingMethod" Prop
determines how decimal values are rounded. NOTE: when this Prop is true,
the "outputType" Prop is automatically set to 'number'.

components.contextData:
FLUID Currency Field is a FLUID Form Element designed for entering and displaying currency values with proper formatting, validation, and internationalization support. It ensures accurate input of monetary amounts, handles various currencies and locales, and provides options for shorthand entry, rounding, and custom output formatting.

Use Currency Field when users need to input or view currency values in a consistent format.

changeLog.title: Currency Field Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Currency Field component created.

changeLog.title: Fixed Currency Field Placeholder Text :focus Bug
changeLog.description: Fixed issue in Currency Field LESS that prevented placeholder text from being hidden on :focus (which was intended functionality). Also added fading transition to placeholder text on :focus.

changeLog.title: Currency Field Background Color
changeLog.description: Fixed issue with Currency Field LESS that caused it to have a transparent background instead of white.

changeLog.title: Updated Currency Field Border & Placeholder Colors
changeLog.description: Previously, Currency Field border & placeholder text colors were too light in contrast to a standard white background color, resulting in poor visibility. Both border & placeholder text colors were darkened in each theme to increase visibility and aligned more closely with each theme's look & feel.

changeLog.title: Updated Currency Field "Clear/Cancel" Button Accessibility
changeLog.description: Updated several aspects of accessibility for "clear/cancel" button that appears when "allowCancel" @Prop is utilized. Root element is now HTML button element (instead of div) that can receive :focus when navigating via keyboard. When button is clicked, :focus automatically shifts back to the form element (instead of requiring a second click/Tab to navigate). Also, button click target size was increased to 24x24px, making it easier to click. Finally, button icon color was darkened to improve contrast.

changeLog.title: Add step prop
changeLog.description: Currency field component will now take a step property (can also be passed via the config property) that will allow a user to specify how much to step the input by via the stepper buttons.

changeLog.title: Add autoFocus prop
changeLog.description: autoFocus allows this field to automatically be focused on page load without user action.

changeLog.title: Improved Disabled State Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Currency Field disabled state styles for improved readability/legibility.

changeLog.title: Add shortHandNumbers prop
changeLog.description: shortHandNumbers allows the user to input a shorthand string representation of a number,which is then converted to the corresponding numerical representation

changeLog.title: Updated Validation Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Currency Field's validation error text so that it doesn't overlap sibling components/elements when visible & always has the correct font set for its current theme. Also added "fade in" visual effect to error text.

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update allows the outputFormat feature, previously only available in the context of a form, to be used in standalone mode too.

changeLog.title: Enabled number coercion in output value
changeLog.description: This update allows you to configure the field such that the value, previously always expressed as a string, can be coerced to number value on the way out, meaning you can define the shape of your payload without any app-level mutations.

changeLog.title: Adds negativeOnly function property
changeLog.description: Adds a `negativeOnly` function property which allows a developer to determine if a currency field should be forced into a negative state based on the form state and/or external state.

changeLog.title: Refactored Currency Field LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Currency Fields's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: "Autofill" Menu Config ("autocomplete" attr)
changeLog.description:
FLUID Currency Field now has the ability to configure the autocomplete attribute on its embedded input element via the htmlAutocomplete Prop. This allows developers to specify how browsers should handle the "autofill" dropdown menu that provides suggestions based on previously entered data.

Note: the "autofill" menu is now disabled by default on "standalone" Currency Field instances (i.e. not inside FLUID Form), but can be enabled by configuring the htmlAutocomplete Prop. See MDN Docs for the "autocomplete" attribute for configuration information.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

changeLog.title: Datepicker Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Datepicker component created.

changeLog.title: daysBefore and daysAfter validation now supported
changeLog.description: Fluid datepicker now supports daysBefore and daysAfter validation without a need for custom validators. See the datepicker field in advanced usage for more information on how to configure this common validation pattern in your forms!

changeLog.title: minDate and maxDate validation now supported
changeLog.description: Fluid datepicker now supports minDate and maxDate validation without a need for custom validators. See the datepicker field in advanced usage for more information on how to configure this common validation pattern in your forms! Additionally, the date validation can now take an optional `format` property, allowing validation dates to be passed in any format.

changeLog.title: Date picker Field Updated
changeLog.description: Added disabled property to render for Fluid data picker Field component.

changeLog.title: Datepicker Background Color
changeLog.description: Fixed issue with Datepicker LESS that caused it to have a transparent background instead of white.

changeLog.title: Updated Datepicker Border Color
changeLog.description: Previously, Datepicker border color was too light in contrast to a standard white background color, resulting in poor visibility. Border color was darkened in each theme to increase visibility and aligned more closely with each theme's look & feel.

changeLog.title: Updated Datepicker "Clear/Cancel" Button Accessibility
changeLog.description: Updated several aspects of accessibility for "clear/cancel" button that appears when "allowCancel" @Prop is utilized. Root element is now HTML button element (instead of div) that can receive :focus when navigating via keyboard. When button is clicked, :focus automatically shifts back to the form element (instead of requiring a second click/Tab to navigate). Also, button click target size was increased to 24x24px, making it easier to click. Finally, button icon color was darkened to improve contrast.

changeLog.title: Added Default "Invalid Date" Validation to Datepicker
changeLog.description: Added default validation for incomplete dates and/or dates with day values that are greater than the actual number of days in the month.

changeLog.title: Add autoFocus prop
changeLog.description: autoFocus allows this field to automatically be focused on page load without user action.

changeLog.title: Improved Disabled State Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Datepicker disabled state styles for improved readability/legibility.

changeLog.title: Updated Validation Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Datepicker's validation error text so that it doesn't overlap sibling components/elements when visible & always has the correct font set for its current theme. Also added "fade in" visual effect to error text.

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update allows the outputFormat feature, previously only available in the context of a form, to be used in standalone mode too.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation
changeLog.description: Instrumented FLUID Datepicker for observability using the FLUID Observability Provider pattern. Tracks user interactions for open click, focus, and blur.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

changeLog.title: "lineWeight" Prop Added

changeLog.title: "marginSize" & "removeMargins" Props Added

changeLog.title: "colorScheme" Prop Added
changeLog.description: Added colorScheme Prop to Divider that provides a standardized way to set the line color for increased contrast when the component is used on light/dark backgrounds (replaces color Prop). For example, if Divider is displayed on a dark blue background, set colorScheme to light so that the line color is white (instead of the default "medium gray").

changeLog.title: "dashed" Prop Added
changeLog.description: Added dashed Prop to Divider that renders a dashed line instead of a solid line (replaces borderStyle Prop).

changeLog.title: Divider Usage Examples Updated
changeLog.description: Updated Divider's usage examples to reflect new Props and provide more comprehensive demonstrations of the component's capabilities.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text: While similar to FLUID Sidebar in appearance, FLUID Drawer is closer to a Modal or Popover in purpose. FLUID Drawer's primary use case is for contextual information that is related to content within the page (especially when a Popover is too small, or a Modal is too intrusive). The Drawer component can be used for ancillary content, reference material, settings controls, etc., but should NOT be used primarily for navigation (except in very rare circumstances such as contextual links to relevant in-page material).

props.name: anchor
props.docs: Determines which side of the page that Drawer will be positioned.

props.name: disableScroll
props.docs:
If true, background (page body) scrolling will be disabled when
Drawer is open. If false, page can be scrolled in the background
while Drawer is open.

props.name: hideCloseIcon
props.docs:
When true, removes drawers "close" button. NOTE: This should be used
with caution - if you haven't set up a way to close programmatically
with toggleDrawer(visible: boolean) on the instance OR enabled "outsideClickClose",
you won't be able to close the drawer!

props.name: nonBlocking
props.docs:
When true, the Drawer will not block the page background. The overlay
will be hidden, focus will not be trapped to the Drawer, background
scrolling will be enabled, and the drop shadow will be removed. This
is useful for patterns like cookie consent banners that need to appear
without blocking user interaction with the rest of the page.

props.name: outsideClickClose
props.docs:
If true, the Drawer will close on a click anywhere outside of the
main Drawer container. If false, the "dismiss" button must be clicked
to close the Drawer.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: padding
props.docs:
Determines the size of the Drawer container's internal padding.
Accepts all FluidSize values except for "full".

props.name: size
props.docs:
Determines the Drawer's width (if anchor is left/right) or height
(if anchor is top/bottom). Accepts FluidSize for t-shirt sizing, or
a number that equates to a percentage of the viewport width/height.
For example, if the anchor Prop is set to "left" & a value of 60
is passed, the Drawer will be 60% of the viewport width.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: visible
props.docs:
Whether the Drawer is open or closed. When true, Drawer will be open.
When false, Drawer will be closed.

methods.name: openDrawer
methods.docs:
Allows the drawer to be opened programmatically without maintaining
visibility state.

methods.name: toggleDrawer
methods.docs: Toggles Drawer open (true) or closed (false/null).

events.docs:
Event emitted when Drawer is opened or closed. Emits "true" when
Drawer is opened & "false" when closed.

slots.docs: Content displayed within the Drawer

components.contextData: While similar to FLUID Sidebar in appearance, FLUID Drawer is closer to a Modal or Popover in purpose. FLUID Drawer's primary use case is for contextual information that is related to content within the page (especially when a Popover is too small, or a Modal is too intrusive). The Drawer component can be used for ancillary content, reference material, settings controls, etc., but should NOT be used primarily for navigation (except in very rare circumstances such as contextual links to relevant in-page material).

changeLog.title: Allow drawer to be persistable
changeLog.description: Addition of a new `hideCloseIcon` prop allows the drawer to become persistable (when used along with `outsideClickClose`) and can now be toggled using a `toggleDrawer(visible: boolean)` method on the instance/reference.

changeLog.description: Improved Drawer's "dismiss" Button aesthetics, color contrast, & click target size for better accessibility.

changeLog.description: Drawer's "close" Button is now sticky when its content scrolls, allowing users to close the Drawer without needing to scroll back to the top.

changeLog.title: Keyboard Accessibility Improvements
changeLog.description: Drawer now transfers :focus to itself when opened, allowing users to tab through its contents without needing to click within its body first. Drawer has also been updated to support "escape to close", making it easier to navigate via keyboard only.

changeLog.description: Added "nonBlocking" Prop to Drawer. When true, the overlay is hidden, focus is not trapped to the Drawer, background scrolling is enabled, and the drop shadow is removed.

docsTags.text:
FLUID Dropdown Button is exactly what it sounds like - a FLUID Button that displays a dropdown navigation menu when clicked. Dropdown Button utilizes FLUID Tree Menu under the hood, giving it support for nested menu items, expandable submenus, section titles, dividers, & more (see Tree Menu documentation for more information).

Dropdown Button should primarily be used for internal, external, or in-page navigation, but can also be used for contextual actions or controls. It should always be related to nearby page content, and should limit the number of menu items displayed to a maximum of 10-15.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: icon-before - Named slot for icon displayed to the left of the Button's label

props.name: absolutePosition
props.docs:
Changes the dropdown menu's CSS "position" property from "fixed"
(default) to "absolute". NOTE: if the dropdown menu isn't displaying
correctly, try setting this Prop's value to "true".

props.name: color
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "color" is now deprecated. Instead, use the "type" Prop
(same functionality, just a different naming convention) -- Style
settings applied to the Button.

props.name: colorScheme
props.docs:
NOTE: This Prop applies to "type: ghost" Buttons ONLY & will be
ignored for all other Button types. Sets a Ghost Button's text color
to "light" or "dark" for increased contrast when displayed on a color
background. For example, if your Ghost Button is displayed on a DARK
BLUE background, set this Prop's value to "light" so that the label
color will be white (instead of the default blue). If your Ghost
Button is displayed on a YELLOW background, set this Prop's value to
"dark" so that the label will be dark gray (instead of the default
blue). Do NOT change this Prop's value if your Ghost Button is
displayed on a WHITE background. See FLUID Button's "Examples" tab
for more info.

props.name: disabled
props.docs: When true, Button & dropdown menu will be disabled.

props.name: icon
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "icon" is now deprecated. Use "iconBefore" Prop instead.
If present, renders an Icon BEFORE the Button label (NOTE: "iconAfter"
is automatically set to "chevron" Icon that indicates whether dropdown
menu is open or closed).

props.name: iconBefore
props.docs:
If present, renders an Icon to the left of the Button label.
NOTE: "iconAfter" is automatically set to "chevron_down" Icon
that indicates whether the dropdown menu is open or closed.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the dropdown-button in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: label
props.docs: Text for the Button label.

props.name: links
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "links" is now deprecated. Use "menuItems" Prop instead.
-- Array of FluidAction objects that populate the dropdown menu with
menu items. Values from this Prop are now mapped to "menuItems" Prop.

props.name: maxHeight
props.docs:
Sets a maximum height on the dropdown menu & allows vertical
scrolling for content overflow. Accepts any string value that is
valid for CSS "max-height" property.

props.name: menuId
props.docs: Unique "id" attribute for the dropdown menu container.

props.name: menuItems
props.docs: Array of FluidMenuItems that populates the dropdown menu.

props.name: openOnHover
props.docs:
When true, hovering over the Button will open the dropdown menu
and moving the mouse out of the component's bounds will close it.
NOTE: this Prop DISABLES click events on the Button (i.e. clicking
the Button will NOT open/close the menu), but does NOT affect
keyboard events (i.e. "enter" or "space" WILL open the menu).

props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the

props.docs: Removes the Button's default right margin.

props.name: removeMargin
props.docs: Removes the Button's default right AND bottom margins.

props.name: removeVerticalMargin
props.docs: Removes the Button's default bottom margin.

props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.docs: Sets the color & style of the Button.

methods.docs: Toggles the dropdown menu open/closed.

Event emitted when a menu item in the dropdown menu is clicked
(NOTE: does NOT include "submenu buttons"). Contains the menu
item's FluidMenuItem object.

changeLog.title: Dropdown Button Component Created
changeLog.description: Dropdown Button Component Created.

changeLog.title: Dropdown Button Usage Examples Added
changeLog.description: Added usage examples for Dropdown Button.

changeLog.title: Standardized Dropdown Button Menu Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Dropdown Button styles to be consistent with all other FLUID component dropdown menus.

changeLog.title: Updated Dropdown Button to Fixed Position
changeLog.description: Fixed issue with Dropdown Button that caused it to be truncated when overflowing certain containers and/or hidden by stacking context.

changeLog.title: Added FluidMenuItem Support (Embedded Tree Menu)
changeLog.description: Added "menuItems" Prop to Dropdown Button & deprecated "links" Prop. Dropdown Button now uses Tree Menu under the hood to populate its dropdown menu, which adds support for submenus, nested menu items, section titles, dividers, & more.

changeLog.title: Improved Dropdown Menu Edge Detection & Overflow Prevention
changeLog.description: Refactored Dropdown Button to use PopperJS for menu positioning & edge detection. Menu now uses "position: fixed;" to display above sibling/parent elements, which mitigates previous truncation issues caused by parent containers with "overflow" settings. Dropdown Button also has improved edge detection functionality that prevents the menu from overflowing the viewport both horizontally & vertically.

changeLog.title: Added Ability to Set Menu Max-Height
changeLog.description: Added Prop "maxHeight" to Dropdown Button - sets a maximum height on the dropdown menu & allows vertical scrolling for overflowing content.

changeLog.title: Added Ability to Open Menu on Hover
changeLog.description: Added a new Prop "openOnHover" - when true, causes the dropdown menu to open when the trigger is hovered over & close when the mouse leaves the component's bounds. NOTE: click events on the Button element are disabled when "openOnHover" is true to prevent accidental menu closes.

changeLog.title: Updated Dropdown Button Render/Functional Tests
changeLog.description: Added basic set of Dropdown Button unit & functional tests.

changeLog.title: Overhauled Dropdown Button Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Refactored Dropdown Button usage examples to cover all major Props & commonly used Prop configurations.

changeLog.title: Added "colorScheme" Prop
changeLog.description: Added "colorScheme" Prop to Dropdown Button - changes ghost Button label text color to either light (white) or dark (default text color) for increased contrast when displayed on a color background. For example, if your Ghost Button is displayed on a DARK BLUE background, set this Prop's value to "light" so that the label color will be white (instead of the default blue). If your Ghost Button is displayed on a YELLOW background, set this Prop's value to "dark" so that the label will be dark gray (instead of the default blue). NOTE: This Prop applies to "type: ghost" Buttons ONLY & will be ignored for all other Button types.

changeLog.title: Added "type" Prop & Deprecated "color" Prop
changeLog.description: Changed naming convention of Dropdown Button's Prop "color" to "type". New naming convention is more consistent with other component Prop names, conveys the Prop's functionality clearly, & is less ambiguous with the addition of the new "colorScheme" Prop.

changeLog.title: Added Support for Slotted Icons in Menu Items
changeLog.description: Dropdown Button now supports custom slotted icons in menu items (including menu items nested within submenus) using FluidMenuItem's iconBefore.slotName or iconAfter.slotName. See Dropdown Button's usage examples in the FLUID Docs Site for demo.

changeLog.title: Refactored Dropdown Button LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Dropdown Button's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

docsTags.text:
The FLUID file upload component lets the user choose one or more files from their device storage, which is displayed as an
editable table list of files. When the filelist changes in the table, the actual files are emitted from the fileListUpdated event for the
consuming application to handle from then on.

props.name: acceptFileTypes
props.docs:
If supplied, file upload will be restricted to the given filetypes only,
otherwise, all file types are accepted.

Please note - in some cases, the file type presented by different operating systems uses
different casing (example macroenabled vs macroEnabled). As the FLUID uploader simply
concatenates the array you provide to the native elements 'accept' property, you may need
to both casing versions to support multiple operating systems.

props.name: acceptMultiple
props.docs:
Whether the file upload should allow multiple files to be uploaded -
if true, file list is displayed as a table beneath the drop zone.

props.name: actionsDisabled
props.docs:
If true, all actions will be disabled, unless they are configured with an `enabledIf` property which
overrides this propertyl.

props.name: emptyStateConfig
props.docs: Allows content customization in the default (empty) state.

props.name: fileListHeaderConfig
props.docs:
If provided, overrides the default table headers for the filelist when
using multiple file upload.

props.name: maxSize
props.docs: The maximum allowed file size in bytes.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: populatedStateConfig
props.docs: Allows content customization when the control is populated with files.

props.name: restrictedFileTypeMessage
props.docs:
Allows a custom message to be configured for the popover that is shown on the warning
icon when a restricted file type has been attempted upload via drag and drop.

props.name: showFileList
props.docs: If false, this will hide the table which displays the file list

props.name: size
props.docs: The size of the file upload component.

props.name: supplementaryInformation
props.docs:
If there is any additional information to be displayed in the drop zone, such as maximum accepted
file size, or restrictions of filetype, use this property to provide it.

props.name: theme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.docs:
Where a file upload allows multiple files, you can configure a set of action buttons to be
displayed beneath the table that displays the files ready for upload.

props.name: autoFocus
props.docs:
When true, :focus will be automatically transferred to the root
element's first tabbable child (or child element set by
"setAutoFocusNode") when Focus Trap is enabled. When false, :focus
is transferred to the root element itself (default).

props.name: disableAutoActivation
props.docs:
If true, prevents Focus Trap from enabling itself automatically when
one of its children receives :focus.

props.name: enabled
props.docs:
Whether Focus Trap is actively trapping :focus. When true, :focus
is automatically transferred to the Focus Trap (if :focus was
previously outside the root element). When false, Focus Trap will
attempt to restore :focus to the element that previously had :focus
before the trap was activated.

props.name: rootElement
props.docs:
Container that holds all tabbable elements within the Focus Trap.
Must be located within Focus Trap's Slot.

methods.name: setAutoFocusNode
methods.docs:
Sets element to receive :focus when Focus Trap is ACTIVATED &
"autoFocus" is true. Element provided MUST be child of root element.

changeLog.title: Form Created
changeLog.description: Fluid Form component created.

changeLog.title: Added ability to get a reference to a forms inner elements
changeLog.description:
We've now added the ability to get a reference to a forms inner elements by dataPath, which allows you to
    call methods, or attach event listeners to individual elements, whilst still in the context of the parent form. This is useful in
    scenarios where you may want to reset an elements state, for example, but maintain the state of the rest of the form, or listen specifically
    to changes to a particular element, without having to filter valueChange events on the parent form itself. Now, if you want a reference to
    a myTextInput field, for example, from your formRef, simply call: formRef.getElementRef('myTextInput').then(myTextInputRef => // do stuff with
    myTextInputRef) 🎉

changeLog.title: Added abilty to provide external state to form for dynamic config and values
changeLog.description: Form now accepts externalState, which allows you to provide a mutable object containing any external state to the forms dynamic functions, allowing you to have complex configuration, such as validation based on app state, or even based on another forms state.

changeLog.title: Adds native isBeforeField and isAfterField validation, along with token replacements for validation messages
changeLog.description:
Adds native `isAfterField` and `isBeforeField` validations to FLUID form so consumers do not have to roll their own date comparison logic, when we already have built in utilities.

Adds the ability to include a comparator value in the validation messages so users know exactly what value they need to work against.

Adds the ability to provide `tokenFormatters` for any replacements in the validation message so that a raw value can be custom formatted for display in the message.

See the PR for more info: https://github.com/lmigtech/fluid/pull/1009

Example: https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-ivy-bcidgu?file=src%2Fapp%2Fbasic-form-config.ts

changeLog.title: Add a confirmation dialog strategy option for the cancel button
changeLog.description:
Two new properties were added the `FluidConfirmationDialogConfig` and the `FluidFormControlConfig.displayDialogBeforeAction` .

Adds the ability to display the confirmation dialog before the cancel action button.

See the PR for more info: https://github.com/lmigtech/fluid/pull/1026

Example: https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-ivy-hmkpdm

changeLog.title: Toggle Vertical Alignment
changeLog.description: FLUID Form now automatically applies vertical center alignment to Toggles when displayed side-by-side with other Form Elements.

changeLog.title: Fixed bug with output formatting on redacted values
changeLog.description: Fixed a bug 🐛 where output formatting was not being applied to the redacted values in form state output

changeLog.title: Column/Element Sizes: "fill" & "auto"
changeLog.description:
FLUID Form now supports fill & auto values for column & element sizes. Specifically, these values can be used when configuring FluidColumnOptions.colSpan (e.g. columnOptions & rowOptions.columnOptions) & FluidFormItem.elementWidth (e.g. elementWidth properties within the elements Prop).

The fill value will cause a column or element to dynamically expand to fill the available space within a row. This is especially useful when paired with the auto size, since auto columns/elements will most likely be irregular sizes.

Conversely, the auto value will set a column's or element's size to match the size of its content. This is useful for non-Form elements (such as Buttons) that would skew a Form row's spacing when configured with a traditional column size (i.e. 1-12).

See FLUID Grid Item's usage example for "Responsive Column Sizes" for a demo showing both fill & auto values. Also see the FLUID Form: Layout Config StackBlitz for examples of each Form layout configuration.

changeLog.title: "Row" Layout Vertical Alignment
changeLog.description: FLUID Form's "row" layout now supports vertical alignment configuration for items within each Form row (i.e FluidRowOptions.alignItems). When defining Form rows within the rowOptions Prop, simply provide the alignItems property with a valid FluidFlexAlignment value to set the vertical alignment of all items within the row (i.e. Form Elements and/or non-Form Elements). This is especially useful for center-aligning non-Form elements (e.g. FLUID Button) with the other Form Elements within a row.

changeLog.title: Refactored Form LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Forms stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Ability to preserve touched state between renders
changeLog.description: Added a new preserveTouchedState flag which, when true, will cause the form to preserve its own, and its childrens, 'touched' state when it re-renders as a result of fromData changing from above.

changeLog.title: External state can now be used in dynamic renderer functions
changeLog.description:
This update gives the developers the ability to use <code>externalState<code> in any dynamic functions they apply to rendered components in their form,
meaning they can now use the form data in addition to any data from outside the form to calculate dynamic props, content, events and children!

changeLog.title: Added field focused event
changeLog.description: This update allows developers to add a native fieldFocused event to each element so developers can listen directly on the element.

changeLog.title: Fully Responsive Layout Configuration
changeLog.description:
FLUID Form now supports responsive breakpoint configuration for all column & element sizes. Specifically, FluidGridItemCargo objects can now be used to configure FluidColumnOptions.colSpan (e.g. columnOptions & rowOptions.columnOptions) & FluidFormItem.elementWidth (e.g. elementWidth properties within the elements Prop).

Previously, only FluidGridItemSize values (i.e. 1-12, "auto", & "fill") were supported for column & element sizes. Now, you can provide a responsive configuration for each column/element, allowing you to define different layouts for different viewport sizes. See FluidGridItemCargo & FLUID Grid Item documentation & usage examples for more information.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is intended for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. The property can be set at the form level (applies to all elements) or at the individual element level via config.wrapValidation. A developer warning is emitted when this property is enabled to encourage concise error messaging.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements. Form-level formState.warnings aggregation is now available alongside formState.errors.

changeLog.title: Validate entries when configuration changes
changeLog.description: Whenever configuration changes (or external state causing dynamic config to re-evaluate), each entry was previously being validated with its owninternal validators, however, the overall entry validations (min/max, custom, etc) was not running on ALL entries. This update fixes that by waiting for individualvalidations to finish before running the overall entry validations.

changeLog.title: Enables disabled entries from Form
changeLog.description: The disabled property from Fluid Form now disables all entries in the Form Array.When the entire Form is disabled, all form controls will no longer appear.Fixed issue where disabledByState was not updating when last entry was removed without validating the entry.Fixed logic issue in addForms for when it is disabled.

changeLog.title: Added reordering functionality

components.contextData: FLUID Grid is a responsive, flexbox-based component that can be used to build layouts of all shapes & sizes. Grid is meant to be used with FLUID Grid Item children - together, they provide a 12-column grid framework that is customizable at 5 incremental breakpoints.

changeLog.title: FLUID Grid Created
changeLog.description: Grid component created.

changeLog.title: Customizable Spacing Between Grid Items
changeLog.description: Added gridItemSpacing Prop to Grid that allows custom spacing between Grid Item children. Also added removeSpacing Prop & deprecated gutter Prop.

changeLog.title: Horizontal & Vertical Grid Item Alignment
changeLog.description: Added justify (horizontal) & alignItems (vertical) Props to Grid that allow custom horizontal/vertical alignment of Grid Item children.

changeLog.title: Grid Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Added complete set of Grid + Grid Item usage examples that demo all major Props & configurations. Also added table of FLUID breakpoints & their associated "col-..." Props.

changeLog.title: Support for "Full-Height" & "Inline" Grid
changeLog.description: Added fullHeight & inline Props to Grid. The fullHeight Prop expands Grid's height to be 100% of its parent container's height. The inline Prop applies display: inline-flex; to Grid's root element.

changeLog.title: Grid Performance Improvements
changeLog.description: Improved Grid Item's performance & reduced memory usage - removed unnecessary internal references to Grid Item children & updated Grid's lifecycle methods.

docsTags.text: FLUID Grid Items are the foundational building blocks of FLUID Grid - they create modular, flexible columns for page content that can be customized at 5 incremental responsive breakpoints.

props.name: alignSelf
props.docs:
Set vertical alignment for a single Grid Item within parent Grid.
Overrides Grid parent's vertical alignment setting (i.e.
"alignItems" Prop). NOTE: Grid Item's child(ren) MUST be shorter
than the height of the parent Grid for this Prop to work.

props.name: auto
props.docs:
Sets column width automatically based on content width at ALL
breakpoint sizes (i.e. "fluid" column width - no pun intended 😏).
To use "auto width" at specific breakpoint sizes, set any of the
"col-..." Props to "auto". NOTE: this Prop is overridden by any/
all other "col-..." Props applied to the Grid Item, so it needs
to be used independently of them to work correctly.

props.name: col
props.docs:
Sets default column width at smallest mobile breakpoint size & up
(viewport sizes: >0px). Accepts number value 1-12, "auto", or "fill".
NOTE: when setting breakpoint sizes larger than "colSm", it's
recommended to ALWAYS set this Prop's value to 12 - this provides
a "fallback" value for smaller breakpoint sizes (otherwise, smaller
breakpoints will behave as if no "col-..." Prop is set).

props.name: colLg
props.docs:
Sets column width at desktop breakpoint size & up
(viewport sizes: ≥992px). Accepts number value 1-12, "auto", or "fill".

props.name: colMd
props.docs:
Sets column width at tablet / small desktop breakpoint size & up
(viewport sizes: ≥768px). Accepts number value 1-12, "auto", or "fill".

props.name: colSm
props.docs:
Sets column width at large mobile / small tablet breakpoint size & up
(viewport sizes: ≥480px). Accepts number value 1-12, "auto", or "fill".

props.name: colXl
props.docs:
Sets column width at large desktop breakpoint size & up
(viewport sizes: ≥1200px). Accepts number value 1-12, "auto", or "fill".

props.name: config
props.docs: Allows all Grid Item Props to be set via a single configuration object.

props.name: gridItemCargo
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "gridItemCargo" is now deprecated. Instead, use the
"config" Prop (allows ALL Grid Item Props to be set). -- Config
object that allows all "col-..." Props to be set via a single Prop.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the grid-item in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: order
props.docs:
When provided, changes default DOM order of the Grid Item within
its Grid parent (i.e. sets flexbox "order" property). By default,
all Grid Items have an order of 0 - changing this Prop to 1 will
cause the Grid Item to be displayed AFTER other Grid Item siblings.

props.name: pullLeft
props.docs:
Left-justify a single Grid Item within parent Grid. Only applicable
when sum of all GridItem "col" values is less than 12. Works best
when parent Grid's "justify" Prop is "end".

props.name: pullRight
props.docs:
Right-justify a single Grid Item within parent Grid. Only applicable
when sum of all GridItem "col" values is less than 12. Works best
when parent Grid's "justify" Prop is "start".

changeLog.title: FLUID Grid Item Created
changeLog.description: Grid Item component created.

changeLog.title: Left/Right Grid Item Offset
changeLog.description: Added pullLeft & pullRight Props to Grid Item that allow a single Grid Item to be offset left/right from all other Grid Items.

changeLog.title: Override Parent Grid Vertical Alignment
changeLog.description: Added alignSelf Prop to Grid Item that overrides parent Grid alignItems Prop.

changeLog.title: Grid Item Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Added complete set of Grid + Grid Item usage examples that demo all major Props & configurations. Also added table of FLUID breakpoints & their associated "col-..." Props.

changeLog.title: Responsive "Auto" Column Width
changeLog.description: Updated Grid Item's col-... Props to accept FluidGridItemSize values, which allow "auto" column width to be set at each breakpoint (i.e. column width determined by Grid Item's content). Previously, Grid Item only supported "auto" column width via the auto Prop, which applied to ALL breakpoints. Also fixed an obscure bug that caused Grid Item to overflow the bounds of its parent Grid when using the auto Prop.

changeLog.title: Grid Item "config" Prop
changeLog.description: Deprecated Grid Item's gridItemCargo Prop & added config Prop. The config Prop allows ALL Grid Item Props to be set via a single object, whereas gridItemCargo only allowed Grid Item's col-... Props to be set.

changeLog.title: Grid Item Performance Improvements
changeLog.description: Updated Grid Item to allow col-... Props to be updated after component first loads. Also improved functionality of Grid Item's internal validation methods.

changeLog.title: Grid / Grid Item Sandbox Page
changeLog.description: Added <fluid-link inline href="/fluid/fluid-grid.html">Grid / Grid Item "sandbox" page</fluid-link> & populated with additional usage examples.

changeLog.title: Responsive "Fill" Column Size
changeLog.description: All of Grid Item's col-... Props now support "fill" value - this allows Grid Item to “grow” to fill empty space within its parent Grid at ANY breakpoint. Previously, Grid Item was only allowed to “grow” when none of its col-... Props were defined (i.e. it could NOT be configured to “fill” empty space at specified breakpoints).

docsTags.text: FLUID Header is a key component of any user interface. It helps users quickly and easily find the information they're looking for via links to the main pages & sections of a site. Since it appears on every page, Header facilitates a consistent user experience by allowing users to navigate from one page to another regardless of the content of each page. Header can be combined with FLUID Sidebar for more complex UIs where advanced navigation is needed.

Preferred sizing: Aspect Ratio: 4:1-10:1 | Width: 175px-300px | Height: 20px-60px

docsTags.text: header-content - Named slot for additional header content (i.e. links, menus, etc.)

props.name: alignment
props.docs:
Sets alignment of links within Header container (at desktop size).
Accepts "left", "center", or "right".

props.name: displayDensity
props.docs:
Sets Header's height, link font size, padding, spacing, etc. to be
more or less compact.

props.name: fixedPosition
props.docs:
When true, Header will be "sticky" when scrolling (i.e. Header will
have a fixed position at the top of the viewport).

props.name: hoverOpenSubmenus
props.docs:
When true, Header submenus / mega menus will open on :hover (at
desktop size).

props.name: links
props.docs:
Array of FluidMenuItems that populate Header with links / submenus.
NOTE: FluidMenuItem provides 2 ways to set a Header link's destination
URL: the "href" property & "route" property. Use the "href" property to
generate a standard anchor (<a>) element that does NOT rely on the
consuming app's router for navigation. Use the "route" property when
navigation SHOULD be handled by the consuming app's router (i.e.
equivalent to Angular's "routerLink" or React's <Link to="...">).

props.name: logoConfig
props.docs:
Allows configuration of Header's built-in logo, including the ability
to make the logo a clickable hyperlink. The config object accepts the
following FLUID Link properties: "href" OR "route" (required) &
"target" (optional). It also accepts an optional "tooltip" property
that displays tooltip text on :hover.

props.name: noLogo
props.docs: When true, Header will NOT render a logo OR a logo slot.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: themePalette
props.docs:
When provided, sets the current theme's color palette & appearance.
NOTE: a theme palette acts as a "style override" applied ON TOP of
the current theme & isn't necessary for "standard" theme aesthetics.

methods.name: closeAllSubmenus
methods.docs: Closes all open submenus & mega menus.

events.docs:
Event emitted when a link is clicked. Contains the corresponding
FluidMenuItem's "route" or "href" property value. This event only
applies to links (i.e. menu items), and is NOT emitted when a
submenu/mega menu button is clicked.

Event fired when a menu item with no submenu / mega menu is clicked.
Contains the entire FluidMenuItem object.

Emits "route" and "href" prop values, along with the original click event,
when Link is clicked.

Useful for properly handling control-clicks when using the "route" prop.

It helps users quickly and easily find the information they're looking for via links to the main pages & sections of a site. Since it appears on every page, Header facilitates a consistent user experience by allowing users to navigate from one page to another regardless of the content of each page. Header can be combined with FLUID Sidebar for more complex UIs where advanced navigation is needed.

changeLog.title: Header Created
changeLog.description: Header component created.

changeLog.title: Responsive Header Released
changeLog.description: Refactored Header to be responsive. Header body transforms into slide-out menu at mobile/tablet sizes.

changeLog.title: Added "Disabled" State for Header Links
changeLog.description: Added ability to disable Header links.

changeLog.title: Swapped Header <a> tags for <button> tags
changeLog.description: Since Header links did not use the "href" attribute, <a> tags should not be used. Instead, <button> tags were implemented for all Header links.

changeLog.title: Integrated "Sticky" Functionality
changeLog.description: Added "Sticky Position Management Engine" support to Header. Header can now communicate its size / position to other "sticky" components, allowing multiple fixed-position component on the same page.

changeLog.title: Integrated FLUID Navigation
changeLog.description: Integrated FLUID Navigation functional components to handle rendering/functionality of Header links. Changed "links" Prop() array interface type to FluidMenuItem (was FluidAction).

changeLog.title: Updated Tests for Addition of FLUID Navigation
changeLog.description: Updated render / functional tests to expect embedded FLUID Navigation functional components.

changeLog.title: Added Header Dropdown Menus
changeLog.description: Added support for mobile/desktop Header dropdown menus. NOTE: Dropdown menus currently can only be 1 level deep - meaning that Header does NOT support nested submenus (like FLUID Tree Menu does). Added ability to open dropdown menus via :hover (desktop size), & functionality to close the mobile "flyout" menu when link is clicked (mobile size).

changeLog.title: Added Dropdown Menu Keyboard Navigation
changeLog.description: Added ability to seamlessly navigate between Header top-level links & dropdown menu links via keyboard controls.

changeLog.title: Updated Header Links :hover & "selected" States
changeLog.description: Added styles for dropdown menu link :hover & "selected" states. Updated LM theme :hover state for top-level links. Added "disabled" state styles to dropdown menu buttons.

changeLog.title: Added Support for Slotted Header Logo
changeLog.description: Added FLUID Header support for custom logos via Slot. Removed logo in "mobile flyout menu" for compatibility with logo Slot. Adjusted Header architecture to compensate for logo updates & improved dynamic content organization to prevent "search" & "content" Slots from wrapping underneath navigation links.

changeLog.title: Refactored Header Render & Functional Unit Tests
changeLog.description: Refactored Header render / functional tests to be more effective. Added render tests for remaining @Props.

changeLog.title: Added Support for FluidMenuItem "href" & "target" Properties
changeLog.description: Added support for FluidMenuItem "href" property in the "links" array - generates standard anchor elements that do NOT rely on the consuming application's router for navigation. Also added support for "target" property, which allows a Header link to be opened in a new tab by default (must be used with "href" property / NOT compatible with "route" property).

changeLog.title: Added Basic Header Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Added basic usage examples to Header that demonstrate the difference between "standard" & "router" links, & show basic submenu implementation as well.

changeLog.title: Added Mega Menu Support to Header
changeLog.description: FLUID Header now supports mega menus (in addition to standard "dropdown menu" submenus). Mega menus can be configured with 3 layouts: "Columns" (vertical columns of links with titles), "Links Only" (unstructured list of links that cascade into columns), & Hybrid (mix of columns & "links only" layouts). Each layout supports an optional "menu title" displayed to the left of the menu's links as well. See Header's usage examples for demo configurations. Header now also uses PopperJS under the hood for viewport overflow detection & dynamic positioning of submenus & mega menus.

changeLog.title: Updated Header Aesthetics
changeLog.description: Header's mobile "flyout" menu received an aesthetic facelift, & link styles now match the look & feel of FLUID Link more closely.

changeLog.title: Added "Escape-to-Close" Functionality to Header Menus
changeLog.description: Header submenus (i.e. "dropdown menus") & mega menus can now be closed via the "escape" key when open.

changeLog.title: Improved Header Performance
changeLog.description: Header now runs more smoothly/efficiently, responds quicker to changes in viewport size, child elements, etc., & uses less system resources.

changeLog.title: Added Advanced Header Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Added advanced usage examples to Header including examples for mega menu, slots, & multiple "links" Prop configurations.

changeLog.title: Theme Palette Support
changeLog.description: Added themePalette Prop to Header that allows selective color/aesthetic "style overrides" to be applied on top of the currently applied theme. Also added "Helmsman" theme palette MVP (for use with Portal theme).

changeLog.title: Refactored Header LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Header's stylesheets to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Compact Display Density
changeLog.description: Added displayDensity Prop to Header that adjusts logo size, font size, & spacing to be more or less compact.

changeLog.title: Header Logo Hyperlink Support
changeLog.description: Added logoConfig Prop to FLUID Header that allows its logo to be configured as a clickable hyperlink. When provided, Header will wrap its logo in a FLUID Link with optional tooltip text. logoConfig can be used with Header's default theme-specific logo, or with a custom logo provided via the header-logo slot.

changeLog.title: Mega Menu Slotted Content Support
changeLog.description: Added support for custom slotted content within FLUID Header's mega menus. When configured, the left-hand side of mega menus can display slotted content, allowing for a richer navigation experience that goes beyond standard links. Simply add a slotName property with the desired slot name to the mega menu's FluidMenuItem object, then add a child component/element with a matching slot attribute to FLUID Header.

props.name: arialabel
props.docs:
Property to set the aria-label for accessibility compliance.
Note: if the Icon is used as an "indicator" (i.e. it's used by itself), then arialabel must be provided for accessibility.
However, if the Icon is used with another element that has a label OR is used within another component with a label, then arialabel should NOT be provided (i.e. the other element / component provides the necessary context)

props.name: popover
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popover" is now deprecated (https://chromestatus.com/feature/5463833265045504).
Instead, use the "message" property of the "popoverConfig" Prop. --
If provided, adds simple "tooltip" Popover to Icon that is
displayed on hover. NOTE: if you need to customize Popover's
Props, use the "popoverConfig" Prop instead to access ALL of
Popover's Props.

props.name: popoverConfig
props.docs:
When provided, adds a Popover to Icon that is displayed on :hover.
Accepts either a string or FluidPopoverConfig value - string value
generates a simple Popover, while a FluidPopoverConfig value allows
all Popover Props to be customized.

props.name: popoverPersistable
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popoverPersistable" is now deprecated. Instead, use
the "persistable" property of the "popoverConfig" Prop. --
When false, the Icon's Popover will NOT remain open when clicked.

props.name: popoverPlacement
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popoverPlacement" is now deprecated. Instead, use
the "placement" property of the "popoverConfig" Prop. --
If Popover exists, which side of the Icon should display the Popover?

props.name: popoverWidth
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popoverWidth" is now deprecated. Instead, use
the "width" property of the "popoverConfig" Prop. --
If Popover exists, explicitly sets the Popover's maximum width.

props.docs:

props.name: rotate
props.docs: The icon will infinitely rotate while this value is true

props.name: scale
props.docs:
If we need to override the scaling down of an icon, use this prop. Scales
are in multiples of 5 and correspond to a percentage reduction. If you find you
need to scale up, use the next size up and scale down accordingly.

props.name: size

props.name: slotName
props.docs:

will render a named slot instead of an embedded SVG. Slotted
children (e.g. custom SVGs, images, Font Awesome icons, etc.) will
need to have the following attribute: slot="slotName" ("slotName"
should be the value of this Prop). NOTE: this Prop should be used
when providing custom slotted icons for menu items within Context
Menu or Tree Menu.

changeLog.title: Added Support for Rotation & Custom Styles to FLUID Icon
changeLog.description: Added @Props to FLUID Icon that enable infinite rotation animation & custom margin / padding to be added to the Icon SVG.

changeLog.title: Added Ability to Vertically Flip FLUID Icon via @Prop

changeLog.title: Added @Props to Tweak FLUID Icon Positioning
changeLog.description: Added "position" @Prop that allows top, bottom, left, & right margin to be added INSIDE the Icon container (pushes the Icon in specified direction(s)). Also added "scale" @Prop that allows the Icon width to be scaled down by increments of 5%.

changeLog.title: Added "config" @Prop to FLUID Icon
changeLog.description: Added ability to set all FLUID Icon @Props via a single configuration object.

changeLog.title: Added Embedded Popover Support to FLUID Icon
changeLog.description: Added support for simple, embedded Popover to FLUID Icon.

changeLog.title: Added Ability to Disable FLUID Icon

changeLog.title: Updates to FLUID Icon Styles
changeLog.description: Updated FLUID Icon styles to position SVG within its container more consistently & with better vertical alignment.

changeLog.title: Fixed FLUID Icon Default Hover State
changeLog.description: Added "interactive" @Prop to FLUID Icon that specifies whether Icon should have "cursor: pointer" on :hover. Icon will automatically have "pointer" cursor if it has a Popover.

changeLog.title: Added Support for Fully Customizable Popover to FLUID Icon
changeLog.description: Added "popoverConfig" @Prop to FLUID Icon that gives access to all Popover @Props for full Popover customization.

changeLog.title: FLUID Icon Theme-Based Colors

changeLog.title: FLUID Icon Usage Examples

changeLog.title: FLUID Icon Sandbox Page
changeLog.description: Added FLUID Icon "sandbox" page that showcases all available SVGs (i.e. iconKey Prop values) & includes an configurable/interactive Icon preview with code snippet.

changeLog.title: Expand/Collapse Icons

changeLog.title: Full-Size Icon Support
changeLog.description: Added support for full value to FLUID Icon's size Prop, which allows Icon to fill the width/height of its parent.

changeLog.title: Icon Inherits Text Color by Default
changeLog.description: FLUID Icon now automatically inherits the text color of its parent when color Prop is left undefined.

changeLog.title: Save & Print Icon Support
changeLog.description: Added support for "save" & "print" Icon keys.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
FLUID In-Page Nav helps users to understand the contents of a page at a glance, as well as navigate to specific sections of a page via "jump links". The component features a "sticky" Tree Menu positioned on one side of the page containing a list of "jump links" that outline the page's content. Clicking a link will smoothly scroll the page to the corresponding section.

NOTE: In-Page Nav is meant to be implemented via FLUID Page, and should NOT be used as a standalone component.

NOTE: In-Page Nav works best when its "jump links" correspond to large sections of content within the page. When constructing the page's layout, it's recommended to wrap each section of content with a FLUID Container that has a meaningful "id" attribute applied to it. Each FLUID Container "id" attribute should then be set as the "href"/"route" property of a menu item in In-Page Nav's "menuItems" Prop.

props.name: anchor
props.docs: Determines which side of the page that In page nav will be positioned.

props.name: config
props.docs: Allows In page nav's Props to be set via a single configuration object.

props.name: disableAutoScroll
props.docs:
By default, In-Page Nav will automatically scroll to the element
specified by ID in the window's location URL (if one exists) when
the component is loaded. Setting this Prop to "true" will disable
this behavior.

props.name: locationStrategy
props.docs:
Determines how In-Page Nav updates the window's location URL when a
"jump link" is clicked. The "hash" strategy (default) updates the URL's
hash (e.g. "...lmig.com#section-1"), while the "query" strategy
updates the URL's query string (e.g. "...lmig.com?section=section-1").

props.name: menuItems
props.docs:
Array of FluidMenuItem objects used to populate the In-Page Nav.
Each menu item MUST contain a "label" property AND either an "href"
OR "route" property. The "href"/"route" property's value should match
the "id" attribute of a section within the page (with or without
leading "#" character).

props.name: navTitle
props.docs: Custom string title of in-page-nav element

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: queryStringKey
props.docs:
If "locationStrategy" is set to "query", this Prop determines
the query parameter name that will be used to update the URL.

props.name: showAtBreakpoint
props.docs:
Determines the breakpoint/viewport size at which In-Page Nav will be
visible (component will be hidden at sizes smaller than the specified
breakpoint to conserve space). Prop accepts the following
FluidBreakpointName values: "sm" (viewport sizes: ≥480px),
"md" (viewport sizes: ≥768px), "lg" (viewport sizes: ≥992px),
"xl" (viewport sizes: ≥1200px).

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

components.contextData:
FLUID In-Page Nav helps users to understand the contents of a page at a glance, as well as navigate to specific sections of a page via "jump links". The component features a "sticky" Tree Menu positioned on one side of the page containing a list of "jump links" that outline the page's content. Clicking a link will smoothly scroll the page to the corresponding section.

NOTE: In-Page Nav is meant to be implemented via FLUID Page, and should NOT be used as a standalone component.

NOTE: In-Page Nav works best when its "jump links" correspond to large sections of content within the page. When constructing the page's layout, it's recommended to wrap each section of content with a FLUID Container that has a meaningful "id" attribute applied to it. Each FLUID Container "id" attribute should then be set as the "href"/"route" property of a menu item in In-Page Nav's "menuItems" Prop.

changeLog.title: In-Page Nav Created
changeLog.description: Fluid In-Page Nav component created.

changeLog.title: Location Strategy Support
changeLog.description: Added locationStrategy Prop to In-Page Nav that determines how the component updates the window location URL when a "jump link" is clicked. When set to hash, the component will update the location URL's hash with the ID of the "target" page section (e.g. "...lmig.com#section-1"). When set to query, it will update the location URL's query string with the ID of the "target" page section (e.g. "...lmig.com?section=section-1"). The query string "key" can optionally be customized using the queryStringKey Prop (e.g. "...lmig.com?customKey=section-1").

changeLog.title: Performance & Configuration Improvements
changeLog.description: Updated In-Page Nav to be fully compatible with JS framework routing systems. Also improved In-Page Nav's menuItems Prop to allow for a more flexible configuration. The menuItems Prop can now be configured with FluidMenuItem objects that use either the href OR route property (with or without leading # character.

changeLog.title: Refactored In-Page Nav LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored In Page Nav's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

clicked. The field's <input> must have a value for button to be
visible. Button is NOT displayed when field has "required" validation.

props.docs:
When true, this field will automatically have focus on page load.
Note: only one form field should have "autoFocus" set to true
on a page. Multiple fields with "autoFocus: true" can/will cause
unexpected behavior.
