props.name: controlName
props.docs:
A unique name for the field (usually the dataKey for any form using
the input element).

props.name: debounceDelete
props.docs:
Debounces the delete action by the specified time limit.
Useful for preventing functions that act on value change
from firing repeatedly when the user deletes characters.

props.name: disabled
props.docs: If true, Input Field's <input> will be disabled.

props.name: displayStepperButtons
props.docs:
If a number field (i.e. "type" Prop is "number"), controls whether
"stepper buttons" (i.e. "spin buttons") are displayed on desktop
devices.

props.name: fluidTranslate
props.docs: Internationalisation

props.name: formatStrategy
helpText
props.docs:
If provided, Input Field's Form Label will render a "helptext" icon
with attached Popover. To render a basic Popover with default
Prop values, simply provide the Popover's message as a string
value to this Prop. To render a Popover with customized Props,
provide a FluidPopoverConfig object to this Prop with the "message"
property set. For more information, please see Popover's API
documentation.

props.name: htmlAutocomplete
props.docs:
Sets the HTML "autocomplete" attribute on the Input Field's embedded
<input>. Accepts 'on', 'off', or a space-separated <token-list> that
describes the meaning of the autocompletion value. See
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/autocomplete
for more information.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When provided, the "identifier" string will be prepended to
"data-test-id" attributes on Input Field's inner architecture to help
facilitate testing.

props.name: initialValue
props.docs:
Default value to be displayed within Input Field's <input> on first
load. NOTE: this Prop is NOT dynamically updated after initial load
like the "value" Prop is, & cannot be used to update the form field's
value after the first render.
props.typeAliasStructure: FluidPrimitive = string | number | bigint | boolean | symbol | "null" | undefined

props.name: inlineField
props.docs: Removes the form field's default bottom margin.

props.name: label
props.docs:
If provided, a FLUID Form Label will be rendered above the Input
Field with the specified string.

props.name: labelTextOverflow
props.docs:
Sets the Form Label's text overflow behavior. By default, overflowing
label text will be truncated with ellipsis.

props.name: locale
props.docs: Default country code for phone formatting

props.name: maskingConfig
props.docs:
If provided, applies masking function to the form field's <input>
value after the specified time delay.

props.name: maxLength
props.docs:
Sets a maximum length (number of characters) allowed to be entered
in the form field's <input>. NOTE: does not apply to number fields
(i.e. "type" Prop is "number").

props.name: outputType
props.docs:
Determines whether the output value should remain as a string or be
coerced to a number when emitted. NOTE - will only work if `type` is `number`.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: placeholder
props.docs: Optional placeholder text to display within Input Field's <input>.

props.name: readonly
props.docs: If true, Input Field's <input> will be in a "readonly" state.

props.name: roundingMethod
props.docs:
If using the "wholeOnly" Prop, this Prop dictates how decimal values
should be rounded to the nearest whole number (e.g. round up or round
down). Defaults to always rounding down.

props.name: shortHandNumbers
props.docs:
When true, Input Field will accept "shorthand" number abbreviations
as valid input (e.g. '1.2K' => '1200', '3.5M' => '3,500,000', etc).
NOTE: only applies when "type" Prop is "number".

props.name: step
props.docs:
Sets the increment/decrement interval for the input's "stepper" (spin)
buttons or keyboard arrows (i.e. applied to the embedded <input>
element's "step" attribute). NOTE: only applies if "type" Prop is
"number" or "time".

props.name: supplementaryLabel
props.docs:
If provided, a supplementary muted label will be displayed after the
primary Form Label.

changeLog.title: Input Field Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Input Field component created.

changeLog.title: Input Field Updated
changeLog.description: Added disabled and readonly properties to Fluid Input Field component.

changeLog.title: Allows field to mask its value on blur
changeLog.description: Input field component will now take a maskingConfig property (can also be passed via the config property) with two properties - maskingFn and blurDelay. The maskingFn property is a function, which receives the value of the field, and returns a string. This allows the consuming application to be in control of how the field is masked, rather than FLUID dictating that. This will mask the value of the input with whatever is returned from your function on blur (leaving the field), either immediately, or, if you specify the blurDelay property, after however many milliseconds you define.

changeLog.title: Fixed Input Field Placeholder Text :focus Bug
changeLog.description: Fixed issue in Input Field LESS that prevented placeholder text from being hidden on :focus (which was intended functionality). Also added fading transition to placeholder text on :focus.

changeLog.title: Input Field Background Color
changeLog.description: Fixed issue with Input Field LESS that caused it to have a transparent background instead of white.

changeLog.title: Updated Input Field Border & Placeholder Colors
changeLog.description: Previously, Input Field border & placeholder text colors were too light in contrast to a standard white background color, resulting in poor visibility. Both border & placeholder text colors were darkened in each theme to increase visibility and aligned more closely with each theme's look & feel.

changeLog.title: Updated Input Field "Clear/Cancel" Button Accessibility
changeLog.description: Updated several aspects of accessibility for "clear/cancel" button that appears when "allowCancel" @Prop is utilized. Root element is now HTML button element (instead of div) that can receive :focus when navigating via keyboard. When button is clicked, :focus automatically shifts back to the form element (instead of requiring a second click/Tab to navigate). Also, button click target size was increased to 24x24px, making it easier to click. Finally, button icon color was darkened to improve contrast.

changeLog.title: Add maxLength prop
changeLog.description: Input field component will now take a maxLength property (can also be passed via the config property) that will forcethe input to only be at max characters long. This does not work if the type of the input is "number".

changeLog.title: Add autoFocus prop
changeLog.description: autoFocus allows this field to automatically be focused on page load without user action.

changeLog.title: Refactored Input Field Styles & Improved Interaction Design
changeLog.description: Refactored Input Field styles to be consistent with FLUID form field standards.

changeLog.title: Updated Input Field "value" Prop
changeLog.description: Input Field "value" Prop now tracks the form field's current value (i.e. "_elementState.value"). The Prop is dynamically updated to reflect the form field's current state, so it can be used as a "synchronous" alternative to the public async "getValue()" method. If provided on first load, the "value" Prop populates the form field with a default value. After the component is rendered, changes to the Prop will update the form field's value (similar to "setValue()" method). NOTE: "initialValue" will override this Prop on first load if both Props are provided.

changeLog.title: Improved Disabled State Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Input Field disabled state styles for improved readability/legibility.

changeLog.title: Updated Validation Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Input Field's validation error text so that it doesn't cause layout shift when displayed. Also added "fade in" visual effect to error text.

changeLog.title: Refactored Input Field LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Input Field's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update allows the outputFormat feature, previously only available in the context of a form, to be used in standalone mode too.

changeLog.title: "Autofill" Menu Config ("autocomplete" attr)
changeLog.description:
FLUID Input Field now has the ability to configure the autocomplete attribute on its embedded input element via the htmlAutocomplete Prop. This allows developers to specify how browsers should handle the "autofill" dropdown menu that provides suggestions based on previously entered data.

Note: the "autofill" menu is now disabled by default on "standalone" Input Field instances (i.e. not inside FLUID Form), but can be enabled by configuring the htmlAutocomplete Prop. See MDN Docs for the "autocomplete" attribute for configuration information.

changeLog.title: Shorthand Number Input Support
changeLog.description: FLUID Input Field now supports shorthand number abbreviations when type="number" and shortHandNumbers Prop is enabled. Users can enter values like "1.5K" (converts to 1500), "2M" (converts to 2,000,000), or "3B" (converts to 3,000,000,000). The shorthand value is converted to the full numeric value when the field loses focus.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

See https://www.npmjs.com/package/chartjs-plugin-annotations for object info

props.docs:
Takes an array of values for the bars in the chart
Each value is a number array, one per dataset

props.name: chartHeight
props.docs:
Allows the user to set the height of the chart (in px). NOTE:
"maintainAspectRatio" Prop MUST be "false" for this Prop to
take effect.

props.name: chartHoverData
props.docs:
Takes in chart hover data to be rendered as a tooltip.
Each value is a object array, one per dataset

props.name: chartId
props.docs:
A unique identifier for your chart canvas element
Useful to specify for E2E, analytics, etc.
Defaults to a unique 36 char string

props.name: chartLabels
props.docs: Takes an array of string labels for the lines in the chart

props.name: chartTitle
props.docs: When provided, displays a heading title above the chart.

props.name: chartWidth
props.docs:
Allows the user to set the width of the chart (in px). Adjusting
this value will override horizontal auto-resizing. NOTE: this Prop
REQUIRES "chartHeight" Prop to be provided & "maintainAspectRatio"
Prop MUST be "false".

props.name: colorOverride
props.docs:
Allows the user to pass in a custom color scheme for the line graph.
If prop is not given the color scheme will default to styles in FluidChartStyles
When this is set the theme colors will be ignored

props.name: currencySymbol
props.docs:
Allows the user to pass in a unit of currency to prepend to to chart values
Defaults to an empty string if undefined, should you wish to not have currency in your units

props.name: datasetOverrides
props.docs:
Allows the user to pass dataset-specific overrides.
Includes 'fill' (boolean if the line should be filled) and 'dashed' (a list of numbers indicating length of lines and spaces in desired dash pattern).

props.name: hasBackground
props.docs:
When provided, adds a white background with subtle drop shadow
to the chart's container.

props.name: hasLegend
props.docs: Lets the user decide if they want a legend

props.name: label
props.docs: A label to describe the data units in the chart (required).

props.name: legendLabels
props.docs:
Allows user to feed in a double array to allow for a legend of different types
Example:
[["Flood, Hail, EM", "Low", "Moderate", "High", "Severe"],["Wind", "None", "Tier 2", "Tier 1", "Tier 1 - Florida"]]
This will produce a 2 level legend with 2 sets of corresponding categories, from left to right
The first legendLabels[n][0] will always be the name for that category

Unlocking the aspect ratio will allow for the adjustment of width and height.
Defaults to true (aspect ratio locked).

docsTags.text: FLUID Linear Progress is an animated visual indicator that a process, task, or progress is currently underway. It can be indeterminate, which means that it does not express a specific wait time or display loading progress, or determinate, which means that it does indicate progress toward completion / how long a process will take.

props.name: config
props.docs: Allows all Props to be set via a single configuration object.

props.name: determinate
props.docs:
Determines whether Linear Progress is a determinate or indeterminate
indicator. Linear Progress is indeterminate by default, which means
that it will NOT indicate wait time / time to completion (e.g.
attempting to reconnect to a server). When this Prop is true, Linear
Progress will be a determinate indicator, meaning that it WILL show
progress toward completion / how long a process will take to finish
(e.g., downloading a file of a known size).

props.name: label
props.docs: Optional descriptive title/label to be displayed above the progress bar.

props.name: labelId
props.docs:
If "label" Prop is provided, overrides the label element's default "id"
attribute value.

props.name: max
props.docs:
For determinate Linear Progress, sets the maximum value on the progress
bar. When the "value" Prop equals the "max" Prop, the progress bar will
be shown as full/complete.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: type
props.docs:
For determinate Linear Progress, sets the data format that the
current value should display.

props.name: value
props.docs:
For determinate Linear Progress, sets the current progress/completion
status toward the "max" Prop value.

props.name: weight
props.docs:
Sets the Linear Progress component's "line weight" (i.e. the height
& thickness of the progress bar).

docsTags.text:
FLUID Link is a navigational element used to direct users to a URL, section of a page, or file download. Links can appear inline within sentences or paragraphs, or on their own as standalone elements.

NOTE: Link supports the following native HTML attributes: "download", "rel", "ping", "referrerpolicy", "tabindex", "title", & "role". When applied to the root "fluid-link" element, these attributes will be "tunneled" through the component's shadow root & applied to the underlying anchor tag.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: - Text / content displayed within the Link's <a> tag

props.name: center
props.docs:
When true, Link will appear center-aligned within its container.
NOTE: this Prop cannot be used when "inline" Prop is true.

props.name: colorScheme
props.docs:
Sets a Link's text color
to "light" or "dark" for increased contrast when displayed on a color
background. For example, if your Link is displayed on a DARK
BLUE background, set this Prop's value to "light" so that the text
color will be white (instead of the default blue). If your
Link is displayed on a YELLOW background, set this Prop's value to
"dark" so that the label will be dark gray (instead of the default
blue). Do NOT change this Prop's value if your Link is
displayed on a WHITE background.

props.name: disabled
props.docs: When true, Link will be disabled.

props.name: href
props.docs:
NOTE: use this Prop INSTEAD OF "route" when Link should be a
standard <a> element (anchor tag) & navigation should NOT be
handled by the consuming application's router. Sets the URL to
navigate to when the Link is clicked.

props.name: iconAfter
props.docs:
When provided, Link will render a FLUID Icon to the RIGHT of its
slotted content.

props.name: iconBefore
props.docs:
When provided, Link will render a FLUID Icon to the LEFT of its
slotted content.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the link component in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: inline
props.docs:
When true, Link will be styled as an inline element with regular
font weight & an underline. When false (default), Link will be
styled as a "standalone" element (i.e. display: flex;) with bold
font weight & no underline (except on :hover). Inline styles
should be used for Links within text blocks or Tables.

props.name: interactionElement
props.docs: The type of interaction element to report for observability.

props.name: link
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "link" is now deprecated. Instead, use "href" Prop for
standard <a> tag functionality, or use "route" Prop for navigation
handled by the consuming application's router. -- The URL / route to
navigate to when the Link is clicked. When "useNative" Prop is TRUE,
this Prop's value must be a valid URL. When "useNative" Prop is FALSE,
navigation will NOT occur automatically & will need to be handled
via the consuming application's router.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: route
props.docs:
NOTE: use this Prop INSTEAD OF "href" when navigation should be
handled by the consuming application's router (i.e. equivalent to
Angular's "routerLink" or React's <Link to="...">). Sets the route
to be emitted via the "linkClicked" Event when the Link is clicked.

props.name: target
props.docs:
Specifies where to open the Link. "_blank" opens the link in a new
window or tab. "_self" opens the link in the same frame as it was
clicked (default). "_parent" opens the link in the parent frame.
"_top" opens the link in the full body of the window.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: type
props.docs:
If Link is an email address or phone number, specifies the Link's
behavior when clicked. "email" will add a "mailto:" prefix to the
Link's "href" attribute, & will open the user's native email client
when clicked. "tel" will add a "tel:" prefix to the Link's "href"
attribute, & will open the user's native phone or VoIP application
when clicked. NOTE: this Prop MUST be used with the "href" Prop
(NOT the "route" Prop).

props.name: useNative
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "useNative" is now deprecated. Instead, use "href"
Prop for standard <a> tag functionality, or use "route" Prop for
navigation handled by the consuming application's router. -- When
true, Link will behave as a native HTML <a> tag and will direct the
browser to the configured link (i.e. via "href" attr). Set to false
to handle routing internally.

events.docs: Emits "route" or "href" Prop value when Link is clicked.

Emits "route" and "href" prop values, along with the original click event,
when Link is clicked.

Useful for properly handling control-clicks when using the "route" prop.

slots.docs: Text / content displayed within the Link's <a> tag

changeLog.title: Adds "target" Prop
changeLog.description: FLUID Link will now accept a "target" property of "_blank", "_self", "_top", or "_parent", and render the anchor link as the native version would.

changeLog.title: Adds native HTML attribute tunneling
changeLog.description: Adds native HTML attribute tunneling that applies any supported native HTML attributes to the underlying anchor tag. This allows for accessibility enhancements to be configured without additional Props added to the FLUID component.

changeLog.title: Added "href" & "route" Props
changeLog.description: Added "href" & "route" Props to Link & deprecated "link" & "useNative" Props. This change brings simpler, more intuitive Prop names to Link that are more consistent with Prop naming conventions in other FLUID components. For "standard" anchor tags (NOT handled by the consuming app's router), use the "href" Prop. For Links that SHOULD use the consuming app's router for navigation, use the "route" Prop (i.e. equivalent to using "link" Prop with "useNative: false") NOTE: the "linkClicked" Event will still be emitted when Link is clicked, regardless of whether the Link's navigation URL is supplied to the "href" or "route" Prop.

changeLog.title: Added "type" Prop (Open in Email/Phone/VoIP App)
changeLog.description: Added "type" Prop to Link for email or phone hyperlinks. When "type" is set to "email", Link will launch native email application when clicked. When "type" is set to "tel", Link will launch native phone/VoIP application when clicked.

changeLog.title: Added Support for Embedded Icons
changeLog.description: Added "iconBefore" & "iconAfter" Props to Link that display embedded FLUID Icons to the left/right of Link text.

changeLog.title: Expanded Support for Native HTML Attributes
changeLog.description: Link now supports the following native HTML attributes: "rel", "ping", "referrerpolicy", "tabindex", "title", & "role". When applied to the root "fluid-link" tag, these attributes will be "tunneled" through the component's shadow root & applied to the underlying anchor tag.

changeLog.title: Style Updates for "Standalone" & "Inline" Links
changeLog.description: Updated styles to differentiate between "standalone Links" (default) & "inline Links". Standalone Links (default) have bold font weight & do NOT have an underline (except on hover) - they're meant to be used independently or within a list. Inline Links display as "inline-block" elements, have regular font weight, & DO have an underline (except on hover) - they're meant to be used within text blocks or within Table cells.

changeLog.title: Accessibility Updates for Link
changeLog.description: Fixed "standalone" (default) Link click target size - while component still displays as a "block" element, the underlying anchor tag's clickable area is now limited to the width of the Link text itself. Updated "disabled" Link styles & fixed color contrast accessibility issues. Updated Link's "aria" accessibility attributes.

docsTags.text:
FLUID Loading Spinner is an animated visual indication that loading is underway.
It is indeterminate, which means that it does not express a specific wait time or display loading progress.
Loading Spinner has multiple sizes available, as well as 2 style variations & an option to display a "loading message" beneath the Spinner. It can also be implemented as a container that blocks access to its content while loading.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: - Content that is loading. All children of this slot will be inaccessible while "loading" Prop is true. NOTE: "container" Prop MUST be true to enable this slot. See documentation for "container" & "loading" Props for more information.

props.name: centered
props.docs: If true, Spinner will be horizontally centered within its container.

props.name: circleType
props.docs: Sets the Loading Spinner's aesthetic style & animation behavior.

props.name: config
props.docs:
Single configuration object to populate Spinner (instead of using
individual Props).

props.name: container
props.docs:
NOTE: this Prop MUST be used in conjunction with the "loading" Prop.
When true, Loading Spinner will be rendered as a container for slotted
content (i.e. enables Loading Spinner's slot). As long as the "loading"
Prop is true, the Spinner will be displayed on top of its slotted content
& all child elements will be inaccessible. When the "loading" Prop is
false (or undefined), the Spinner will be hidden & all slotted children
will be accessible (i.e. Loading Spinner becomes a standard <div>).

props.name: height
props.docs:
When loading spinner is used as a blocking container, us this prop to set
a minimum pixel height for the blocking spinner, so it can take up an
appropriate amount of space on your page until whatever content you are loading
can be loaded.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the loading spinner in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: loading
props.docs:
When true, Spinner will be visible & slotted content will be blocked /
inaccessible. When false, Spinner will NOT be displayed, & slotted child
elements WILL be accessible (see "container" Prop documentation for more
info). NOTE: if "container" Prop is FALSE, this Prop is OPTIONAL & will
NOT affect the Spinner's visibility if undefined (i.e. Spinner will always
be visible until removed from the DOM). However, if "container" Prop is
TRUE, this Prop is REQUIRED to display the Spinner (i.e. Spinner will
NOT be visible if this Prop is left undefined).

props.name: loadingMessage
props.docs: If provided, displays a message string beneath the Loading Spinner.

props.name: muted
props.docs:
If true, the loading spinner will be a smaller, more muted spinner. This is
useful for inline loading spinners, where the standard size and colour may be
too much for the container.

props.name: overlay
props.docs:
NOTE: this Prop MUST be used in conjunction with the "loading" Prop.
When true, Loading Spinner will be rendered as a full-page overlay
that covers the entire FLUID Content area (i.e. from beneath the Header
& Context Bar down to the bottom of the page). As long as the "loading"
Prop is true, the Spinner will block access to all page content &
background scrolling will be disabled. When the "loading" Prop is
false (or undefined), the Spinner will be hidden, all background
elements will be accessible, & page scrolling will be re-enabled.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: size
props.docs:
Sets the overall size of the Loading Spinner. Accepts all FluidSize
values EXCEPT "xxs" & "full".

props.name: spinnerId
props.docs:
Set a unique spinner ID. If there are multiple spinners on a single page,
this can be useful when dynamically toggling their loading state.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: verticalPadding
props.docs:
Sets top & bottom padding of Loading Spinner container. If provided,
overrides default 1em top/bottom padding. FluidSize values equate
to preset pixel values, decimal numbers between 0 and 1 equate to percent
values, whole numbers greater than 1 equate to pixel values, and
strings are outputted directly as inline style values (NOTE: strings
should contain valid CSS units - i.e. 'px', '%', 'em', 'vh', etc.).

slots.docs: Content that is loading. All children of this slot will be inaccessible while "loading" Prop is true. NOTE: "container" Prop MUST be true to enable this slot. See documentation for "container" & "loading" Props for more information.

components.contextData:
FLUID Loading Spinner is an animated visual indication that loading is underway.
It is indeterminate, which means that it does not express a specific wait time or display loading progress.
Loading Spinner has multiple sizes available, as well as 2 style variations & an option to display a "loading message" beneath the Spinner. It can also be implemented as a container that blocks access to its content while loading.
components.slot: - Content that is loading. All children of this slot will be inaccessible while "loading" Prop is true. NOTE: "container" Prop MUST be true to enable this slot. See documentation for "container" & "loading" Props for more information.

changeLog.title: Loading Spinner Created
changeLog.description: Fluid Loading Spinner component created.

changeLog.title: Updated Loading Spinner Styles & Theme Aesthetics
changeLog.description: Updated Loading Spinner theme aesthetics to match the overall look & feel of each theme. Updated line weight & font size to be proportional to "size" Prop value. Also fixed color contrast accessibility issues & "centered" text alignment bug.

changeLog.title: Updated Loading Spinner "loading" & "verticalPadding" Props
changeLog.description: Updated Loading Spinner "loading" Prop to hide/show Spinner even when "container" Prop is false. Also Updated Loading Spinner "verticalPadding" Prop to accept "FluidSize", string, or number values (similar to FLUID Container).

changeLog.title: Fixed Loading Spinner Slot Z-Index Bug
changeLog.description: Fixed bug where slotted children could appear above Loading Spinner's overlay.

changeLog.title: Updated Loading Spinner "aria" Attributes
changeLog.description: Updated & fixed invalid Loading Spinner "aria" attributes.

changeLog.title: Overhauled Loading Spinner Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Refactored Loading Spinner usage examples to cover all Prop configurations.

changeLog.title: Refactored Loading Spinner Unit Tests
changeLog.description: Refactored Loading Spinner unit tests & functional component unit tests.

changeLog.title: Refactored Loading Spinner LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Loading Spinner stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Added "Overlay" Prop to Loading Spinner
changeLog.description: Added "overlay" prop to display loading spinner as a full-page overlay with semi-transparent backdrop that blocks user interaction until loading completes.

changeLog.title: Improved Size Normalization on DOM Reconnection
changeLog.description: Enhanced Loading Spinner to normalize invalid size values when component reconnects to DOM after conditional rendering. The normalizeSize() method now runs in connectedCallback(), componentWillLoad(), and via @Watch("size") to ensure size values are always valid.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation
changeLog.description: Instrumented FLUID Matrix Questions for observability using the FLUID Observability Provider pattern. Tracks selection clicks on matrix question response options.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
FLUID Modal is a dialog box that displays content in a layer above the rest of the page. Modals are meant to interrupt the user's workflow and focus their attention on a particular task or piece of information. While open, the user cannot interact with the underlying page until the modal has been dismissed.

Modals should be used sparingly for short or infrequent tasks such as editing or management tasks. If a task must be repeatedly performed, it should be done from the main page.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: action-set - Named slot for Modal action buttons. Only available when "modalActions" Prop is NOT used

props.name: actionsDisabled
props.docs:
When true, all action buttons will be disabled EXCEPT for those
with "enableOnModalDisabled" property set to true. NOTE: If you need
a Modal to complete an action before closing, set this to true while
that action completes.

props.name: autoFocus
props.docs:
When true, Modal will automatically transfer :focus to the first
child element that can receive :focus when opened. NOTE: Modal
must have at least one slotted child element that can receive
:focus for this Prop to function correctly.

props.name: disableBackgroundScroll
props.docs:
Whether to disable background page scrolling while Modal is open.
If false, page behind Modal will be allowed to scroll. NOTE: this
Prop SHOULD be enabled if possible for best user experience.

props.name: disableFocusTrap
props.docs:
By default, Modal will "trap" :focus when open (i.e. Modal will
prevent :focus from escaping its children via tab navigation).
This Prop will disable "focus trap" functionality when true.

props.name: disableTopDocumentIFrameShift
props.docs:
When true, prevents Modal from promoting itself within the DOM
to the top document level in an attempt to escape an <iframe>.
This default behavior is not desireable in some scenarios and
causes rendering issues.

props.name: hideCloseIcon
props.docs:
When true, removes Modal's "close" button. NOTE: This should be used
with caution - if you haven't set up a "close" action button with
corresponding event listener OR enabled "outsideClickClose", you
won't be able to close the Modal!

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the modal in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: limitOverflow
props.docs:
When TRUE, limits Modal's max-height to 70% & allows internal
scrolling within the Modal's body, but also truncates any content
that overflows the edges of the Modal container (such as Popovers).
When FALSE, Modal's height will be dictated by the height of its
content, and content WILL be allowed to display outside the Modal
container edges without truncation (see usage examples).

props.name: modalActions
props.docs:
Populates the Modal's action buttons. If this Prop is provided &
"outsideClickClose" is set to false, the Modal will be considered
an "action Modal" and will validate that 1 primary action exists
and at least 1 secondary action exists. Each action button emits an
"actionClicked" event containing its given "eventKey" when clicked.
If this Prop is NOT provided, Modal will render an "action-set"
named Slot.

props.name: modalTitle
props.docs: Text to be displayed in Modal header title.

props.name: open
props.docs: Controls whether Modal is visible (true) or hidden (false).

props.name: outsideClickClose
props.docs:
When true, clicking anywhere outside the Modal body container
(i.e. anywhere on the backdrop overlay) will close it. NOTE: If
your Modal requires users to complete an action/task before close,
you should set this Prop to false.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: shouldDisableClose
props.docs:
Disables Modal's "close" button IF this Prop is true AND
"actionsDisabled" Prop is true as well (i.e. both Props must be true
for "close" button to be disabled).

props.name: size
props.docs: Sets the size of the Modal container.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: transparentOverlay
props.docs:
When true, Modal's backdrop overlay will be transparent instead
of translucent.

methods.name: toggleModal
methods.docs:
Opens or closes the Modal. If parameter is not provided, sets "open"
Prop to the inverse of its current value.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: open - whether Modal should be open (true) or closed (false)

methods.name: toggleModalOpen
methods.docs:
DEPRECATED: "toggleModalOpen" is now deprecated. Instead, use the
"toggleModal" Prop (same functionality, just a different naming
convention) -- Opens or closes the Modal. If parameter is not
provided, sets "open" Prop to the inverse of its current value.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: open - whether Modal should be open (true) or closed (false)

events.docs:
Event emitted when an action button is clicked. Contains the
action's "eventKey" property (FluidModalAction).
Event emitted when Modal is closed.
Event emitted when Modal is closed via outside click.

slots.docs: Content displayed within the Modal

components.contextData:
FLUID Modal is a dialog box that displays content in a layer above the rest of the page. Modals are meant to interrupt the user's workflow and focus their attention on a particular task or piece of information. While open, the user cannot interact with the underlying page until the modal has been dismissed.

Modals should be used sparingly for short or infrequent tasks such as editing or management tasks. If a task must be repeatedly performed, it should be done from the main page.
components.slot: action-set - Named slot for Modal action buttons. Only available when "modalActions" Prop is NOT used

changeLog.title: Modal Created
changeLog.description: Fluid Modal component created.

changeLog.title: Added ability to turn off content overflow limits
changeLog.description: Added `limitOverflow` Prop ("true" by default) that constrains Modal height and enables internal scrolling. The downside to `limitOverflow` is that it prevents absolutely-positioned components (e.g. Popover) within the Modal from displaying outside the bounds of the Modal container. To allow Modal children (like Popovers) to display outside the bounds of the Modal without being truncated, set `limitOverflow` to "false". If `limitOverflow` is set to "true", the maximum height of the Modal will be 70% of the viewport height, and overflowing content is scrollable within the Modal. If `limitOverflow` is set to "false", and the height of the Modal is greater than the height of the viewport, the entire Modal will be scrollable within the full-screen overlay.

changeLog.title: Minor Updates to Modal Architecture and Styles
changeLog.description: Adjusted Modal HTML architecture so that all elements within Modal are relatively positioned (instead of absolutely positioned). Also swapped SVG dismiss icon for FLUID Icon.

changeLog.title: Minor Update to Modal Hide/Show Styles
changeLog.description: In certain instances, Modal content could potentially cover parts of the DOM (even though opacity/visiblity set to hide content). This update sets Modal parent container to "display: none;" after fade aimation completes.

changeLog.title: Minor Update to handle xx-small, x-small, x-large, and xx-large modal directives
changeLog.description: We should be able to handle any valid FluidSize value passed to the modal.

changeLog.title: Update Title When Attribute Changes
changeLog.description: Previously the title attribute was only read once on load and updates to it were ignored. Now the title of the modal will be kept in sync with the attribute "title".

changeLog.title: Update Actions to Accept Icon Before/After
changeLog.description: The actions can now accept an iconBefore and iconAfter to display in the action buttons.

changeLog.title: Added Focus Trap Functionality to Modal
changeLog.description: Modal now prevents :focus from leaving its children while open. Focus will "loop" between the last tabbable child and the first tabbable child instead of returning to the underlying page. When Modal is closed, :focus is restored to the element that was active before Modal was opened.

changeLog.title: Added Prop that Disables Background Page Scrolling
changeLog.description: Added "disableBackgroundScroll" Prop to Modal - when true, prevents background page scrolling when Modal is open.

changeLog.title: Added Min/Max Widths to Modal (All Sizes)
changeLog.description: Updated Modal to have minimum/maximum width regardless of "size" @Prop value.

changeLog.title: Escape Key Closes Modal & Other Accessibility Updates
changeLog.description: Added support for closing Modal via "escape" key (UNLESS "outsideClickClose" is disabled AND "close" button is disabled/hidden). Also implemented "aria" attributes to Modal for screen reader support.

changeLog.title: Added Complete Set of Modal Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Added Modal usage examples for all major @Props & common use cases.

changeLog.title: Added Prop that Disables Focus Trap
changeLog.description: Added "disableFocusTrap" Prop to Modal - when true, prevents Modal from "trapping" :focus (i.e. allows elements outside of Modal to receive :focus via tab navigation).

changeLog.title: Added Modal autoFocus Prop
changeLog.description: Added Prop "autoFocus" to Modal that automatically transfers :focus to the first child element that can receive :focus when the Modal is opened (instead of :focus being transferred to the Modal container). Useful for Modals containing form elements. NOTE: Modal must have at least one slotted child element that can receive :focus for this Prop to function correctly.

changeLog.title: Improved "Close" Button Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Modal's "close" button color fill to meet WCAG AA contrast spec.

changeLog.title: Adds i18n Strategy
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to configure FLUID modal to accept message translations (MVP)

changeLog.title: Added Prop that Disables promotion of Modal to top document when inside an iframe.
changeLog.description: Added "disableTopDocumentIFrameShift" Prop to Modal - when true, prevents Modal from promoting itself within the DOM to the top document level in an attempt to escape an iframe. This default behavior is not desireable in some scenarios and causes rendering issues.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
FLUID Page is a foundational component that provides the root architecture for all page content. It's also responsible for Sidebar implementation, and manages the layout structure of page content in relation to the Sidebar(s).

FLUID Page should be implemented ONCE per page at the ROOT of the page body (typically as a sibling of FLUID Header & FLUID Footer), & should NOT be used for micro-UIs (unless the micro-UI is used as the page's root).

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: - Content displayed within the page body

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: left-sidebar-content - Named slot for left Sidebar content (only available if "leftSidebarConfig" Prop defined)

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: right-sidebar-content - Named slot for right Sidebar content (only available if "rightSidebarConfig" Prop defined)

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: page-context-bar - Named slot for Page Context Bar component (only necessary if Page Context Bar is not a direct child of FLUID Page)

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: page-fab - Named slot for "Floating Action Button" (FAB) positioned in the bottom-right corner of the viewport

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: page-footer - Named slot for "sticky" content along the bottom of the viewport (DO NOT implement FLUID Footer in this slot)

props.name: hasSidebar
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "hasSidebar" is now deprecated. Instead, use
"leftSidebarConfig" or "rightSidebarConfig" Props. -- Renders left
Sidebar when true.

props.name: inPageNavConfig
props.docs:
When provided, FLUID Page will render In-Page Navigation (aka "table
of contents") on one side of the page.

props.name: leftSidebarConfig
props.docs:
Left sidebar config object: setting this will cause a left Sidebar
to be rendered, regardless if an array of FluidMenuItems is included.
Leaving it unset (default) means the left Sidebar will NOT be rendered.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: pageFooterDropShadow
props.docs:
When true, adds a subtle drop shadow to the "page-footer" slot. NOTE:
"page-footer" slot MUST be used for this to take effect.

props.name: pageTitle
props.docs: When provided, displays a title above slotted FLUID Page content.

props.name: rightSidebarConfig
props.docs:
Right sidebar config object: setting this will cause a right Sidebar
to be rendered, regardless if an array of FluidMenuItems is included.
Leaving it unset (default) means the right Sidebar will NOT be rendered.

props.name: sidebarLinks
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "sidebarLinks" is now deprecated. Instead, use
"leftSidebarConfig" or "rightSidebarConfig" Prop with "menuItems"
property set. -- Array of FluidMenuItems to be rendered within
the left Sidebar.

props.name: sidebarOpen
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "sidebarOpen" is now deprecated. Instead, use
"leftSidebarConfig" or "rightSidebarConfig" Prop with "visible"
property set. -- Whether the left Sidebar should render as
open/expanded by default.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: themePalette
props.docs:
When provided, adjusts the current theme's color palette & appearance.
NOTE: a theme palette acts as a "style override" applied ON TOP of
the current theme & isn't necessary for "standard" theme aesthetics.

props.name: themeVariant
props.docs:
Sets page background color depending on variation chosen. NOTE: currently
only supports "atmospheric white" background color.

methods.name: getTreeMenuRef
methods.docs:
Returns reference to embedded FLUID Tree Menu component within the
specified Sidebar. This allows public methods to be called on Tree
Menus embedded within the component's Shadow DOM. NOTE: Sidebar
MUST be configured via "leftSidebarConfig"/"rightSidebarConfig" Prop
AND Tree Menu must be configured via "treeMenuConfig" or "menuItems"
property of Sidebar's config object to use this method.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: anchor - which Sidebar's Tree Menu element to return

events.docs:
DEPRECATED: The "sidebarLinkClicked" event is now deprecated.
Instead, listen for "menuItemClick" from the FLUID Tree Menu
component. -- Event emitted when a menu item within a Sidebar
Tree Menu is clicked.

components.contextData:
FLUID Page is a foundational component that provides the root architecture for all page content. It's also responsible for Sidebar implementation, and manages the layout structure of page content in relation to the Sidebar(s).

FLUID Page should be implemented ONCE per page at the ROOT of the page body (typically as a sibling of FLUID Header & FLUID Footer), & should NOT be used for micro-UIs (unless the micro-UI is used as the page's root).
components.slot: page-footer - Named slot for "sticky" content along the bottom of the viewport (DO NOT implement FLUID Footer in this slot)

changeLog.title: Page Component Added
changeLog.description: Fluid page component created.

changeLog.title: Change "sidebarOpen" from State() to Prop()
changeLog.description: Allows Sidebar to be open on page load.

changeLog.title: Add Right Sidebar Compatibility
changeLog.description: Updated FLUID Page to handle right Sidebar.

changeLog.title: Refactor Sidebar Implementation
changeLog.description: Deprecated Props "hasSidebar", "sidebarLinks", "sidebarOpen" - instead, use "leftSidebarConfig" and/or "rightSidebarConfig". Added deprecated Props warning. Cleaned up support for dual Sidebars. Removed "sidebarLinkClicked" Event() - listen for menuItemClick in FLUID Tree Menu instead.

changeLog.title: Refactor Sidebar Layout
changeLog.description: Changed layout used with Sidebar components. Before, FLUID Content used Props to set a margin offset for open/closed Sidebar(s), & FLUID Sidebars were absolutely positioned. Now, FLUID Page utilizes a flexbox layout for Sidebar(s) that does not require any Props/Events to be set on FLUID Content in order to open/close the Sidebar(s). Removed top margin when FLUID Header Actions are present.

changeLog.title: Updates & Bug Fixes
changeLog.description: Removed "...SidebarOpen" States from FLUID Page (caused unnecessary re-renders every time Sidebar(s) toggled). Added functionality to check for Sidebar(s) existence on update, then apply flexbox layout to root element if necessary (fixes "disappearing" right Sidebar issue). Fixed failure to update/re-render when deprecated Props updated.

changeLog.title: Fixed "Inner Scroll" Issue
changeLog.description: Fixed "inner scroll" issue that caused page to scroll 2-3px & stop before allowing scrolling to continue.

changeLog.title: Added FLUID Page Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Added basic usage examples for FLUID Page.

changeLog.title: Dynamic Page Height
changeLog.description: Fixed bug in FLUID Page that prevented page body from being 100% of overall page height and/or caused themeVariant: atmospheric to display extraneous "white space" at the bottom of the page. Now, Page dynamically calculates its `min-height` so that total page height is ALWAYS at least 100% of viewport height. This also fixes a bug that caused Footer to "float" above the bottom of the page or be displayed below the fold (depending on Footer content) when page content is shorter than the viewport height.

changeLog.title: Responsive Container Padding
changeLog.description: Added responsive styles to FLUID Page that reduce the body container padding by 1/2 at tablet/mobile viewport sizes - this gives additional horizontal screen real estate at smaller screen sizes.

changeLog.title: In-Page Nav Support
changeLog.description: Added support for FLUID In-Page Nav to FLUID Page. Page can now be configured with a "table of contents" style navigation that provides "jump links" to sections within Page.

changeLog.title: Refactored Page LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Pages stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Page Context Bar Support
changeLog.description: FLUID Page now supports a "sticky" page-context-bar slot for FLUID Page Context Bar. See Page Context Bar documentation for details.

changeLog.title: "Sticky" Page Footer Slot
changeLog.description:
FLUID Page now supports a "sticky" page-footer slot for content displayed along the bottom of the viewport, such as a "floating toolbar". See FLUID Page's usage examples for implementation tips.

NOTE: DO NOT implement FLUID Footer within this slot, as it results in an invalid HTML structure. FLUID Footer should be implemented as a SIBLING of FLUID Page, NOT as a child of FLUID Page.

changeLog.title: Theme Palette Support
changeLog.description: Added themePalette Prop to FLUID Page that allows selective color/aesthetic "style overrides" for embedded Sidebar to be applied on top of the currently applied theme.

changeLog.title: getTreeMenuRef() Method
changeLog.description: Added public getTreeMenuRef() Method to FLUID Page that returns the embedded Tree Menu element within the specified Sidebar (when configured via treeMenuConfig or menuItems in leftSidebarConfig or rightSidebarConfig). This is useful for calling public methods on Tree Menu instances that are managed/rendered by FLUID Page, as they are not directly accessible otherwise (i.e. they're nested within Page's & Sidebar's Shadow DOMs).

changeLog.title: Floating Action Button (FAB) Slot
changeLog.description: FLUID Page now supports a fixed-position page-fab slot for displaying a "floating action button" in the bottom-right corner of the UI. See usage examples for implementation demo.

docsTags.text:
FLUID Page Context Bar is a versatile component designed to provide supplemental contextual information related to the current page or section of an application. It is displayed below FLUID Header and remains "sticky", staying visible as the user scrolls down the page.

The component is divided into two sections: the "body" and the "context panel". The "body" section is always visible, and should be used for important information that should be displayed upfront. The "context panel" is an optional expandable panel that can be toggled open or closed by the user. The "context panel" is intended to display additional information that is not critical to the user's primary task, but may be useful for reference.

Page Context Bar MUST be implemented as a child of FLUID Page. It is not intended to be used as a standalone component. When implemented as a DIRECT child of FLUID Page, the component does not require a slot attribute. However, if Page Context Bar is implemented as a child of another component/element (e.g. within a micro-UI), its top-most parent that is a direct child of FLUID Page must have the attribute slot="page-context-bar".

If not provided, toggles to the opposite of current state.

docsTags.text:
FLUID Paginator allows users to efficiently navigate large data sets (such as Table rows) by breaking them into smaller, more manageable pages.

When the user interacts with the Paginator, a "pageChanged" Event is emitted that can be used to update any associated data view.

props.name: currentPage
props.docs:
The page shown as "selected" by default on first render.
NOTE: this number is a zero-based index (i.e. "0" is the first page).

props.name: dataItems
props.docs:
Array of objects whose length determines the # of pages shown
in the Paginator.

props.name: defaultPageSize
props.docs:
Sets the default number of items per page. Accepts a number
or the string 'total' to show all items.

props.name: displayDensity
props.docs: Adjusts Paginator's font, padding, spacing, etc. to be more or less compact.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the paginator in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: isTotalItemsDisabled
props.docs:
When true, "total items" (last item of the select box) will not
be an option.

props.name: itemsPerPageOptions
props.docs:
Array of numbers to be shown as page size options in the
"items per page" dropdown menu.

props.name: itemsPerPageTemplate
props.docs: Allows custom items per page wording to be rendered

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: rangeIndicatorTemplate
props.docs: Allows custom range indicator wording to be rendered

props.name: showFirstButton
props.docs:
If true, Paginator will display a "jump to first page" button
before the "previous page" navigation button.

props.name: showLastButton
props.docs:
If true, Paginator will display a "jump to last page" button
after the "next page" navigation button.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

methods.name: goToNextPage
methods.docs: Go to the next page (if not already on the last page).

methods.name: goToPreviousPage
methods.docs: Go to the previous page (if not already on the first page).

methods.name: setItemsPerPage
methods.docs: Sets the page size to the given number, or 'total' to show all items.

methods.name: setPage
methods.docs:
Sets the Paginator's page to the given page number.
Note - page numbers are zero-indexed, where 0 is the first page.

events.docs:
Event fired when a new page is selected within Paginator.
Emits the derived FluidPaginationState object.

Event fired when the user manually selects a new "items per page"
value or when "setItemsPerPage()" is called. Emits the new page
size number or "total" if all items are being shown.

When the user interacts with the Paginator, a "pageChanged" Event is emitted that can be used to update any associated data view.

changeLog.title: Paginator Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Paginator component created & basic functionality implemented using FLUID Button.

changeLog.title: Paginator Refactored
changeLog.description: Paginator functionality & architecture refactored. Added functionality to truncate total # of page navigation buttons shown with ellipsis. Added @Props for optional "jump to first page" & "jump to last page" buttons. Implemented FLUID Select for "items per page" dropdown menu. Added theme-specific Icons to Paginator previous/next & first/last controls.

changeLog.title: Paginator Style / Theme Updates
changeLog.description: Updated Paginator look & feel to be similar to Material Paginator, added theme-specific styles & layouts, and added LM Corporate theme support.

changeLog.title: Paginator Accessibility Updates
changeLog.description: Improved Paginator keyboard navigation, added appropriate "aria" tags, improved :hover & :focus state styles, & optimized component for screen reader support.

changeLog.title: Paginator Tests Updated
changeLog.description: Rewrote Paginator "render" tests according to new architecture & theme integration.

changeLog.title: Paginator added Internationalization
changeLog.description: Added Internationalization for paginator props and aria-labels

changeLog.title: Refactored Paginator LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Paginator stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Support for "total" Page Size
changeLog.description: Updated Paginator's defaultPageSize Prop & setItemsPerPage() method to accept "total" value, which causes all items to be displayed on a single page.

changeLog.title: "pageSizeChanged" Event
changeLog.description: Added new pageSizeChanged Event to Paginator that is emitted when the user manually selects a new "items per page" value or when setItemsPerPage() is called. Emits the new page size number or "total" if all items are being shown.

changeLog.title: Compact Display Density
changeLog.description: Added displayDensity Prop to Paginator that adjusts font size & nav button style to be more or less compact.

docsTags.text: FLUID Pie Chart is a data visualization component used to show how parts of a data set add up to a total value. It is typically used to illustrate numerical proportions and percentages.

props.name: chartData
props.docs:
Array of numbers for chart values. The chart will calculate
the relative percentage

props.name: chartHeight
props.docs: Lets the user decide the height of the chart

props.name: chartHoverData
props.docs:
Array of objects to handle any possible data required
for the hover tooltip

props.name: chartId
props.docs:
A unique identifier for your chart canvas element
Useful to specify for E2E, analytics, etc.
Defaults to a unique 36 char string

props.name: chartLabels
props.docs: Array of labels for each chart value

props.name: chartTitle
props.docs: When provided, displays a heading title above the chart.

props.name: chartType
props.docs:
Allows the user to change the chart type to either "pie" (default)
or "doughnut";

props.name: chartWidth
props.docs: Lets the user decide the width of the chart

props.name: colorOverride
props.docs:
Allows the user to pass in a custom color scheme for the line graph.
If prop is not given the color scheme will default to styles in FluidChartStyles
When this is set the theme colors will be ignored

props.name: hasBackground
props.docs:
When provided, adds a white background with subtle drop shadow
to the chart's container.

props.name: hasDataLabels
props.docs:
Lets the user decide if they want a label
Defaults to true

props.name: hasLegend
props.docs: Lets the user decide if they want a legend

props.name: legendFontTextSize
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "legendFontTextSize" is now deprecated. Legend font
size is now responsive & is calculated based on the width of the

docsTags.text: FLUID Popover is a floating, non-actionable dialog meant to display a small amount of supplemental or contextual information without interrupting a user's workflow. Popover is always attached to a "trigger" element (such as an Icon, Badge, or Button) that opens the dialog on hover, focus, or click. Content within a Popover should be brief, helpful, and related to other content within the same page.

props.name: asWrapper
props.docs:

will NOT be persistable, will ONLY open on hover events
(i.e. trigger clicks will NOT open the Popover), & will NOT
allow :focus (however, the SLOTTED element CAN receive :focus).

props.docs:

used as a wrapper for block-level elements that should span

props.name: hoverCloseDelay
props.docs:
Sets delay (in ms) before Popover closes when mouse leaves trigger.
Prevents accidental close if hover state is interrupted. Only applies

props.name: hoverOpenDelay
props.docs:
Sets delay (in ms) before Popover opens on hover. Prevents
accidental opening on hover. Only applies to hover events.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When supplied, will be prepended on each inner element of the popover in order
to help facilitate testing.

props.name: ignoreClippingBoundaries
props.docs:
When TRUE, Popover has "position: fixed;" & will only adjust its
placement and/or position to prevent its container from appearing
offscreen. When FALSE, Popover has "position: absolute" & will
adjust its placement and/or positioning to stay within the bounds
of any parent container(s) that would truncate overflow (e.g.
scrollable elements, elements with "overflow: hidden;" etc.). This
Prop should be TRUE for most implementations - however, setting it
to false may help to improve performance.

props.name: message
props.docs:
Content displayed within the Popover container (supports basic
HTML). NOTE: if this Prop is provided, the "content" Slot will
NOT be available.

props.name: open
props.docs: Whether the Popover is visible (true) or hidden (false).

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:

props.name: persistable
props.docs:
Allows Popover to remain open after hover event ends or trigger
loses :focus (instead of closing after given delay). Clicking the
trigger element or Popover container will cause it to persist.

props.name: placement
props.docs:
Preferred side of trigger element to anchor Popover container.
When open, Popover will appear on the specified side UNLESS it's
projected to overflow a clipping boundary (i.e. it would appear
offscreen or would be truncated by a parent container).

props.name: preventPopoverOpening
props.docs:
When true, Popover will NOT open on hover or click events
(e.g. only open popover when a button is in a disabled state).

props.name: width
props.docs:
Sets the Popover container's max-width (in px). If the total
width of Popover's content is LESS than the value of this Prop,
the Popover container will automatically shrink to fit content width.

events.docs:
Event emitted when Popover is opened or closed. Emits "true" when
Popover is opened & "false" when closed.

changeLog.title: Popover Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Popover component created.

changeLog.title: Improved Popover Positioning Algorithm
changeLog.description: Added IntersectionObserver (modern browsers) that sets Popover position above trigger element dynamically when Popover is scrolled into the viewport. This is especially relevant for Popovers that are open by default, or Popovers not visible on page load & rendered/revealed following user interaction

changeLog.title: Add config Property
changeLog.description: Add Popover config property for setting all props with a single object.

changeLog.title: Added Parent Container Edge Detection Support to Popover
changeLog.description: Added "parentContainer" @Prop to Popover - if specified, Popover's edge detection will apply to the given element (rather than to the window).

changeLog.title: Improved Popover Accessibility
changeLog.description: Swapped Popover's "trigger" & "dismiss" span elements for button elements. Added missing "aria" tags & improved Popover compatibility with assistive technology.

changeLog.title: Improved Popover Styles for Each Theme
changeLog.description: Updated Popover styles to better reflect the overall look & feel of each theme. Added drop-shadow to each Popover theme to be more consistent with other "floating" (i.e. absolutely positioned) components.

changeLog.title: Improved Popover Edge Detection & Fixed Truncation Issues
changeLog.description: Integrated PopperJS into Popover - greatly improves edge detection & allows Popover to display above sibling/parent elements using "position: fixed;" (default), mitigating previous truncation issues caused by parent containers with "overflow" settings. Popover also now hides itself (while remaining open) when its "trigger element" is not visible within the viewport.

changeLog.title: Refactored Popover Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Refactored all Popover usage examples to demo all major @Props & configurations. Also added dynamic, interactive examples for "ignoreClippingBoundaries" @Prop.

changeLog.title: Improved "Close" Button Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Popover's "close" button color fill to meet WCAG AA contrast spec.

changeLog.title: Updated Corp & Portal Theme Aesthetics
changeLog.description: Updated Popover's Corp & Portal theme styles to better reflect the overall look & feel of each theme.

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation
changeLog.description: Instrumented FLUID Popover for observability using the FLUID Observability Provider pattern. Tracks user interactions for click, hover, focus, and blur.

changeLog.title: Added "block" @Prop
changeLog.description: Added "block" @Prop that renders Popover as a block-level element (full-width) instead of inline. Useful when Popover wraps block-level elements that should span the full width of their parent container.

docsTags.text:
FLUID Radio Group is a Form Element component that allows users to make a single selection from a list of 2+ mutually exclusive options. Unlike Toggle Group (i.e. checkboxes), only ONE option can be selected at a time - clicking a non-selected Radio Button will deselect all other options in the list. Radio Group can be displayed with traditional radio buttons, or as a FLUID Button Group using the "selectorType" Prop.

For the best user experience, a single Radio Group should not have more than 8 options. Consider splitting groups with 6+ options into multiple Radio Groups, or using a FLUID Select component (instead of Radio Group) to display the options within a dropdown menu.

This should only be used where there are minimal options, and the
field is the middle of a grid form (where no borders would look out

components.contextData:
FLUID Radio Group is a Form Element component that allows users to make a single selection from a list of 2+ mutually exclusive options. Unlike Toggle Group (i.e. checkboxes), only ONE option can be selected at a time - clicking a non-selected Radio Button will deselect all other options in the list. Radio Group can be displayed with traditional radio buttons, or as a FLUID Button Group using the "selectorType" Prop.

For the best user experience, a single Radio Group should not have more than 8 options. Consider splitting groups with 6+ options into multiple Radio Groups, or using a FLUID Select component (instead of Radio Group) to display the options within a dropdown menu.

changeLog.title: Radio Group Created
changeLog.description: Fluid Radio Group component created.

changeLog.title: Fixed Radio Group selectorType="button" Theme Bug
changeLog.description: Fixed bug in Radio Group that prevented Button Group implementation from displaying with correct theme (when "selectorType" @Prop is set to "button").

changeLog.title: Fixed Radio Group Disabled State Popover Opacity Bug
changeLog.description: Fixed bug in Radio Group that caused "helpText" Popovers to display at 50% opacity when option is disabled. Required minor refactor to architecture & styles.

changeLog.title: Added ability to use radio group to create a questionnaire style format.
changeLog.description: Developers can now create a questionnaire style form by using the 'inlineQuestion' prop on radio groups to align the main label with the radio options.

changeLog.title: Add autoFocus prop
changeLog.description: autoFocus allows this field to automatically be focused on page load without user action.

changeLog.title: Improved Disabled State Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Radio Group disabled state styles for improved readability/legibility.

changeLog.title: Support for Default Selected Option via FluidOption "selected: true"
changeLog.description: Added ability to set Radio Group's default selected option via an individual FluidOption's selected property in the options array (i.e. alternative to initialValue Prop). This functionality also allows for the selected option to be updated after the component first loads (i.e. when updating the options array).

changeLog.title: Refactored Radio Group Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Refactored Radio Group's usage examples to cover all major Props & common component configurations.

changeLog.title: Updated Validation Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Radio Group's validation error text so that it doesn't overlap sibling components/elements when visible & always has the correct font set for its current theme. Also added "fade in" visual effect to error text.

changeLog.title: Radio Group Accessibility Enhancements
changeLog.description: Updated Radio Group to clearly indicate :focus state for keyboard navigation. Also fixed Radio Group's keyboard navigation when helpText Popovers are present. Popovers now automatically open when their corresponding radio buttons receive :focus (during keyboard navigation) & do NOT interrupt Tab flow.

changeLog.title: Radio Group Aesthetic Updates
changeLog.description: Updated Radio Group's theme aesthetics so that they align more closely to each theme's overall look & feel. Also increased the clickable area for Radio Group's individual radio buttons, improved text wrapping for radio button labels, & added responsive mobile styles for inlineQuestion Radio Groups.

changeLog.title: Decoupled "helpText" Popovers from Radio Buttons
changeLog.description: Decoupled Radio Group's helpText Popovers from their corresponding radio buttons. Now, clicking a helpText Popover Icon won't change the radio button's "selected" state.

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update allows the outputFormat feature, previously only available in the context of a form, to be used in standalone mode too.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

The Range chart is a type of chart to get a lineal visualization of 5 data points.
The data points are:
Min: The minimum value to display in the lineal chart.
Max: The maximum value to display in the line chart.
Baseline: The indicator of the baseline value to achieve.
Quoted: The indicator of the current data quoted or achieved.
Target: The indicator of the goal desired to achieve.

changeLog.title: Rating Created

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update allows the outputFormat feature, previously only available in the context of a form, to be used in standalone mode too.

changeLog.title: Keyboard Navigation Support
changeLog.description: FLUID Rating now has full keyboard support, allowing users to navigate using the arrow keys & select a rating using the "enter" or "space" keys.

changeLog.title: Assistive Technology Support
changeLog.description: FLUID Rating now has full support for screen reader assistive technology. Rating is treated as a radio group, & will have its options announced by screen readers as users navigate.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

changeLog.description: Fluid Search Box component created.

changeLog.title: Search Box UX Improvements
changeLog.description: Search Box's embedded Input Field & optional "search Button" now extend to fill 100% of the component's width, & remain side-by-side at mobile viewport sizes (instead of the Button wrapping underneath the Input Field). The vertical alignment of the component's optional search Button & helpText Icon have also been updated to always be centered against the Input Field, even when the Input Field has a label configured.

changeLog.title: Added searchCleared event
changeLog.description: Added a new searchCleared event that emits whenever the value in the search box is updated to an empty string (via backspace) and search has already been applied previously.

changeLog.title: Search Box Styles Offered
changeLog.description: Removed separate labels from select and input fields in the search box and replaced it with a single label that wraps both fields. This allows for better alignment and styling of the search box as a whole. Validation for the select field has been removed, as validation should be handled at the API level.

changeLog.title: Observability Added
changeLog.description: Tracks user interactions for input and submit.

changeLog.title: Clickable Search Adornment
changeLog.description: The magnifying glass icon on dynamic search boxes is now a clickable button that triggers a search. This provides an additional route for users to initiate a search beyond pressing Enter, improving accessibility.
