components.contextData:
FLUID Select is a form element that allows users to select an option from a predefined list displayed within a dropdown menu. Select should only be used for lists of 5-15 options to reduce cognitive load & avoid overwhelming users with too many options.

If you have a list of more than 15 options, or need multi-select / autocomplete functionality, use FLUID Combo Box. If your list contains less than 5 options, use FLUID Radio Group.

changeLog.title: Select Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Select component created.

changeLog.title: FLUID Select Background Color
changeLog.description: Fixed issue with FLUID Select LESS that caused it to have a transparent background instead of white.

changeLog.title: Updated FLUID Select Border Color
changeLog.description: Previously, FLUID Select border color was too light in contrast to a standard white background color, resulting in poor visibility. Border color was darkened in each theme to increase visibility and aligned more closely with each theme's look & feel.

changeLog.title: Updated Select "Clear/Cancel" Button Accessibility
changeLog.description: Updated several aspects of accessibility for "clear/cancel" button that appears when "allowCancel" @Prop is utilized. Root element is now HTML button element (instead of div) that can receive :focus when navigating via keyboard. When button is clicked, :focus automatically shifts back to the form element (instead of requiring a second click/Tab to navigate). Also, button click target size was increased to 24x24px, making it easier to click. Finally, button icon color was darkened to improve contrast.

changeLog.title: Added support for option grouping
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to provide a grouping key via the group key of FluidOption, which automatically groups the available options into the option groups.

changeLog.title: Add autoFocus prop
changeLog.description: autoFocus allows this field to automatically be focused on page load without user action.

changeLog.title: Improved Disabled State Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated FLUID Select disabled state styles for improved readability/legibility.

changeLog.title: Updated Validation Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Select's validation error text so that it doesn't overlap sibling components/elements when visible & always has the correct font set for its current theme. Also added "fade in" visual effect to error text.

changeLog.title: Cross-Browser Aesthetic Updates
changeLog.description: Updated Select's styles to be consistent with Combo Box & fixed aesthetic inconsistencies in Firefox & Safari browsers. Also updated Select's "placeholder text" styles to be consistent with all other FLUID Form Elements.

changeLog.title: Added "value" Prop
changeLog.description: Added value Prop to FLUID Select that allows the form field's selected option value to be set & accessed. The Prop is dynamically updated to reflect the form field's current state, so it can be used as a "synchronous" alternative to the public async getValue() method. If provided on first load, the value Prop sets the default selected option. After the component is loaded, changes to the value Prop will update the form field's value (similar to the setValue() method). NOTE: the initialValue Prop will override the value Prop on first load if both Props are provided.

changeLog.title: Added Support for Individually Disabled Options
changeLog.description: Added support for individually disabled options via FluidOption's disabled property to FLUID Select. Any FluidOption object within the options array that has disabled: true will be disabled within Select's dropdown menu.

changeLog.title: Added Support for FluidOption.selected
changeLog.description: Added ability to set Select's default selected option via an individual FluidOption object's selected property in the options array (i.e. alternative to initialValue & value Props). This functionality also allows for an option to be selected OR deselected after the component first loads (i.e. when updating the options array).

changeLog.title: Added Selected Option Validation
changeLog.description: FLUID Select now validates that values passed to initialValue, value, & setValue() are associated with a valid option in the options array. Passing an invalid value to any of these Props/methods will reset the form element (i.e. clear the selected option) & display a console warning.

changeLog.title: Refactored Select's Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Refactored Select's usage examples to cover all major Props & common component configurations.

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update allows the outputFormat feature, previously only available in the context of a form, to be used in standalone mode too.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

docsTags.text:
FLUID Sidebar provides a flexible way to display internal/external navigation, in-page navigation (i.e. "jump links"), contextual information, or ancillary controls on a single page, collection of pages, or globally across all pages within a website.

In general, Sidebar's primary use case is to supplement header navigation by creating an "inverted L" navigation structure. It is also commonly used to provide "jump links" that vertically scroll the page to a certain position when clicked.

NOTE: Sidebar is meant to be implemented via FLUID Page, and should NOT be used as a standalone component. See walkthrough guide for more information: FLUID Sidebar: Implementation & Tips

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: - Content displayed within the Sidebar body. NOTE: if built-in Tree Menu is used (i.e. "menuItems" or "treeMenuConfig" Props), slotted content will be displayed BELOW the Tree Menu.

props.name: anchor
props.docs:
Whether to render the Sidebar on the left or right side of the
viewport. NOTE: this Prop is set automatically via FLUID Page (i.e.
value inferred from use of "leftSidebarConfig" or "rightSidebarConfig"
Prop).

props.name: collapsible
props.docs:
Whether the Sidebar can be expanded / collapsed by the user. When
false, Sidebar will ALWAYS be visible/open at desktop size & will NOT
display a toggle button. NOTE: at tablet / mobile size, Sidebar WILL
become collapsible to save screen real estate (regardless of this
Prop's value).

props.name: config
props.docs: Allows Sidebar's Props to be set via a single configuration object.

props.name: displayDensity
props.docs:
Sets Sidebar's width, padding, & embedded Tree Menu size to be more
or less compact.

props.name: fixed
props.docs:
When true, Sidebar will have a fixed (i.e. "sticky") position within
the DOM when scrolling. NOTE: it is recommended to ALWAYS set this
Prop to true, especially if the Sidebar is used for navigation.

props.name: menuItems
props.docs:
When provided, Sidebar will render a built-in FLUID Tree Menu above
its primary unnamed content slot. This Prop renders a BASIC Tree Menu
- use "treeMenuConfig" Prop INSTEAD OF this Prop to access ALL of Tree
Menu's Props.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: themePalette
props.docs:
When provided, adjusts the current theme's color palette & appearance.
NOTE: a theme palette acts as a "style override" applied ON TOP of
the current theme & isn't necessary for "standard" theme aesthetics.

props.name: treeMenuConfig
props.docs:
When provided, Sidebar will render a built-in FLUID Tree Menu above
its primary unnamed content slot. Use this Prop INSTEAD OF the
"menuItems" Prop if you need access to ALL Tree Menu Props.

props.name: visible
props.docs:
Opens/expands the Sidebar when true, closes/collapses the Sidebar
when false. NOTE: by default, the "visible" Prop will be true
(expanded) at desktop size & false (collapsed) at mobile/tablet size
on first load. Setting an explicit initial value on "visible" will
override this default responsive behavior, so it is recommended to
leave this Prop out of FLUID Page's Sidebar config if Sidebar should
be open initially.

methods.name: getTreeMenuRef
methods.docs:
Returns reference to embedded Tree Menu component (when configured
via "menuItems" or "treeMenuConfig" Prop).

events.docs:
Event emitted when Sidebar is opened or closed. The event's payload
is a boolean value that indicates its "visible" status. At desktop
size, this event is only emitted when the "collapsible" Prop is true.

changeLog.title: Sidebar Component Created
changeLog.description: Sidebar component skeleton created.

changeLog.title: Sidebar Component Improvements
changeLog.description: Added ability to render Sidebar on right-hand side of screen.

changeLog.title: Style Cleanup & Theme Support Added
changeLog.description: Added theme support for Sidebar component & set up styles for each theme. Improved support for fixed-position Sidebar. Swapped "hamburger" icon for "arrow" icon. Added mobile/tablet support.

changeLog.title: Sidebar Component Refactored
changeLog.description: Removed native "menu item" rendering to new Tree Menu component. Added support for "Sticky Position Management System" so that Sidebar can be positioned dynamically in relation to fixed-position Header. Added support for FLUID Tree Menu component if "menuItems" property utilized. Added persistent Slot that is rendered regardless of menuItems. Added ability to make Sidebar non-collapsible.

changeLog.title: Sidebar Functionality Updates
changeLog.description: Refactored Sidebar viewport width detection to use "matchMedia()" (HUGE performance boost). Sidebar now renders "closed" at mobile size when "visible" @Prop is "true" by default.

changeLog.title: Sidebar Style Bug Fixes
changeLog.description: Fixed issue that caused Sidebar to be shorter than height of window.

changeLog.title: Added "treeMenuConfig" Support to Sidebar
changeLog.description: Added support for Tree Menu "config" object to Sidebar that allows advanced configuration of the built-in Sidebar Tree Menu.

changeLog.title: Sidebar Architectural Style Updates
changeLog.description: Updated Sidebar styles to make Y-axis scrolling occur within the main content container rather than the Sidebar root element itself. This allows slotted content that is absolutely-positioned to accurately maintain its position when scrolling within the Sidebar. Also added ":focus-visible" styles to Sidebar toggle button.

changeLog.title: Refactored Sidebar Render & Functional Tests
changeLog.description: Updated Sidebar render tests to cover all basic @Props & architecture, and updated Sidebar functional tests to cover "updateTreeMenuConfig()".

changeLog.title: Added Sidebar Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Added Sidebar usage examples.

changeLog.title: Upgraded Sidebar's Look & Feel
changeLog.description: Upgraded & modernized Sidebar's architecture & styles. fixed Sidebar is now "sticky" until it reaches the bottom of FLUID Page, then "slides up" to show Footer (instead of always "floating" beside Footer) - this is a more "standard" design pattern, & prevents Footer content from being "smashed". Also updated the look & feel of Sidebar's "toggle" button (i.e. expand/collapse) & improved its usability/accessibility. The "toggle" button now expands vertically to be 100% height when Sidebar is collapsed, making it much easier to click. The button also has refreshed expand/collapse Icons that better represent the button's actions & has updated theme styles.

changeLog.title: Sidebar Performance Improvements
changeLog.description: Improved Sidebar's internal logic to render faster, smoother, & with a smaller memory footprint.

changeLog.title: Expand/Collapse Button Improvements
changeLog.description: Improved usability, accessibility, & aesthetics of Sidebar's "toggle" button. Increased click target size of "collapse" button (i.e. button shown when Sidebar is OPEN) & updated expand/collapse Icon sizes to be proportional to each theme.

changeLog.title: Added Sidebar displayDensity Prop
changeLog.description: Added displayDensity prop to Sidebar - supports compact and default densities. Sidebar's embedded Tree Menu also receives the displayDensity Prop configuration.

changeLog.title: Added Sidebar displayDensity width rules (desktop)
changeLog.description: When Fluid-Sidebar prop displayDensity is set to compact, Sidebar width is set to 280 px as opposed to default 350px.

changeLog.title: Refactored Sidebar LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Sidebar's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Theme Palette Support
changeLog.description: Added themePalette Prop to Sidebar that allows selective color/aesthetic "style overrides" to be applied on top of the currently applied theme.

changeLog.title: QBI Theme Palette
changeLog.description: Added "QBI" theme palette MVP to Sidebar.

changeLog.title: getTreeMenuRef() Method
changeLog.description: Added public getTreeMenuRef() Method to FLUID Sidebar that returns its embedded Tree Menu element (when configured via treeMenuConfig or menuItems). This is useful for calling public methods on Tree Menu instances that are rendered within Sidebar's Shadow DOM, as they are not directly accessible otherwise.

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation
changeLog.description: Instrumented FLUID Sidebar for observability using the FLUID Observability Provider pattern. Tracks user interactions for sidebar toggle click (expand/collapse).

docsTags.text: FLUID Stacked Horizontal Bar Chart is a data visualization component used to compare values across groups of data. Each bar in the chart is divided into segments, with each segment representing a portion of the group's data. This segmentation allows for an easy comparison of the proportions within each group.

Example:

This will produce a 2 level legend with 2 sets of corresponding categories, from left to right

FLUID State Container provides a central, reactive state for MFEs (micro frontend apps),
along with subscription and notification mechanisms. State is session-persistent, deduplicated,
and observable via both subscription API and Stencil events.

Call with no arguments to clear all event history, or pass an event name

- Notifies subscribers (and fires event) with `undefined` as the new value.
- Unsubscribes all callbacks for that key.

- Returns undefined if the key does not exist and cannot be hydrated.

methods.signature: publishEvent(event: string, data?: any, options?: FluidEventOptions) => Promise<void>
methods.docs:
Publishes a transient event to all subscribers.
Events are fire-and-forget: they do NOT persist to state or sessionStorage.
Use this for notifications like "proposal-ready" that don't need state tracking.
The last published data is stored for replay functionality.

docsTags.name: param

docsTags.name: param

methods.docs:
Runs a queued async process (like an API call) and reduces the state using a reducer.
- Notifies only changed keys.
- Serialized by a promise queue so that state changes are always ordered.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: process Async function representing a process.

docsTags.name: param

methods.signature: setState(keyOrObject: string | Record<string, any>, valueOrOptions?: any | FluidSetStateOptions, options?: FluidSetStateOptions) => Promise<void>
methods.docs:
Set state for one or more keys.
- Accepts either a single key/value pair or an object with multiple keys/values.
- Only triggers notifications and persistence for keys whose values actually changed.
- Optionally broadcasts changes to other browser tabs when crossTab option is true.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: keyOrObject Single key or a bulk updates object

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: valueOrOptions Value to set (if single key) or options (if bulk update)

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: options Options including crossTab for cross-tab synchronization

methods.signature: subscribe(key: string, callback: (value: any) => void) => Promise<() => void>
methods.docs:
Subscribes to changes for a given state key.
- The callback is immediately invoked with the current value.
- The callback is invoked on future changes (but only if the value differs from last notification).
- Returns an unsubscribe function to remove the callback.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: callback Callback invoked on key changes.

components.contextData: Steppers convey progress through numbered steps. It provides a wizard-like workflow. Steppers display progress through a sequence of logical and numbered steps. They may also be used for navigation.

changeLog.title: Stepper Component Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Stepper component created.

changeLog.title: Added Stepper "Sandbox" Page
changeLog.description: Created <fluid-link href="/fluid/fluid-icon.html" target="_blank" inline>FLUID Stepper "sandbox" page</fluid-link> & added basic examples for testing features/functionality.

changeLog.title: Added stepChanged event
changeLog.description: Added stepChanged event to allow users to perform an action when the step is changed.

changeLog.title: Refactored Stepper LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Steppers stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Add a mutation observer to the stepper
changeLog.description: Monitors changes in the child elements to ensure stepper dynamically updates when steps are added or removed. The stepper must reassign the changes back to itself this.steps=[...this.steps] or setSteps([...steps])

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation
changeLog.description: Instrumented FLUID Stepper for observability using the FLUID Observability Provider pattern. Tracks step button clicks, footer button clicks (Back, Next, Finish, Reset), and scroll navigation (left/right).

changeLog.title: Added Vertical Layout
changeLog.description: Added verticalLayout prop to render steps in a vertical timeline layout with inline expanded content. Steps stack vertically with a connector line, and the active step's content expands below its header. Supports linear and non-linear navigation, accessibility (accordion pattern with aria-expanded/aria-controls), and all existing stepper features (finish, reset, themes).

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
FLUID Sticky Button is a simple component that displays a fixed-position FLUID Button on the right side of the viewport. It's primarily used when an action or navigation link needs to be visible at all times, regardless of the user's scroll position on the page.

NOTE: By default, Sticky Button is NOT responsive at this time (i.e. it's meant to be used on a SINGLE device type). However, it can be made responsive by creating logic to dynamically update the "verticalPlacement" Prop value based on viewport size.

props.name: color
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "color" is now deprecated. Instead, use the "type" Prop
(same functionality, just a different naming convention) -- Style
settings applied to the Button.

props.name: controlBarPosition
props.docs:
If the button is part of a control bar, what position is it
in? 'start' | 'middle' | 'end'

props.name: disabled
props.docs:
When true, Sticky Button will be disabled. Setting this Prop to
true also allows the embedded Popover to be displayed on :hover
(i.e. Popover is DISABLED when this Prop is false or undefined).

props.name: iconAfter
props.docs: An additional icon to be placed after the button label.

props.name: iconBefore
props.docs: An additional icon to be placed before the button label.

props.name: label
props.docs:
The label to give the button (if no ID is supplied, the label will
be automatically camelCased and used as an ID for accessibility &
e2e testing).

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: popover
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popover" is now deprecated (https://chromestatus.com/feature/5463833265045504).
Instead, use the "message" property of the "popoverConfig" Prop. --
When provided, displays a Popover on :hover when Sticky Button is
DISABLED. This Prop sets the "message" within the Popover. NOTE:
Popover will NOT be displayed on :hover UNLESS component is disabled.

props.name: popoverConfig
props.docs:
When provided, displays a Popover on :hover when Sticky Button is
DISABLED. NOTE: Popover will NOT be displayed on :hover UNLESS
component is disabled.

props.name: popoverPlacement
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popoverPlacement" is now deprecated. Due to the
placement of Sticky Button within the viewport, the Popover's
placement should ALWAYS be "top". -- Sets preferred side of the
Sticky Button to display Popover (when open).

props.name: popoverTitle
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popoverTitle" is now deprecated. Instead, use the
"header" property of the "popoverConfig" Prop. -- Adds a title to the
Popover. If undefined, Popover will show without a header section.

props.name: popoverWidth
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "popoverWidth" is now deprecated. Instead, use the
"width" property of the "PopoverConfig" Prop. -- Specifies the maximum
width of the Popover (in px).

props.name: removeHorizontalMargin
props.docs:
When true, removes Sticky Button's default right margin. NOTE:
this Prop is overridden by "removeMargin" Prop.

props.name: removeMargin
props.docs: When true, removes Sticky Button's default right & bottom margins.

props.name: removeVerticalMargin
props.docs:
When true, removes Sticky Button's default bottom margin. NOTE:
this Prop is overridden by "removeMargin" Prop.

props.name: small
props.docs: When true, Sticky Button will be smaller than the default size.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: type
props.docs: Sets the color & style of the Button.

props.name: verticalPlacement
props.docs:
Sets the Sticky Button's vertical offset (in px) from the top
of the viewport.

props.name: active
props.docs: When true, Tab will be "selected" within the parent Tabs component.

props.name: contextContentDefinition
props.docs:
When provided, renders a FLUID component within the Tab button (to the
right of the label). To hide the rendered component until the user hovers
over the Tab button, set "props.showOnHover" to true within the
FluidComponentDefinition object. The following component definitions are
allowed: Badge, Button, Context Menu, Text, & Icon.

props.name: disabled
props.docs: When true, Tab will be disabled (prevents user from selecting the Tab).

props.name: hidden
props.docs: When true, Tab button & slotted content will be hidden.

props.name: iconAfter
props.docs: FLUID Icon displayed after the Tab button label.

props.name: iconBefore
props.docs: FLUID Icon displayed before the Tab button label.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: tabTitle
props.docs:
Sets the Tab button label & "aria-label" for Tab's content panel.
NOTE: use this Prop INSTEAD of "title" attribute (a11y best practice).

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

events.docs: Event emitted when the property `disabled` was changed.
Event emitted when the "hidden" Prop changes.
Event emitted when the "tabTitle" Prop changes.

props.name: maxScrollPosition
props.docs:
The furthest horizontal position that the user can scroll to within
the parent Tabs component. When "scrollPosition" is equal to
"maxScrollPosition", the right navigation arrow will be hidden.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: scrollPosition
props.docs:
The current horizontal scroll position (i.e. scrollLeft) of the
parent Tabs component.

props.name: showArrows
props.docs:
Determines whether Tab Navigation is rendered (when false, nothing
is displayed).

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
A table is a structured set of data made up of rows and columns (tabular data).
A table allows you to quickly and easily look up values that indicate some kind of connection between
different types of data, for example a person and their age, or a day of the week, or the timetable
for a local swimming pool.

docsTags.name: slot
docsTags.text: table-header-row - A named slot to allow an additional header row to be applied at the head of the table;

props.name: acceptFileDrop
props.docs:
When true, the table will accept files via drag-and-drop. Dropped files
are validated and stored internally, then emitted via the `fileListUpdated`
event. The consuming application can decide what to do with the files
(e.g. update `dataItems`).

props.name: acceptFileTypes
props.docs:
If supplied, file drop will be restricted to the given MIME types only,
otherwise all file types are accepted.

Please note — in some cases the file type presented by different operating
systems uses different casing (e.g. macroenabled vs macroEnabled). You may
need to include both casing variants.

props.name: acceptMultipleFiles
props.docs:
Whether the table should accept multiple files in a single drop, or
replace the list with the first valid file each time.

props.name: actionsDisabled
props.docs: If true, the save and cancel buttons will be disabled.

props.name: allowOverflow
props.docs:
If true, horizontal scrolling will be allowed on tables with many columns. NB - If allowOverflow is true,
horizontal scrolling will be enabled, however, filter menu style will be switched to compact to prevent overflow on the Y axis from cutting off the view.

props.name: columnAdjustments
props.docs:
Allows you to adjust the width of all columns in a single prop, including columns
added by FLUID.

NB - Column widths will shrink *where possible* - certain column elements (such as icons) may dictate the column
width be larger than what is configured - in this case, the column will shrink as much as it can.

props.name: columnGroups
props.docs: An array of column groups to apply to the table

props.name: columnVisibilityButtonConfig
props.docs:
Sets the visibility button config (Icon)
The default is `icon:'ellipsis_vertical'`
You can override all the properties from `FluidIconConfig`
Example: the `color` and `size` of the icon

props.name: commitOnValidSave
props.docs:
If true (default), a table with an expandable form or editable field, and
table-rendered edit actions with automatically commit the changes to the forms
to its own internal memory on click of the Save button if the forms are valid.

This will fire the dataMutated event, which lets the consuming application know
the new data set values.

props.name: dataItems
props.docs:
The initial dataSet to work from - duplicated in _tableState to allow
data mutation in the table without affecting the original data

props.name: dataLoading
props.docs:
Lets the table know if data from above is loading (from an API for example) so that
it can show a loading spinner until it has the data (Must be managed from consuming
application)

props.name: defaultPageSize
props.docs:
Sets the default page size (i.e. number of rows displayed per page)
for Table's pagination. Accepts a number or "total" to display all rows
in a single page.

props.name: disableActiveFiltering
props.docs:
If true, filters are only applied after clicking the 'Apply Filters' button
on the filter menu - this helps improve performance on large datasets.

props.name: disableColumnVisibility
props.docs: If true, disables the column visibility filters

props.name: disableRowHighlighting
props.docs: When true, disables row highlighting for all rows in the table.

props.name: disableRowIf
props.docs:
Provides the ability to pass a function that receives the row data as a parameter, and returns a
boolean. If true, the row will be disabled, and all interactive elements in the row will be disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.docs: When true, all interaction on the table will be disabled.

props.name: displayDensity
props.docs: Adjusts Table's font, padding, spacing, etc. to be more or less compact.

props.name: emitOnEmptyFilter
props.docs:
When true (default), the tableFiltered event is fired on every filter
action, even if there are no filters applied.

props.name: emptyStateConfig
props.docs:
Allows a custom message to be shown when there are no dataItems available, and the table is not marked
as loading.

props.name: enableSearch
props.docs: If true, the table will have a search bar

props.name: expandableForm
props.docs:
Configuration for an expandable form to be rendered with each row, which
allows the dataItem in that row to be edited. Each row will display a
"trigger" button for the expandable panel on the left side of the Table
by default, or on the right side of the Table by setting
"expandedButtonPosition: right".

props.name: expandableRowTemplate
props.docs:
Provide a template to render in an expandable panel for each row.
Row template will receive the entire row object to render in template.
Each row will display a "trigger" button for the expandable panel on
the right side of the Table by default, or on the left side of the Table
by setting "expandedButtonPosition: left".

props.name: expandedButtonPosition
props.docs:
Overrides default position of each row's "expand" button (rendered when
"expandableForm" or "expandableRowTemplate" Props used). By default,
the "expandableForm" Prop will render the "expand" buttons on the LEFT side
of the Table (e.g. "right" will override the default position). The
"expandableRowTemplate" Prop will render the "expand" buttons on the
RIGHT side of the Table by default (i.e. "left" will override the
default position).

props.name: exportOptions
props.docs: Set the options for the export feature.

props.name: externalState
props.docs:
Allows you to pass an external state object to the table, which it can
use in certain computations.

props.name: filteredValues
props.docs:
When set, the table will consider the values at each dataPath as filtered
out, and therefore leave them unchecked in the corresponding filter menu
and not include them in the initial visible data set.

Provides the ability to further customise the edit actions for a table with editable cells/forms.

Deprecates several properties via the mapFormActionsToConfig() method

If true, the table will provide the ability to delete a row, without
having to supplement with a defined action.

props.name: hideExpandAll
props.docs: If set to true, the expand all header will be disabled and hidden.

Provides the ability to pass a function that receives the row data as a parameter, and returns a

props.docs:
When provided, the "identifier" string will be prepended to
"data-test-id" attributes on Table's inner architecture to help
facilitate testing.

props.name: isPaginatorTotalItemsDisabled
props.docs:
If true the total items of the paginator (last item of the select box)
will not be an option

props.name: itemsPerPageTemplate
props.docs: Allows the Paginator's "items per page" selector wording to be customized

props.name: loadingMessage
props.docs: Customize the loading spinner message

props.name: maxFileSize
props.docs:
The maximum allowed file size in bytes. Files exceeding this size will
be silently rejected with a console warning.

props.name: maxHeight
props.docs:
Sets a maximum height for the embedded <table> element. Causes Table to
become scrollable if rows overflow the maximum height.

props.name: menuItems
props.docs: Use this prop in tableActions to render a dropdown button

props.name: minHeight
props.docs: Sets a minimum height for the embedded <table> element.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: paginated
props.docs:
Determines if the table is pageable - default is true, so needs
to be explicitly set to false if we don't want pagination

props.name: paginationItemsPerPageOptions
props.docs: If paginated, sets the "items per page" options for the paginator

props.name: preloadDelay
props.docs:
Sets the delay on preloading (the time the table waits after initial loading
before initialising the data source) to prevent render-blocking on larger
datasets

props.name: preloadLimit
props.docs: Sets the limit on data set size before preloading is applied.

props.name: rangeIndicatorTemplate
props.docs: Allows the Paginator's range indicator wording to be customized

props.name: refreshDelay
props.docs:
When the dataItems array is changed, the table enters a 'refresh' state - this is to ensure all the
operations the table has to carry out on the new data set can complete before rendering the table nodes.
This value determines how long the table is in that refresh state, so it can be fine-tuned if there any
issues with larger, or more complex datasets.

props.name: retainTransientProperties
props.docs:
FLUID adds certain properties to the data to help it manage internal state - these properties
are then stripped out of any data that is emitted from the table, so data retains the same shape
on the way out, as what was put in. If the consuming application relies on any of these properties,
it can request that FLUID doesn't strip them out, by adding the required properties to this array.

props.name: rowActions
props.docs: Actions to be rendered for each row.

props.name: rowBorders
props.docs: If true, each Table row will have a bottom border.

props.name: rowIdentifier
props.docs:
If a particular property within the given dataItems can be used to uniquely
identify the item, this property tells the table to use it rather than generated
IDs

props.name: rowSubset
props.docs:
Allows a table subset to be created as an expandable panel beneath each row.

Each subset uses the same headers as the main row, and passes the current dataItem
as the parameter to the function to return an array of child rows for the subset table.

props.name: runTemplateOnExpansionOnly
props.docs:
If true, the expandable panel template function will only run when the row
is expanded for the first time.

props.name: searchOptions
props.docs: Configure the table search (searchable headers, dynamic search, etc.)

props.name: selectionOptions
props.docs: Provides selection options for the selectable row table type.

docsTags.name: experimental
docsTags.text:
If true, the table will enter server mode, which disables filtering, pagination and
sorting, in favour of events and custom filters provided by the calling application.

The table will not receive all of the data, and thus will not be able to generate its
own filters for each column, instead only providing the custom filters passed in from
the calling application, and emitting an event when the user selects them.

props.name: statefulOptions
stickyHeaders
props.docs:
When true, Table headers will be "sticky" on vertical scroll. NOTE:
Table MUST have a maximum height defined (i.e. "maxHeight" Prop) for
this Prop to function.

props.name: striped
props.docs:
If true, Table rows will be styled with "zebra stripes" (alternating rows
will have gray background).

props.name: tableActions
props.docs: Contextual action buttons for each

props.name: tableId
props.docs: A unique ID for the table

docsTags.text:
- Required prop - we'll need this to store table
state, so the table will fail to render with an error message
if not provided.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: trackFormState
props.docs:
If true, the table emit the form state of each nested form for each change - if you do not need
to know the forms state (validity, etc) prior to hitting the save button (and receiving mutations),
you can set this to false to improve performance.

props.name: useRenderer
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "useRenderer" is now deprecated. Table now automatically
determines the return type of "expandableRowTemplate", so this Prop is
unnecessary -- When true, "expandableRowTemplate" will render its return
value as a FluidComponentDefinition instead of a string of HTML.

docsTags.name: experimental
docsTags.text:
Selectively enables server mode for individual table features, rather than the
all-or-nothing approach of `serverMode`. Pass a `FluidUseServerConfig` object
with feature keys set to `true` to delegate those features to the server.

When a feature is enabled via `useServer`, the table will skip its client-side
processing for that feature and emit events for the consuming application to handle.

Features that are not included (or set to `false`) will continue to operate client-side.

If `serverMode` is also `true`, all features are treated as server-delegated regardless
of `useServer` values.

docsTags.name: example
docsTags.text:
```html
<!-- Only pagination is server-side; sorting and filtering remain client-side -->
<fluid-table .useServer=${{ pagination: true }}></fluid-table>

<!-- Pagination and filtering are server-side; sorting remains client-side -->
<fluid-table .useServer=${{ pagination: true, filtering: true }}></fluid-table>
```

props.name: validateOnSave
props.docs:
Where a table has nested forms or editable cells with validation configured, the table
will not emit a dataMutated event when the save button is clicked unless all are valid.
When this prop is set to true, the table will validate the cells when save is clicked and
cells are not valid, offering immediate visual feedback to the user.

methods.docs:
Clears the internal file list that was collected via drag-and-drop
and emits an empty `fileListUpdated` event.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.docs: Clears all filters and search terms.

methods.name: clearSort
methods.docs: Clears any active sort

methods.docs:
Where a table has an expandable form configured, collapseAllFormRows offers a way to collapse all of those rows in
one click. Call from a reference to the HTML element produced by <fluid-table>

methods.name: collapseAllTemplateRows
methods.docs:
Where a table has an expandable template configured, collapseAllTemplateRows offers a way to expand all of those rows in
one click. Call from a reference to the HTML element produced by <fluid-table>

Where a table has an expandable form configured, collapseRow offers a way to collapse an individual row by
providing that table's id.

Commits the internal store of updated rows to the datasource, first checking that the cells and forms are valid,
before emitting the mutation update, and clearing the _updateRows store.

methods.name: markAsTouchedAndValidate

Where a table has an expandable form or editable cells configured, markTouchedAndValidate offers a way

methods.name: resetRowMutations
methods.docs:
Resets all editable cells and form values to the state they were in when the data was first prepared, effectively
cancelling all changes to the table.

Utility method to set data items from the consuming application. This method takes an array of data objects, and effectively

methods.docs:
Disables or enables the entire Table (including actions, selectable
row Toggles, Form Elements, etc).

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: disabled - disables entire Table when true, enables entire Table when false

methods.name: setElementConfig
methods.signature: setElementConfig(controlName: string, key: string, value: unknown) => Promise<void>
methods.docs:
Where a table has an expandable form configured, setElementConfig offers a way to update the configuration for a particular
form control, and apply it to all forms in the table (for example, updating a validation rule in response to an action outside
of the table). Call from a reference to the HTML element produced by <fluid-table>

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: controlName - the name of the control config to update.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: key - the configuration property to update.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: value - the value to set for the configuration property.

methods.name: setElementConfigForFormInstance
methods.signature: setElementConfigForFormInstance(rowId: string, controlName: string, key: string, value: unknown) => Promise<void>
methods.docs:
Where a table has an expandable form configured, setElementConfigForFormInstance offers a way to update the configuration for a particular
form control, on a specific form instance or row (for example, setting a control as disabled on a particular row/instance and
leaving the same control on other row/instances as enabled). Call from a reference to the HTML element produced by <fluid-table>

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: rowId - the rowId containing the form configuration to be changed.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: controlName - the name of the control config to update.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: key - the configuration property to update.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: value - the value to set for the configuration property.

methods.name: setPaginationState
methods.docs:
Sets the pagination state for the table. Given a page number (0-indexed) and an
items per page, it first sets the selected items per page, before going to the
given page.

If no itemsPerPage is provided, the table just goes to the specific page.

events.docs:
Emits the row actionKey that was clicked, along with the rowData from
the row that was clicked

events.detail: { dataPath: string; rowId: string; row?: FluidTableRowData<DataItem>; rowData?: FluidTableRowData<DataItem>; }
events.docs: Emits the cell data whenever a cell is clicked
Emits whenever the table column visibility has changed.

Emits when the tables 'Save' action is clicked. Emits both the new, now
updated dataset, along with a list of mutated rows. This allows the
consuming component to intercept changes and decide whether to commit
the change, or to reset the data;

Emits whenever an editable cell changes value. Emits the new value, along with the
row data for the row it changed on.
Emits whenever a table row is expanded.

Emits whenever the internal file list changes as a result of a file
drop operation. The payload is the full current list of accepted files.
Mirrors the `fileListUpdated` event from `fluid-file-upload`.
Fired when filters are cleared via clearFilters method only.

Emits when one of the form actions is clicked, in case the parent component

Fired whenever an element in a nested form value changes

Emits the collapsed state of all Table groups when the "Expand/Collapse
All" header cell is toggled. The payload is a keyed object where
each key is a group's "groupedByValue" (i.e. the value of the "dataPath"
that creates the group) & each value is "true" if the group is collapsed,
or "false" if the group is expanded.

row-level toggle cell. The payload contains the group's "groupedByValue"
(i.e. the value of the "dataPath" that creates the group) & a "collapsed"
boolean that is "true" if the group is now collapsed, or "false" if it
is now expanded.
Emits when the state of the nested forms changes.

Emits whenever the table wrapper scroll position changes
if fixed height table and scroll spy enabled.

Emits when the "Select All" toggle is clicked. In server mode, this
delegates the select-all operation to the consuming application.

Fired when the table sort is cleared - either by 'clearSort' method, or via
organic clear when header is clicked through sort directions
Emits whenever the table is filtered
Emits whenever the table search is executed
Emits whenever the table is sorted

components.contextData:
A table is a structured set of data made up of rows and columns (tabular data).
A table allows you to quickly and easily look up values that indicate some kind of connection between
different types of data, for example a person and their age, or a day of the week, or the timetable
for a local swimming pool.
components.slot: table-header-row - A named slot to allow an additional header row to be applied at the head of the table;

changeLog.title: Table Component Created
changeLog.description: Fluid Table component created.

changeLog.title: Custom Cell Templates Available
changeLog.description: Added ability to provide a custom template to a header column via the cellTemplate property. Template can utilise full row data if renderFullData property is set to true

changeLog.title: Fixed Width Columns Added
changeLog.description: Added ability to set a fixed column width to each column via the columnWidth property. Fixed widths are percentage based, so currently all columns should have a width set.

changeLog.title: Expandable Row Templates Added
changeLog.description: Added ability to provide an expandable row template. If provided, a second row will be created for each data item, and an expand action will be added to the actions column automatically

changeLog.title: Auto Cell Alignment Added.
changeLog.description: Cell alignment is now automatic based on the headers defined data type, and our table design standards. We have also provided a `cellAlignment` property which allows overridding of the automatic cell alignment, where necessary.

changeLog.title: Disable Filters per Column
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to explicitly disable filters on a column by setting the `disableFilters` property to true.

changeLog.title: Add max height to table
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to set a maximum height for the table before it becomes scrollable.

changeLog.title: Adds rowActions to dynamically render actions.
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to provide the table with a list of rowActions which will render an action icon for each. When an action is clicked the table will emit an event with the provided actionKey and the row data of the row which was clicked. This event allows the consuming component to control what happens when a table action is fired.

changeLog.title: Inline editing added to table!
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to provide an `editableCellConfig` configuration to a table header, which, will render an editable cell in place of the usual data item. When the table detects that editable cells are present, it automatically renders Save and Cancel buttons at the foot of the table. Cancel will reset all edits made to the table, whereas Save will emit an event under the `dataMutated` handler. This event will contain the complete updated dataset, as well as a list of the individual mutated rows.

changeLog.title: Expand/Collapse all form rows externally!
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to expand or collapse all of the table form rows from outside the table. Grab a reference to the native element using whatever method your framework supports, and call expandAllFormRows() or collapseAllFormRows() to activate the exposed methods! Advanced usage page has been updated with code snippets, so check there for a full working demo and example code!

changeLog.title: Expand/Collapse all form rows from table header!
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to expand or collapse all of the table form rows from the table header, which will now display a chevron instead of an empty table header cell, which, when clicked, will expand or collapse all form rows.

changeLog.title: Add dedicated action column (for a single action type)
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to define a table header of `action` type, which, when configured with `actionColumnConfig`, will render a column with only one action - this is different to the actions column which renders multiple `rowActions` as it can be added in any column order, and is responsible for only one, dedicated action. The advanced usage expandable row page has been updated with an example of a dedicated delete column with its own iconic table header.

changeLog.title: Adds loading icon for table
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to tell the table that your data is loading, and a loading icon will be rendered. Simply give the table the `dataLoading` prop , and, when true, the loader will display. When your data has finished loading, flip it to false, and the loader disappears! Handy for letting your users know something is happening!

changeLog.title: Fixing sorting on deep properties and sort icon
changeLog.description: Fixing table sort when properties are deeper than 1 level and a minor UI tweak to move the sort-icon arrow to avoid overlap.

changeLog.title: Fixing actionsDisabled for cancel btn
changeLog.description: add actionsDisabled check for cancel button too so its disabled and no action is performed on click.

changeLog.title: Adds ability to provide unique rowId from data item property.
changeLog.description: Individual rows in the table are identified internally using generated IDs, however, in some cases, the consuming application may want to correlate a row action with the data items using a specific identifier (such as a database ID) - this update provides the ability to provide a `rowIdentifier` prop which the table, providing each dataItem has a unique value for that property, will use as its internal tracking mechanism, and will use for propagating events upwards.

changeLog.title: Allow nested form elements to propagate their valueChanged event through the table
changeLog.description: When a table has expandable forms in each row, there now exists a `formValueChanged` on the table, which will propagate the event fired from a single form element within the nested form, whose detail will include the update to that field (including new value, validity, etc), the full row data for the row, the data path that changed and a unique identifier for the row.

changeLog.title: Updates to expandable form expansion states.
changeLog.description: When a table has expandable forms in each row, if the datasource changes from above, the table re-renders, and all rows are collapsed. This update allows expansion state to be maintained between renders, providing the `rowIdentifier` prop is supplied, and is valid. Additionally, you can now expand a row on initial render by updating your data source with `expandedForm: true` on any data items you want to be expanded by default (handy if you want to add a single new item, and have its form expanded when it renders).

changeLog.title: Enable sticky headers in tables with maximum height
changeLog.description: If a table is configured with a maximum height, we can now add the `stickyHeaders` property which will fix the header row to the top of the scrollable area, so as the user scrolls through the table, the headers move with them! 👍🏻

changeLog.title: Events now fired when a cell is clicked
changeLog.description: This update exposes a new event on the table `cellClicked`, which fires whenever a cell is clicked, or editable cell receives focus. It will emit a custom event that contains the row ID of the row the cell is in, the dataPath of the clicked cell, and the current row data for the row the cell is in. This means that at any given time, the consuming application can handle a click in any cell, and derive the current cell data based on the row data and dataPath.

changeLog.title: Ability to truncate a cell value and show optional popover added
changeLog.description: This feature adds a property `truncationOptions` to the header definitions to configure the displayable `maxLength` before truncating and showing a configurable popover (either the full untruncated data, or by way of a `popoverTemplate` which receives the full row data as its parameter and returns the popover content)

changeLog.title: Added @Props for Table row striping & row borders
changeLog.description: Added `striped` @Prop to Table that toggles visual "zebra striping" on rows (alternating rows have gray background). Also added `rowBorders` @Prop to Table that toggles row bottom borders.

changeLog.title: Table Theme Style Updates
changeLog.description: Minor aesthetic updates to Table Default, Legacy, & LM themes, & major aesthetic updates to Table LM Corporate theme.

changeLog.title: Custom Filters
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to configure custom filters for a table.

changeLog.title: Filter 'Empty State' Added
changeLog.description: Adds a table 'empty state' for when filters are applied, but no data items pass.

changeLog.title: Added ability to make table selection mutually exclusive, highlight rows and configure toggle type.
changeLog.description: This update allows selectable tables, which previously only supported multiple selections, to be mutually exclusive by configuring `selectionOptions` to have `mutuallyExclusive: true`. Additionally, we can now highlight selected rows with the `highlightSelected: true` property, and we can decide what toggle type we want to use with `toggleType` instead of the default checkbox.

changeLog.title: Added ability to disable column visibility filters and associated column
changeLog.description: This update allows you to provide a disableColumnVisibility prop, which will remove the column visibility filter menu from the table. If your table has no rowActions configured, it will remove the end column completely, otherwise, it will just remove the menu trigger, but keep the column for your actions.

changeLog.title: Added Portal Theme Styles to Table
changeLog.description: Updated Table"s Portal theme to be consistent with the DCX style guide.

changeLog.title: Table Filter Menu Updates
changeLog.description: Table filter menus can now be closed on outside click (as well as closed via the dedicated "close" button). This prevents multiple filter menus from being open simultaneously & overlapping each other. Filter menu Icons also now have a :hover state that clearly shows the clickable area to open the menu.

changeLog.title: Table Header Cells: Click Anywhere to Sort
changeLog.description: Table now supports clicking anywhere within a header cell to sort (excluding "helptext" & filter menu Icons). Previously, only the Table header cell label could be clicked to apply sorting.

changeLog.title: Table Header Cell Usability Updates
changeLog.description: Expanded click target size for "column toggle" Context Menu & "expand all" Table header cells. Fixed "cursor: pointer" state that was always applied to Table header cells - now only applies when Table column is sortable. Also fixed "cursor: pointer" state that was applied to "column group" & "split point" header cells - these are never interactive & should not indicate clickability.

changeLog.title: Updated Table Architecture & Styles
changeLog.description: Updated "filter" Icon position to always be right-aligned within Table header cells. Updated "sort" Icon position to appear beside the header cell label to the right/left. Added "pseudo-borders" (i.e. "hash marks") between Table header cells that clearly delineate each individual cell. Updated Table header cell text wrapping styles & hyphenation. Added background color to Table "column group cells" regardless of whether split-point headers are used.

changeLog.title: Table Filter Handles Lists
changeLog.description: Default column filters now will handle an array being passed as the data path for a column. All distinct values inside the all of the arrays for that column will display as filter options. A row will be hidden when all of the values in its array are toggled off, so if at least one value in the array is toggled on it will display.

changeLog.title: Add ability to provide contextual table actions
changeLog.description: Using the same event-based action handling and configuration as rowActions, you can now add tableActions to your table, which sit alongside the search box (if applicable) above the tables, meaning you no longer have to roll your own action bar for table.

changeLog.title: Table Filter Ability To Format Column Filter Data Prior to Comparing
changeLog.description: Added a property on the header that will allow a columnFilterCompareFormat to be passed in. This function will be called to transform the data for the column filters before they are then normalised and stored to check for equality when filtering.

changeLog.title: Table Empty State Configuration Added
changeLog.description: Added the ability to configure a table empty state, which shows when there are no dataItems available, no filters are applied, and the table isn't loading. The emptyStateConfig prop allows you to configure an icon, and action and a message to show.

changeLog.title: Ability to Display Subsets of Data For Table Rows
changeLog.description: Added the ability to give a function to the rowSubset property, which receives the current row data as it's parameter, and returns an array of dataItems which are rendered in an expandable panel beneath the parent data row.

changeLog.title: Table Usability/Accessibility Updates
changeLog.description:
Implemented several major usability improvements to Table:
  • Table rows now only display "cursor: pointer" for interactive elements
  • All Table actions (i.e. rowActions & actionColumnConfig) have been refactored to have consistent aesthetics, keyboard support, & :hover state styles
  • Checkboxes & radio buttons in selectable Tables now have :hover state styles & can be toggled by clicking anywhere within the containing table cell
  • Highlighting for selectable rows (i.e. highlightSelected) has been improved
  • Table's "expandable row" (i.e. expandableRowTemplate & expandableForm) "trigger buttons" now have :hover/:focus state styles & support for keyboard navigation
  • Table's "loading state" (i.e. dataLoading) has been updated to improve the visibility of the "loading spinner" Icon & disable background user interaction while Table is actively loading

changeLog.title: Table Additional Header Row and Table Footer
changeLog.description:
This feature adds a property `additionalHeaderRow` to the header grouping definition to configure headers to be displayed in a new row as opposed to a new column. The new `footerValue` and `footerRenderComponent` props have also been added to FluidTableHeader. These props enable the creation of a single footer for the table which differs from the existing group footer in the following ways:
  • Single footer: created for all data items in the table, only one footer row
  • Group footer: created for each set of grouped items in the table, one footer row per group

changeLog.title: Ability to export sorted, filtered and paginated data added
changeLog.description: This feature adds an additional member visibleRows to the mutation updated created by getTableState which contains the filtered and sorted data as the user sees it. Additionally, by providing a new prop exportOptions you can now tell the table to create an export action, which will execute either your own exportFn with the visible data, or a default export to CSV provided by FLUID Core.

changeLog.title: Adds ComputedCellValue and allows grouping functions to use live edits.
changeLog.description:
This feature adds the ability to provide a computedValueFn to a table header, which when used with a table that implements save actions, will compute its value in realtime according to the function passed to it, allowing computations based on cell changes to be displayed to the user before they hit save.
For grouping functions (headerValue, footerValue, etc) by using a new property useLive in the config, the computed cell functions will now use the updated datasource, even before committing the values.
Additionally, this feature adds the externalState property to allow state from outside the table to be used in any computation too.

changeLog.title: Updated "rowSubset" Table Aesthetics
changeLog.description: Updated styles for rowSubset Table to better delineate groups of "subset" rows. Subset "parent rows" are now highlighted when expanded, & subset "child rows" have a light gray background color when visible.

changeLog.title: Added Sandbox Demo Page for "rowSubset" Table
changeLog.description: Created <fluid-link inline href="/fluid/fluid-table-subset.html">FLUID Table "rowSubset" sandbox page</fluid-link> to demonstrate the feature's functionality / styles.

changeLog.title: Allowing "highlight" header attribute to be a function in addition to simple boolean.
changeLog.description: Allow the "highlight" attribute of a table header to be a function which takes the current row's dataItem and returns a boolean, which would allow us to highlight columns dynamically based on the row contents.

changeLog.title: Header Cell Menu Button Updates
changeLog.description: Updated :hover & :focus-visible styles of Table's "column visibility" menu Button, & added :focus-visible styles to filter menu Buttons for improved visibility/accessibility.

changeLog.title: Header Grouping Cell Alignment
changeLog.description: Add a new property for the fluid-table headers.grouping.cellAlignment. This allows to have a different cell alignment for the grouping header label.

changeLog.title: Table `SelectionOptions.selectableIf` property
changeLog.description: Adds FluidTableSelectionOptions.selectableIf?:(data: any) => boolean; property. This offers the ability to prevent certain rows from being selectable based on the row's data. When the function returns false the checkbox will be removed and will be replaced by an empty cell.

changeLog.title: 🐛: Fixed bug with showing/hiding edit actions programmatically
changeLog.description: The bug is caused by the el.removeAttribute failing when then edit actions in able are hidden and subsequently shown again programmatically. As the element reference is removed, it fires an NPE which blocks the JS and causes duplication. This changes it by checking the element reference exists before attempting to modify its attributes.

changeLog.title: 💡: Added programmatic identifiers to table cells and headers.
changeLog.description:
This update adds programmatic identifiers to Table cells and headers to aid with end-to-end testing. Table header id attributes are created in the format {tableId}_{dataPath}_header, where Table cell id attributes are created in the format {tableId}_{rowIdx}_{dataPath}.

For example, a header cell with dataPath "username" in a Table with tableId "user-table" would have the ID: user-table_username_header. The username cell on row 3 of the same Table would have the ID: user-table_2_username (where rows are 0-indexed).

changeLog.title: Editable Cell: Dynamic Combo Box Dropdown Menu Width
changeLog.description: Combo Boxes embedded within Table cells (via editableCellConfig) now have "dynamic width" dropdown menus that can extend 2x-3x the width of the Table cell, making options easier to read.

changeLog.title: Table Style Updates
changeLog.description: Aesthetic updates to right and left side of table when horizontal scroll is used. Shadow will appear and dissapear on start and stop of scroll

changeLog.title: Add property to table to allow hiding the expand/collapse all button
changeLog.description: The new table property `hideExpandAll` allows the expand/collapse all button to be hidden from the table header.

changeLog.title: Enhance clearSort to allow pre-sorted headers to be maintained.
changeLog.description: This update adds an additional parameter 'maintainPreSort' to the tables 'clearSort' instance method which, when true, and a pre-sorted header is configured, will return the table to its default sort state, rather than an unsorted state.

changeLog.title: Allow fine-grained control of stateful properties
changeLog.description: This update replaces the now deprecated stateful property with a new, improved statefulOptions property, which allows each stateful element to be individually configured as enabled or disabled, as well as the ability to decide if it should use localStorage or sessionStorage to store the values.

changeLog.title: Adds events for sort and filters cleared
changeLog.description: This update adds events for sortCleared, which fires when the table sort is cleared, either by clearSort method call, or via organic clearing from clicking through sort direction, and filtersCleared, which fires when filters are cleared via clearFilters method call

changeLog.title: Enhanced search clearing mechanism in manual search
changeLog.description:
Updated how the table handles the first key press, backspace, escape and the clear event from search-box in manual mode to reduce compute-
    intensive tasks when not explicitly actioned by the user.

changeLog.title: Enhanced FluidTableAction
Modify FluidGroupedTableHeader
changeLog.description: For dynamically populated tables, group headers will have their visibility set to false if their group contains no data and all header labels in that group are empty.

changeLog.title: Added clickRowToSelect property to mutually exclusive tables
changeLog.description: This update introduces the clickRowToSelect property for mutually exclusive tables, enabling row selection functionality.

changeLog.title: Fix Pagination Bug
changeLog.description: Updated pagination so the table only counts and shows rows that aren’t filtered or excluded by search. Prevents duplicated rows on different pages.

changeLog.title: Fix Persistence Bug
changeLog.description: Fixed an issue where persisted/stateful items were not reapplied after dataItems changed.

changeLog.title: Fixed Stale Row Data in Editable Cell Callbacks
changeLog.description: Fixed issue where editable cell configurations, validators, and callbacks (such as disabledIf and editableCellConfig) were receiving stale row data that did not include pending updates from other cells in the same row. The table now applies pending mutations before evaluating cell configurations. Form elements with custom validation receive _parentState for access to current row data. Improved validation handling by using validate() instead of markTouchedAndValidate() with promise-based timing. The editableCellChange event now emits current row state.

changeLog.title: Disable Row Highlighting Property Added
changeLog.description: Added `disableRowHighlighting` property to disable hover effects on table rows. Expandable rows now have a static gray background (#f5f5f5) with no hover effect by default. Expandable rows also feature bottom border radius for better visual distinction when expanded.

changeLog.title: Improved Stateful Table Performance
changeLog.description: Substantially improved Stateful Table performance by restoring cached filters instantly during initialization instead of waiting for the first render cycle to complete. Added restoreFiltersFromCache() function for immediate filter restoration, eliminating layout churn and significant render delay on first load. Updated firstRender event to emit immediately on componentDidLoad. Improved render performance of selectable Tables and renderComponent cells by eliminating unnecessary RxJS theme subscriptions. Reduced redundant function calls during render cycles that degraded performance.

changeLog.title: Toggle and Render Performance Optimizations
changeLog.description: Updated Toggle and Toggle Group components with componentShouldUpdate() lifecycle hooks to eliminate unnecessary re-renders when config or _elementState props have not actually changed, improving selectable Table render performance. Refactored waitForChildrenToRender() utility to accept configurable MutationObserver options for more targeted observation and improved performance.

changeLog.title: Fixed Search and Filter Interaction Issues
changeLog.description: Fixed multiple issues with the interaction between search and column filters. Added centralized visibility logic through updateRowVisibility() to ensure consistent behavior across filters, search, pagination, and grouping. When excludeFiltered is false, search results now correctly override column filters via the new OVERRIDE_FILTERED flag. Fixed clearSearchResults() to properly restore column filter state and clear memoized cache to prevent stale results. Fixed pagination to respect existing visibility state from filters and search instead of overwriting it. Added comprehensive test coverage for search, filter, and pagination scenarios.

changeLog.title: Sort Stability and Pagination Fixes
changeLog.description: Added stable tie-breaker logic to sortData() that ensures rows with duplicate sort values are sorted in a consistent order based on original row index. Fixed pagination bug where updating dataItems after initialization caused all rows to be shown instead of the selected page size. Fixed page size resetting when "total" items originally shown by adding _showTotalItems flag to the Paginator. Fixed Stateful Table bug where persisted pagination state was not applied correctly due to an undefined Paginator reference on first render.

changeLog.title: Range Selection with Shift+Click
changeLog.description: Added enableRangeSelection property to selectionOptions that enables selecting or deselecting multiple rows at once using Shift+Click. Click a row to set the anchor, then Shift+Click another row to select/deselect all rows in between. The selection mode (select or deselect) is determined by the anchor row's state. Rows in the range are highlighted while the Shift key is held. Range selection state resets on page change, search, or filter operations.

changeLog.title: Refactored Table LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Table's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties. Also migrated styles for Table's header, body, & SCSS mixins from main stylesheet into SCSS partials for maintainability.

changeLog.title: Aesthetic & Usability Updates
changeLog.description: Implemented various aesthetic & usability updates to Table, as well as several updates to theme-specific styles for better alignment to overall theme look & feel.

changeLog.title: Support for Multiple Sticky Columns
changeLog.description: Updated Table's stickyColumn functionality to support up to 3 sticky/frozen columns (not including "selection" or "expand/collapse" columns that automatically become sticky when at least 1 sticky column is configured).

changeLog.title: Usage Examples Updates
changeLog.description: Updated Table's usage examples to reflect new features, remove deprecated Props, & to use configurations that better demonstrate the component's functionality.

changeLog.title: Compact Display Density
changeLog.description: Added displayDensity Prop to Table that adjusts font size, cell padding/spacing, & Paginator size to be more or less compact.

props.name: addTabBtnConfig
props.docs: If true, "+" button will appear to allow creation of default new tabs.

props.name: debounceChange
props.docs:
When provided, tabs will wait until the observable is true before allowing the
tab to change.

props.name: disableNavigationArrows
props.docs:
If true, tab navigation arrows will be disabled (not recommended unless you are making your
users aware that keyboard will be their only option)

props.name: identifier
props.docs: A unique identifier for this tabset

props.name: maximumNumberOfTabs
props.docs: Maximum number of tabs that can be added using add tab button

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: removeMargin
props.docs: If true, Tabs will not add the default margin-top: 1em.

props.name: tabCanChange

This example shows what the "Add Tab" Button configuration looks like, but does not include the event listener & additional logic necessary for actually adding new FLUID Tab children to FLUID Tabs.

To configure the "Add Tab" functionality, add an event listener for addTabButtonClicked to FLUID Tabs. When the Event is triggered, generate a new FLUID Tab component & append it as a child of FLUID Tabs. FLUID Tabs watches for added/removed FLUID Tab children & will dynamically update itself when changes occur.

The maximumNumberOfTabs Prop sets a limit on the total number of FLUID Tab children that can be added to its body before the "Add Tab" Button is disabled - this includes explicitly defined FLUID Tab children, as well as FLUID Tab children that have been dynamically added via the "Add Tab" Button. Once the maximum number of Tab children has been reached, the "Add Tab" Button will be disabled until at least one existing Tab is removed.

changeLog.title: Tabs Created
changeLog.description: Tabs component created.

changeLog.title: Allow Tabs to be Refreshed
changeLog.description: Adds ability to refresh the tabset when adding or removing tabs dynamically by calling refreshTabs on the element.

changeLog.title: Refactored Tabs LESS Stylesheets
changeLog.description: Removed obsolete "base" & "defaults" Tabs stylesheets & migrated styles into new LESS stylesheet format with theme tokens. Updated theme-specific styles for Tabs & improved :hover, :focus, & disabled state styles.

changeLog.title: Standardized Tabs Keyboard Navigation
changeLog.description: Updated Tabs keyboard navigation to use standard "arrow keys" method to change :focus instead of tab key.

changeLog.title: Tabs Accessibility Overhaul
changeLog.description: Added appropriate "aria" attributes to Tabs component & set up "aria" associations between Tabs & Tab components. Improved styles :hover, :focus, & disabled states, and adjusted color contrast for accessibility.

changeLog.title: Added Render Tests to Tabs
changeLog.description: Added unit tests file to Tabs component directory & implemented full suite of render tests.

changeLog.title: Added Functional Tests to Tabs
changeLog.description: Added missing functional tests for Tabs.

changeLog.title: Adds i18n Strategy
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to configure FLUID Tabs to accept message translations (MVP)

changeLog.title: Adds "Add Tab" button/functionality
changeLog.description: Adds the ability to display "Add Tab" button that fires an event.  Takes button config for modifyable props, including internationalizations

changeLog.title: Adds the ability to add custom content to the right of the label of tab buttons.

props.name: textOverflow
props.docs:
Sets overflow behavior when text width is greater than the component's
width. By default, FLUID Text will wrap overflowing content onto new
line(s). Setting this Prop to "clip" will truncate text overflow

(NOTE: these values should only be used when seeing the entire text
is NOT necessary to understand the content's context/purpose). Both
"clip" & "ellipsis" values will display a tooltip on :hover containing
the full, unedited content.

changeLog.title: Added theme dependent text colors
changeLog.description: Added new mechanism for applying colors to fluid-text based on theme, and severity levels. Colors are now completely dependent on theme, so blue in legacy theme is different to blue in LM or Corp theme, but the props remain the same. If no color property is supplied, the text will inherit from the containing element.

changeLog.title: Added wrap prop
changeLog.description: Added the ability to provide a wrap prop (boolean) to enable the text to show as wrapped if newlines exist within the provided text.

changeLog.title: Text Overflow Truncation Support
changeLog.description: Added textOverflow Prop to FLUID Text that allows overflow to be wrapped, clipped, or truncated with ellipsis. If textOverflow is set to ellipsis or clip, a tooltip will be displayed on :hover that contains the full, unedited text content. Also, renamed existing wrap Prop => preserveSpacing & updated Prop documentation to prevent confusion.

changeLog.title: Accessibility Improvements
changeLog.description: Fixed accessibility issue with FLUID Text's muted color by updating the shade of gray to pass WCAG AA standards. Also, increased FLUID Text's small font size for better legibility/visibility. Finally, updated FLUID Text to dynamically set the "root" HTML tag to the most appropriate semantic HTML element based on its Prop configuration.

changeLog.title: Usage Example Overhaul
changeLog.description: Completely refactored FLUID Text's usage examples & added new examples for all major Props & configurations. Also added usage example for new textOverflow Prop.

changeLog.title: Refactored Text LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Text's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Accessibility Improvements
changeLog.description: Updated FLUID Text's color Prop styles for success, warning, & error to be WCAG AA compliant for contrast. Also increased font sizes for Text's Legacy theme muted & small Props for legibility.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
FLUID Text Area is an input field for multi-line or long-form user input. For single line or short form entry, use FLUID Input Field. Unlike Input Field, Text Area supports text wrapping and can be resized vertically to accommodate any length of user input.

Text Area's default height can be adjusted using the "rows" Prop, where each "row" is equal to one line of text. Additionally, if user input overflows Text Area's current height, the component will automatically resize itself so that all content is visible without scrolling.

props.name: allowCancel
props.docs:
If true, displays a "clear" button that resets the form field when
clicked. Button is NOT displayed when field has "required" validation
or is empty.

props.name: autoFocus
props.docs:
Then true, this field will automatically have focus on page load.
Note: only one form field should have "autoFocus" set to true
on a page. Multiple fields with "autoFocus: true" can/will cause
unexpected behavior.

props.name: autoResize
props.docs:
When true, Text Area will automatically resize itself so that its
height is equal to the height of its content.

NOTE: If "inlineField" is set to true, "rows" defaults to 1 which disables
auto-resize. To enable auto-resize with "inlineField: true", explicitly set
"rows" to 0.

props.name: config
props.docs: Allows Text Area's Props to be set via a single configuration object.

When "maxLength" Prop is defined, setting this Prop to true will
