props.docs: If true, Text Area will be disabled & will not allow user input.

props.name: fluidTranslate
props.docs: Internationalisation

props.name: helpText
props.docs:
If provided, Text Area's Form Label will render a "helptext" icon
with attached Popover. To render a basic Popover with default
Prop values, simply provide the Popover's message as a string
value to this Prop. To render a Popover with customized Props,
provide a FluidPopoverConfig object to this Prop with the "message"
property set. For more information, please see Popover's API
documentation.

props.name: htmlAutocomplete
props.docs:
Sets the HTML "autocomplete" attribute on the Text Area's embedded
<textarea>. Accepts 'on', 'off', or a space-separated <token-list> that
describes the meaning of the autocompletion value. See
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/autocomplete
for more information.

props.name: identifier
props.docs:
When provided, the "identifier" string will be prepended to
"data-test-id" attributes on Text Area's inner architecture to help
facilitate testing.

props.name: initialValue
props.docs:
If provided, populates the form field with a default value. NOTE:
this Prop takes precedence over the "value" Prop.

props.name: inlineField
props.docs: Removes the form field's default bottom margin when true.

props.name: label
props.docs:
If provided, a FLUID Form Label will be rendered above the Text
Area with the specified string.

props.name: labelTextOverflow
props.docs:
Sets the Form Label's text overflow behavior. By default, overflowing
label text will be truncated with ellipsis.

props.name: maskingConfig
props.docs:
When provided, enables masking of the form field's value when the
component loses :focus. Text Area will apply the specified
"maskingFn" to its text value after the amount of time specified in
"blurDelay" elapses (see "Form Field Masking" walkthrough guide in
the FLUID Documentation Site for more information).

props.name: maxLength
props.docs:
Sets a maximum length (number of characters) allowed to be entered
in the Text Area & displays a character counter in the bottom
right-hand corner of the field.

props.name: maxLengthPopoverConfig
props.docs:
When the "maxLength" Prop is provided, Text Area will render a
character counter in the bottom right-hand corner of the field -
when the user enters the maximum number of characters allowed,
the character counter will display a Popover that informs the
user that they cannot enter additional characters. This Prop
allows customization of this "max length" Popover. NOTE: to
remove the "max length" Popover, explicitly set this Prop's
value to null.

props.name: maxRows
props.docs:
When set, the text area will start at the height defined by "rows" and
dynamically expand as the user types, up to the maximum height defined
by "maxRows". Once content exceeds "maxRows", a scrollbar will appear.

NOTE - This property only takes effect when autoResize is true.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: placeholder
props.docs: Optional placeholder text displayed when the form field is empty.

props.name: readonly
props.docs:
If true, Text Area will not be mutable (i.e. user cannot edit the
form field's value). However, the form field will still allow :focus &
text selection.

props.name: rows
props.docs:
The default height of the Text Area, where each "row" is equal to
one line of text.

NOTE - Setting the rows property will disable the auto-resize functionality
of textarea unless maxRows is also set.

props.name: supplementaryLabel
props.docs:
If provided, a secondary muted label will be displayed to the right
of the primary Form Label.

props.name: value
props.docs:
The Text Area's current value. This Prop is dynamically updated to
reflect the form field's current state, so it can be used as a
"synchronous" alternative to the public async "getValue()" method.
If provided on first load, populates the form field with a default
value. After the component is rendered, changes to this Prop will
update the form field's value (similar to "setValue()" method). NOTE:
"initialValue" will override this Prop on first load if both Props
are provided.

components.contextData:
FLUID Text Area is an input field for multi-line or long-form user input. For single line or short form entry, use FLUID Input Field. Unlike Input Field, Text Area supports text wrapping and can be resized vertically to accommodate any length of user input.

Text Area's default height can be adjusted using the "rows" Prop, where each "row" is equal to one line of text. Additionally, if user input overflows Text Area's current height, the component will automatically resize itself so that all content is visible without scrolling.

changeLog.title: Text Area Created
changeLog.description: FLUID Text Area component created.

changeLog.title: Text area Field Updated
changeLog.description: Added disabled property to render for Fluid Text area Field component.

changeLog.title: Fixed Text Area Placeholder Text :focus Bug
changeLog.description: Fixed issue in Text Area LESS that prevented placeholder text from being hidden on :focus (which was intended functionality). Also added fading transition to placeholder text on :focus.

changeLog.title: Text Area Background Color
changeLog.description: Fixed issue with Text Area LESS that caused it to have a transparent background instead of white.

changeLog.title: Updated Text Area Border & Placeholder Colors
changeLog.description: Previously, Text Area border & placeholder text colors were too light in contrast to a standard white background color, resulting in poor visibility. Both border & placeholder text colors were darkened in each theme to increase visibility and aligned more closely with each theme's look & feel.

changeLog.title: Fixed Text Area Disabled State :hover Styles Bug
changeLog.description: Fixed bug in Text Area that caused :hover state styles to be displayed when "disabled" @Prop set to true.

changeLog.title: Added Masking Support to Text Area
changeLog.description: Added "maskingConfig" Prop to Text Area that enables masking to be applied to the form field's value on blur.

changeLog.title: Added Text Area "value" Prop
changeLog.description: Added "value" Prop to Text Area that tracks the form field's current text value. The Prop is dynamically updated to reflect the form field's current state, so it can be used as a "synchronous" alternative to the public async "getValue()" method. If provided on first load, the "value" Prop populates the form field with a default value. After the component is rendered, changes to the Prop will update the form field's value (similar to "setValue()" method). NOTE: "initialValue" will override this Prop on first load if both Props are provided.

changeLog.title: Refined Text Area Auto-Resize Functionality
changeLog.description: Added Prop "autoResize" that controls whether Text Area automatically adjusts height to match height of content. Also improved auto-resize algorithm's functionality & performance - Text Area now automatically resizes when a window resize event or UI layout shift causes the form field's height to change.

changeLog.title: Removed Ability to Resize Disabled/Readonly Text Area
changeLog.description: Updated Text Area to have static height when in disabled or readonly state (i.e. "drag handle" in the bottom right-hand corner does not display when component is disabled / readonly).

changeLog.title: Standardized Text Area Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Text Area styles to be consistent with other FLUID form fields in each theme.

changeLog.title: Refactored Text Area Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Completely refactored Text Area usage examples to cover major Props & common use cases.

changeLog.title: Refactored Text Area Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Completely refactored Text Area usage examples to cover major Props & common use cases.

changeLog.title: Add autoFocus prop
changeLog.description: autoFocus allows this field to automatically be focused on page load without user action.

changeLog.title: Improved Disabled State Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Text Area disabled state styles for improved readability/legibility.

changeLog.title: Updated Validation Styles
changeLog.description: Updated Text Area's validation error text so that it doesn't cause layout shift when visible. Also added "fade in" visual effect to error text.

changeLog.title: Refactored Text Area LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Text Area's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Character Counter Style Updates
changeLog.description: Updated Text Area's character counter styles to be more consistent with each theme's overall look & feel.

changeLog.title: Character Counter Assistive Technology Support
changeLog.description: Updated Text Area's character counter to fully support assistive technology. Character counter now includes contextual information & live status updates that are exclusive to screen readers.

changeLog.title: "autoResize" Performance Upgrade
changeLog.description: Text Area now uses native CSS field-sizing property instead of JS for autoResize functionality in supported browsers.

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update allows the outputFormat feature, previously only available in the context of a form, to be used in standalone mode too.

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update adds new maxLengthPopoverConfig prop to Text Area, allowing users to customize the popover message when the maximum length is reached.

changeLog.title: "Autofill" Menu Config ("autocomplete" attr)
changeLog.description:
FLUID Text Area now has the ability to configure the autocomplete attribute on its embedded textarea element via the htmlAutocomplete Prop. This allows developers to specify how browsers should handle the "autofill" dropdown menu that provides suggestions based on previously entered data.

Note: the "autofill" menu is now disabled by default on "standalone" Text Area instances (i.e. not inside FLUID Form), but can be enabled by configuring the htmlAutocomplete Prop. See MDN Docs for the "autocomplete" attribute for configuration information.

changeLog.title: Added "maxRows" Prop for Bounded Auto-Resize
changeLog.description: Added new maxRows Prop that allows the Text Area to dynamically expand as the user types, up to a defined maximum height. The text area starts at the height defined by the rows Prop and expands until it reaches maxRows, at which point a scrollbar appears. This improves usability by eliminating unnecessarily tall text areas when content is minimal.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Added Observability Instrumentation
changeLog.description: Instrumented FLUID Text Area for observability using the FLUID Observability Provider pattern. Tracks user interactions for focus, blur, and input.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

props.name: baseZIndex

changeLog.title: Toggle Created
changeLog.description: Fluid Toggle component created.

changeLog.title: Switch, Flag, Link and custom icon toggles added
changeLog.description: Fluid Toggle now supports switch, flag and link toggleType, as well as custom icon toggles via customToggleConfig props. Custom toggle config accepts iconOn and iconOff icon configuration using FluidIconConfig interface. Additionally, toggle configuration has been extended with labelOn and labelOff properties to provide custom labels for the switch type - examples have been added to reflect these changes.

changeLog.title: Toggle Architecture Refactor
changeLog.description: Refactored FLUID Toggle for accessibility - Toggle input is now rendered inside its label (makes label text clickable even when "id" attribute isn't provided). Added keyboard navigation support to Flag, Link, Custom, & Switch Toggles. Added :focus, :focus-visible, & disabled states to all variations of Toggle. Added appropriate "aria-" attributes for accessibility.

changeLog.title: Added "inlineField" & "labelAlignment" @Props
changeLog.description: Added "inlineField" @Prop that gives the ability to specify Toggle as block-level element when set to "false" (this @Prop is "true" by default). Added "labelAlignment" @Prop that specifies whether label appears left / right of Toggle.

changeLog.title: Added @Watch to "config" @Prop
changeLog.description: Added @Watch decorator for FLUID Toggle "config" @Prop that re-maps config properties to local Props (when "config" @Prop changes).

changeLog.title: Added "Indeterminate" State
changeLog.description: Added "indeterminate" Toggle value. Used with Toggle Groups "Toggle All" checkbox to indicate that Toggles within the group are not uniformly checked/unchecked (standard behavior for grouped or nested checkboxes). This should ONLY be used with grouped / nested checkboxes.

changeLog.title: Fixed Incorrect Flag Toggle On/Off Colors
changeLog.description: Updated Flag Toggle color to be light grey when "off" & red when "on" (previously red when "off" & light grey when "on").

changeLog.title: Replaced Bottom Margin with additional Top/Bottom Padding
changeLog.description: Removed bottom margin on Toggle & compensated with additional top/bottom padding. Larger click target is better for accessibility & allows Toggle Group "horizontal layout" Toggles to be vertically centered.

changeLog.title: Updated Checkbox / Label Vertical Alignment
changeLog.description: For checkbox Toggles, checkbox input is now top-aligned with label text (only noticable if checkbox label text wraps).

changeLog.title: Removed "for" Attribute from Toggle Label
changeLog.description: Removed unnecessary "for" attribute from Toggle label (input is descendant of label).

changeLog.title: Add autoFocus prop
changeLog.description: autoFocus allows this field to automatically be focused on page load without user action.

changeLog.title: Improved Disabled State Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Toggle disabled state styles for improved readability/legibility.

changeLog.title: Decoupled "helpText" Popover from Toggle Input
changeLog.description: Decoupled Toggle's helpText Popover from its embedded input element. Now, clicking the helpText Popover Icon won't change the Toggle's "selected" state.

changeLog.title: Refactored Toggle LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Toggle's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Toggle Accessibility Improvements
changeLog.description:
Toggle Switch, Flag Toggle, Link Toggle, Custom Toggle, & Text Toggle have all been updated to visually hide the embedded input element properly, fixing the aria-hidden console warnings that occurred every time the Toggle's value changed.

Flag Toggle's unchecked/off state color has also been updated to pass WCAG AA standards for contrast. Finally, Toggle's readonly state has been updated to prevent user interaction.

changeLog.title: Toggle Chip
changeLog.description: Added support for toggleType: toggle-chip variant to FLUID Toggle. This toggleType displays the Toggle as a "chip" style button with rounded edges & a visible checkbox to the left of the label.

changeLog.title: Enabled outputFormat in standalone mode
changeLog.description: This update allows the outputFormat feature, previously only available in the context of a form, to be used in standalone mode too.

changeLog.title: Adds 'Favourite' to toggle type.
changeLog.description: This update adds 'Favourite' to toggle type to render an outlined star when unchecked and a filled star when checked.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text:
Using toggles is a good option when you want to give your visitors the option to choose several items from a group of choices.
In that regard, the toggle group works opposite of a radio group, which only allows you to select one item from a group of choices. The FLUID
toggle group allows you to provide a list of toggle options, which will render in a group, and using the toggleState event, will tell the calling
component the full state of the toggle group when something changes. Additionally, by adding a toggleAllLabel, FLUID automatically provides a 'Toggle
All' option, which will control the entire group!

When true, Toggle Group is formatted for use within a parent menu:
the group becomes scrollable, Toggles become "menu items", and the
"Toggle All" Toggle becomes a "sticky" menu header (when configured).
NOTE: Toggle Group's parent element MUST have an explicit height set
for this Prop to display correctly.

changeLog.description: Added "disabled" @Prop that disables entire group (including "Toggle All").

changeLog.title: Horizontal Layout
changeLog.description: Added option to display Toggles horizontally (instead of vertically) via "horizontalLayout" @Prop.

changeLog.title: "Toggle All" Indeterminate State
changeLog.description: Added support for "indeterminate" state to "Toggle All". If Toggles within the group are NOT all uniformly checked or unchecked, "Toggle All" displays as "indeterminate". Only applies if "Toggle All" Toggle is a checkbox (does NOT apply to switch, custom, etc.).

changeLog.title: Added "asMenuSection" @Prop to Toggle Group
changeLog.description: Added support / styles for Toggle Group used within Context Menu via the "asMenuSection" @Prop.

changeLog.title: Improved Disabled State Color Contrast
changeLog.description: Updated Toggle Group disabled state styles for improved readability/legibility.

changeLog.title: Refactored Toggle Group LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Toggle Group's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Chip Group & Toggle Chip Group
changeLog.description: Added chip & toggle-chip variants to Toggle Group that can be configured via the new groupToggleType Prop. These variants display the individual Toggles within the group as "chips" instead of standard "checkbox" Toggles. The toggle-chip variant displays a checkbox within each "chip", while the chip variant does not.

changeLog.title: Refactored Toggle Group Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Toggle Group's usage examples have been refactored to include the new chip & toggle-chip variants, as well as examples for all major Prop configurations.

changeLog.title: Internal State Refactor
changeLog.description: Toggle Group's internal state has been refactored to use a single, unified state object for all Toggles within the group. This change simplifies the component's logic & improves performance.

changeLog.title: Functionality Improvements
changeLog.description:
Several aspects of Toggle Group have been updated to enhance the component's functionality.

First, the toggleOptions Prop now supports updates after the component has been initialized, which means that you can now dynamically update the Toggles displayed within the group. When the toggleOptions Prop is updated, Toggle Group will now retain the values (i.e. "checked" states) of any Toggles that previously existed in the original toggleOptions array (UNLESS explicitly overridden).

The toggleOptions Prop now also supports the toggled property of FluidToggleConfig, providing another way to programmatically set the "checked" state of Toggles within the group.

Finally, the toggleAllValue Prop has been updated to dynamically stay "in-sync" with the "Toggle All" Toggle's value (when configured), which means that the Prop can be used to programmatically set the "checked" state of the "Toggle All" Toggle after the component has been initialized.

changeLog.title: Label & Help Text Support
changeLog.description: Toggle Group now supports the standard FLUID Form Element label & helpText Props. The label Prop (not to be confused with toggleAllLabel, which sets the "Toggle All" Toggle's label) displays a FLUID Form Label above the entire Toggle Group when provided. The helpText Prop displays an "information" Icon with contextual Popover to the right of Toggle Group's Form Label when configured.

changeLog.title: Validation & _elemnentState Support
changeLog.description: Toggle Group now supports the standard FLUID Form Element validation & _elementState Props. The validation Prop allows you to set the validation state of the Toggle Group, while the _elementState Prop allows you to set the overall state of the Toggle Group like every other Form Element component. These Props are used to apply appropriate styles & behaviors based on the current state of the Toggle Group.

changeLog.title: Validation Error Message Wrapping
changeLog.description: Added a new wrapValidation property that allows validation error messages to wrap onto multiple lines instead of being truncated with ellipsis. This is useful for inline (horizontal) form layouts where inputs should not expand to accommodate long validation messages. Can be set directly on the component or inherited from a parent FLUID Form.

changeLog.title: Validation Warning Support & Error Icon
changeLog.description: Validation messages now display with an inline icon indicating severity. Error messages show an error icon, and validators with severity: FluidSeverity.WARNING display with a warning icon and warning color. Warnings do not prevent form submission. Screen reader accessibility improved with role="alert" and severity-prefixed announcements.

docsTags.name: contextData
docsTags.text: FLUID Tree Menu is a hierarchical list of menu items with optional expandable/collapsible subsections. It is primarily used for navigation, but can also be used to display any structured collection of FluidMenuItem objects (e.g. file directories, locations, etc.).

props.name: autoScrollSelectedItem
props.docs:
When true, Tree Menu will automatically scroll to the selected
menu item (if offscreen) when it is programmatically changed (via
"menuItems" Prop update or "setSelectedItem()" method) OR when
Sidebar is opened (if using built-in Tree Menu). NOTE: this
Prop has no effect when the user manually selects a menu item,
as the selected item will already be visible onscreen.

props.name: collapsibleSubmenus
props.docs:
When true (default), submenus can be expanded/collapsed using the
parent submenu button. If false, all submenus will be rendered
open by default & can't be expanded/collapsed. This Prop can
be overridden for individual FluidMenuItems using the
"submenuCollapsible" property.

props.name: config
props.docs: Allows Tree Menu local Props to be set via a single configuration object.

props.name: displayDensity
props.docs:
Adjusts menu item size, padding, & spacing to be more or less compact.
For example, "compact" density increases the number of menu items shown
by ~30% compared to "default" density. NOTE: it is recommended to use
"default" density for Tree Menu implementations within FLUID Sidebar.

props.name: menuItems
props.docs: Array of FluidMenuItems that populates the Tree Menu.

props.name: menuType
props.docs:
Sets Tree Menu styles & functionality. "default" & "sidebar" types
look & behave as a default Tree Menu. "dropdown" type is styled to
be embedded within a dropdown menu (i.e. similar to Context Menu
links) & does not display the current "selected" menu item.

props.name: overrideGlobalTheme
props.docs:
If FluidThemeProvider is used, should this component override the
global theme with its local theme?

props.name: selectableSubmenuButtons
props.docs:
When true, submenu buttons can be selected like regular menu items.
If false (default), submenu buttons can only be used to expand/
collapse their child submenus. NOTE: if this Prop is false and
"collapsibleSubmenus" Prop is also false, the "submenuButtonClick"
event will NOT be emitted when submenu buttons are clicked (unless
FluidMenuItem "submenuCollapsible" property override is used).

props.name: sidebarMenu
props.docs:
DEPRECATED: "sidebarMenu" is now deprecated. Instead, use "menuType"
Prop with value "sidebar". -- Is the Tree Menu displayed within a
Sidebar? If "true", adds negative left/right margin that offsets
the Sidebar's default padding & creates a seamless, "edge-to-edge"
Sidebar menu.

props.name: textOverflow
props.docs:
Sets how menu item labels handle text overflow. By default, a menu item
label will wrap its text if the width is greater than the width of the Tree
Menu (this should be used in the majority of use cases for best User
Experience). Setting this Prop to "clip" will truncate text overflow
mid-character, and "ellipsis" will truncate text overflow with "..." (these
values should only be used when seeing the entire menu item label text is
NOT necessary to understand the menu item's context/purpose). Both "clip" &
"ellipsis" values will display a tooltip on :hover containing the full,
unedited menu item label.

props.name: theme
props.docs: What theme settings should the component use?

props.name: themePalette
props.docs:
When provided, adjusts the current theme's color palette & appearance.
NOTE: a theme palette acts as a "style override" applied ON TOP of
the current theme & isn't necessary for "standard" theme aesthetics.

methods.name: getFlattenedSubmenuArray
methods.docs: Returns flattened array of all menu items that contain submenus.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.docs: Returns the currently selected menu item.

methods.name: getSelectedItemPath
methods.docs:
Returns an array of menu item(s) that constitutes a "consecutive path"
to the currently selected menu item. For example, if the selected menu
item is nested within a submenu, "selectedItemPath" will consist of the
selected item's parent menu item (index 0) & the selected item (index 1).
Can be used to populate FLUID Breadcrumb's "trail" Prop.

methods.name: getTreeMenuState
methods.docs: Returns the current derived Tree Menu state.

methods.name: scrollSelectedItemIntoView
methods.docs:
Scrolls the currently selected menu item into view (if not already
visible). Requirements for scrolling to occur: a menu item must be
selected, the selected item must NOT be hidden within a collapsed
submenu, & the selected item must be outside the visible bounds
of the viewport.

methods.name: setSelectedItem
methods.signature: setSelectedItem(menuItemId?: string | null, disableAutoScroll?: boolean) => Promise<FluidMenuItem>
methods.docs:
Sets the selected menu item based on the "id" provided. If no "id" is
provided or "id" is null, unselects the currently selected menu item.
NOTE: all menu items must have an "id" property for this method to work
correctly (unless unselecting currently selected menu item).

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: menuItemId - "id" property of menu item to be selected or null (optional)

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: disableAutoScroll - prevents auto-scrolling to selected item when true (only relevant when "autoScrollSelectedItem" Prop is true)

methods.name: toggleSubmenus
methods.docs: Toggles all Tree Menu submenus open or closed.

docsTags.name: param
docsTags.text: open - boolean indicating whether submenus should be open or closed

events.docs:
Event fired when a menu item with no submenu is clicked. Contains
the FluidMenuItem that was clicked.

Event fired when a menu item with a submenu is clicked. Contains
the FluidMenuItem that was clicked.

components.contextData: FLUID Tree Menu is a hierarchical list of menu items with optional expandable/collapsible subsections. It is primarily used for navigation, but can also be used to display any structured collection of FluidMenuItem objects (e.g. file directories, locations, etc.).

changeLog.title: Tree Menu Created
changeLog.description: Fluid Tree Menu component created (functionality / styles moved from Sidebar).

changeLog.title: Tree Menu Themes & Styles
changeLog.description: Themes created for Tree Menu component. Added styles for Tree Menu "link buttons", section headings, & dividers.

changeLog.title: Nested Submenus & Other Improvements
changeLog.description: Added ability to pass nested submenus via "menuItems" & expand/collapse functionality. Added "disabled" state to menu items.

changeLog.title: Tree Menu Accessibility Audit
changeLog.description: Audited Tree Menu accessibility. Swapped "a" tags for "button" tags since "href" attributes not used.

changeLog.title: Integrated FLUID Navigation
changeLog.description: Updated Tree Menu to use FLUID Navigation functional components.

changeLog.title: Updated Tests for Addition of FLUID Navigation
changeLog.description: Updated render / functional tests to expect FLUID Navigation functional components.

changeLog.title: Add Icon Functionality For Menu Items
changeLog.description: Added logic to show icons on menu items. They are right aligned (for all themes) and currently size sm (small) looks best.

changeLog.title: Fixed Disabled Submenu Buttons in Tree Menu
changeLog.description: Previously, disabled Tree Menu submenu buttons did not look disabled. Submenu buttons are now styled to be consistent with disabled menu items.

changeLog.title: Fixed Tree Menu Icon Popover Misalignment Issue
changeLog.description: Fixed issue that caused Icon Popovers to be misaligned with their Icon triggers in Tree Menus slotted in to Sidebars.

changeLog.title: Added "collapsibleSubmenus" @Prop to Tree Menu
changeLog.description: Added ability to specify whether all Tree Menu submenus are collapsible via "collapsibleSubmenus" @Prop. If this @Prop is set to "false", all Tree Menu submenus will be rendered "open" by default & submenu buttons will NOT render an expand/collapse "chevron" icon. The "collapsibleSubmenus" @Prop can be overridden on individual submenus via the "submenuCollapsible" property of FluidMenuItem.

changeLog.title: Added "selectableSubmenuButtons" @Prop to Tree Menu
changeLog.description: Added ability to specify whether Tree Menu submenu buttons can be selected like regular menu items. By default, clicking a submenu button will expand/collapse its corresponding submenu, but will NOT change the currently selected menu item. However, if "selectableSubmenuButtons" is true, clicking a submenu button WILL change the currently selected menu item to be said submenu button (and will also still expand/collapse the corresponding submenu IF "collapsibleSubmenus" is true).

changeLog.title: Refactored Tree Menu Unit Tests
changeLog.description: Updated Tree Menu theme render tests, and added Tree Menu functional tests to cover all methods critical to the component's core functionality.

changeLog.title: Added Tree Menu Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Added usage examples for Tree Menu & multiple variations of "menuItems" @Prop.

changeLog.title: Added "iconBefore" & "iconAfter" Support to Menu Items
changeLog.description: Refactored menu item Icons in Tree Menu. Added support for Icon displayed before the menu item label & updated naming convention for Icon displayed after menu item label to be consistent with other FLUID components (i.e. previously: "icon", now: "iconAfter").

changeLog.title: Added Support for Embedded Badges in Menu Items
changeLog.description: Added "badge" property to FluidMenuItem - when provided, displays a FLUID Badge to the right of a menu item's label. The "badge" property accepts a FluidBadgeConfig object, which allows full customization of the embedded Badge's @Props.

changeLog.title: Added Tree Menu Display Density Settings
changeLog.description: Added "displayDensity" @Prop to Tree Menu that adjusts menu item size, padding, & spacing to be more or less compact. For example, "compact" density increases the number of menu items shown by ~30% compared to "default" density. NOTE: it is recommended to use "default" density for Tree Menu implementations within FLUID Sidebar.

changeLog.title: Added Menu Item Text Overflow Settings to Tree Menu
changeLog.description: Added "textOverflow" @Prop to Tree Menu that controls behavior of menu item text overflow. Overflow can be truncated ("clip"), truncated with ellipsis ("ellipsis"), or wrapped onto new lines ("wrap"). Menu items with truncated text will display a tooltip on :hover containing the full, unedited menu item label. While the "textOverflow" @Prop applies to ALL Tree Menu menu items, individual menu items can override the global overflow settings using the "textOverflow" property of FluidMenuItem.

changeLog.title: Updated Tree Menu Usage Examples
changeLog.description: Updated Tree Menu with usage examples for: "iconBefore" / "iconAfter" in menu items, "textOverflow" @Prop & individual menu item overrides, "displayDensity" @Prop, & embedded menu item Badges.

changeLog.title: Added Support for FluidMenuItem "href" & "target" Properties
changeLog.description: Added support for FluidMenuItem "href" property in the "menuItems" array - generates standard anchor elements that do NOT rely on the consuming application's router for navigation. Also added support for "target" property, which allows a menu item links to be opened in a new tab by default (must be used with "href" property / NOT compatible with "route" property).

changeLog.title: Added Support for Slotted Icons in Menu Items
changeLog.description: Tree Menu now supports custom slotted icons in menu items (including menu items nested within submenus) using FluidMenuItem's iconBefore.slotName or iconAfter.slotName. See Tree Menu's usage examples in the FLUID Docs Site for demo.

changeLog.title: Support for Submenu Buttons as Links
changeLog.description: Tree Menu now supports "submenu buttons" as native links (i.e. anchor elements) when selectableSubmenuButtons: true & collapsibleSubmenus: false (see "Selectable Submenu Buttons & Submenu Buttons as Links" in Tree Menu's usage examples for more information).

changeLog.title: Set Selected Item via Public Method
changeLog.description: Tree Menu's new setSelectedItem() public method allows the currently selected menu item to be manually updated without changing the menuItems array. The method also allows for the selected item to be removed/reset by calling the method without specifying a menu item id (i.e. calling without parameter). NOTE: all menu items must have an id property for this method to work correctly (unless unselecting currently selected menu item).

changeLog.title: Submenu Expand/Collapse Animations
changeLog.description: Added new expand/collapse animations for submenu dropdowns.

changeLog.title: Refactored Tree Menu LESS => SCSS
changeLog.description: Refactored Tree Menu's stylesheet to use SCSS instead of LESS, & refactored theme tokens to use CSS custom properties.

changeLog.title: Theme Palette Support
changeLog.description: Added themePalette Prop to Tree Menu that allows selective color/aesthetic "style overrides" to be applied on top of the currently applied theme.

changeLog.title: QBI Theme Palette
changeLog.description: Added "QBI" theme palette MVP to Tree Menu.

changeLog.title: Selected Item Auto-Scroll
changeLog.description: Tree Menu now supports auto-scrolling the currently selected menu item into view via the scrollSelectedItemIntoView() public method or autoScrollSelectedItem Prop. Auto-scrolling is useful when programatically changing the selected menu item via updates to the menuItems Prop or via the setSelectedItem() public method.
